- Write high-quality, well-tested code across the full stack with emphasis on maintainability. 

- Design resilient systems that maintain uptime and performance as we scale globally. 

- Implement observability through logging, metrics, and telemetry to proactively triage issues. 

- Monitor and optimize performance at scale, identifying bottlenecks and implementing solutions. 

- Create comprehensive technical documentation including architectural diagrams and design decisions. 

Collaboration & Mentorship 

- Partner closely with product management to translate requirements into technical solutions. 

- Mentor engineers across experience levels, elevating technical skills and best practices. 

- Collaborate with Platform Services, Ops, and other teams on integration points and shared infrastructure. 

- Build consensus on technical approaches while having authority to make final decisions when needed.

Continuous Learning & Innovation 

- Stay at the forefront of content extraction and transformation technologies and industry trends, cloud-native architectures, and AI-powered tools. 

- Research and prove out new technologies through POCs that align with product strategy. 

- Contribute ideas that directly improve engineering velocity and quality. 

What You’ll Need to Be Successful

- 8+ years of professional software engineering experience delivering production-grade applications at scale on cloud platforms. 

- 5+ years in technical leadership and development roles using OCR technologies.

- Expert proficiency with OCR technologies such as Tesseract or Apryse 

- Expert proficiency building event-driven, microservice-based products 

- Expert proficiency developing on cloud platforms, preferably AWS

- Expert proficiency in observability, including logging, metrics, tracing, telemetry, preferably with DataDog 

What Will Make You Stand Out 

- Deep experience building with OCR & Text Extraction technologies. 

- Deep experience building document management or enterprise content management 

- Deep knowledge of event-driven architectures. 

- You know what it means and takes to ingest millions of documents an hour into a SaaS based document management platform 

- Track record of developing high-performance content extraction and transformation products at scale.

What You’ll Love About NetDocuments

title: Senior Product Engineer (Incident Response, remote)

(Fully remote, async-first, DevTools SaaS, 32-40h/week, time zones: UTC-3 to UTC+3) 

Help turn Checkly's incident response, on-call and status pages from a young product that customers already pay for into a core part of our platform. In 2027 agents will be on call and we want to be ready for that. You'll shape what we build in 2027, build it with AI coding agents, and talk directly to the teams who use it in the middle of an incident.

The best engineering teams don't wait for users to tell them something's broken. They build resilient, reliable systems to catch it first: in the pull request, in staging, or production at 3am, before a single customer notices. That instinct is Checkly's whole reason to exist.

Checkly gives developers, SRE teams and their agents the tools to own reliability the way they own their code: testing and synthetic monitoring defined as code, built on OpenTelemetry and Playwright. From pull request to post-mortem, in one place.

This role is about the post-mortem end of that line. We've built incident management, status pages and on-call into Checkly, and it's already bringing in revenue. Now we want to drive it strategically. Figure out together with us how to evolve incident management with clear signals and with agents being on call.

Thousands of teams, from AI companies like Mistral and resolve.ai to large engineering organizations like LinkedIn, Citi and 1Password, build with us. In 2024 we raised $20M in Series B funding from Balderton, CRV and Accel.

Our stack is AI (Claude, Codex, use what you like best), Vue.js, TypeScript, Go, Postgres, ClickHouse and AWS. We don't filter on programming language. If you ship full-stack with AI, you'll pick ours up. We ship to prod all day, every day, practice Agile (not scrum), keep meetings low and take pride in good documentation and good looking products.

What you'll do

- Shape a product from early stage to strategic. You'll be involved early in how we build incident response out as a platform, technically and on the product side. That means a lot of ownership, influence and visibility.

- Build the foundation first. Incident management, status pages, on-call, and tight integration with the rest of Checkly. For at least the first six months this is solid product engineering. AI-assisted incident response comes once the foundation is in place.

- Build and ship with AI. Coding agents are how you work: exploring solutions, scaffolding, refactoring, testing and debugging.

- Talk to the people on call. You'll be directly involved in customer conversations. You'll learn how responders work under pressure and turn that into what we build next.

- Find the right problems to solve. In a world where the cost of building software trends to zero, the hard part is picking what to build. You will favour pragmatic solutions that ship quickly, validate assumptions in production, and compound into long-term reliability improvements.

- Own your work end to end. From the first idea to rollout to how it behaves in production. You'll join the on-call and support rotations like everyone else.

What you should have

- You've built incident management, on-call, alerting or status page products before. You know what responders need from a tool when something breaks at 3am.

- You have shipped features with AI, not just experimented with them. You have taken work from zero to shipped with a comparable stack, made implementation decisions that held up, and put things in front of real users.

- You have built and run production software. You know the realities of operating software that people depend on: edge cases, incidents, regressions, and the need for observability and follow-up. You are not surprised when things break. You help fix them.

- You can drive a product area, not just pick up tickets. You make decisions without perfect information, and you ask for input when it counts. You have opinions about what we should build and why, and you change your mind when someone makes a better case.

- You work well without an office around you. You are autonomous and self-motivated in a remote setup, and you still enjoy getting to know your colleagues and helping other people get unstuck.

- You share work early. Drafts, rough MVPs and half-finished docs go out for feedback before they’re polished. In an async team, that’s how good ideas get better fast.

- FULLY remote role, within the UTC-3 to UTC+3 time zones. You need to be able to travel to (other) European countries without waiting for a visa appointment, for our annual kickoff, team meetups or conferences.

What you will hate about us

We would rather tell you now than have you find out in month two.

- We use AI for everything, and we mean everything. AI skepticism is not a thing here. If you have the slightest hesitation about working with AI every day, this is not the place for you, and that is completely fine.

- We write more than we talk. We are async-first, so a lot of decisions happen in documents and threads, not meetings. If you do your best thinking out loud in a room full of people, you will miss it here.

- We are lean, so you own the unglamorous parts too. There is no separate QA team, no ops layer to hand things off to, and you are on the support rotation and the on-call rotation like everyone else.

- We ship constantly and change our minds. Priorities move as we learn from customers. If you need long, stable planning cycles, this will feel chaotic.

- Customer signals come first, and most of the time they matter more than your instinct. We build what customers actually want, not the clever thing we dreamed up.

How we build with AI

Don’t take our word for it. Here’s what that looks like in practice, written by the team:

- Checkly and the agentic software layer : Hannes on why the CLI is how agents use software, including running monitoring and incidents.

- Your software factory stops at deploy : Stefan on what happens after deploy, when a failing check should kick off the fix.

- We let AI agents rewrite a 92M-message-a-day service in Go : Eddie on porting a core service with an agent, and zero incidents.

- Why I built my own AI agent orchestration tool : Immanuel on running 10 to 20 coding agents at once.

Benefits

- Transparent salary because your salary shouldn't be dictated by how good a negotiator you are. (more info below)

- Remote-first , flexible work hours , async-first (low meeting, high productivity) and transparent culture 

- Become part of a fast-growing, international, and remote team where your work matters, and your impact won't get lost in layers of bureaucracy.

- Stock options

- 27 days of paid vacation + your local public holidays

- Paid sick leave & up to 14 weeks of paid parental leave

- Co-working budget or home office setup

- Annual company kickoffs

Find out more here .

What we pay

Fair, competitive, and transparent pay is very important for us. Therefore we work with a standardized salary calculator that includes several factors such as seniority level as well as location.

For this role, the range is

- €88k - €107k for someone in a similar cost of market as UK, Germany etc, + stock options

- €79k - €97k for someone in a similar cost of market as Spain, Poland, Ukraine etc, + stock options

Apply

If this sounds interesting, please apply! Studies by several different sources have shown that on average men will apply for a job if they meet 60% of the application requirements. Women, non-binary people and POC will seek to match a much higher percentage of requirements before applying. If you're not sure you're the right fit, apply anyway and let us know what you bring to the table. We'd love to hear from you!

We're all about being transparent and setting clear expectations. That's why we've put together our hiring playbook and open-sourced our employee handbook . There you'll find a sneak peek of who we are, how we work and what you can expect in our hiring process.

title: Medior/Senior Java & Angular Developer
description:
Medior/Senior Java & Angular Developer 

Delft | 32–40 uur per week | 

Wil jij met jouw skills écht impact maken in de zorg? Bij CHA bouw je niet zomaar software – je bouwt systemen waar honderden apotheken en uiteindelijk miljoenen inwoners in Nederland dagelijks op vertrouwen. We zijn een klein team van zo’n 20 collega’s: groot genoeg om samen veel te bereiken, klein genoeg om elkaar écht te kennen. Hier krijg je de ruimte om te creëren, te verbeteren en je stempel te drukken, mét de steun van ervaren collega’s en in een omgeving waar samenwerking centraal staat. 

Wat ga je doen als Java & Angular Developer? 

Voor jou begint software pas écht te leven als het draait in productie, veilig, snel en in handen van gebruikers. Je bent niet alleen een bouwer, maar ook een meedenker: van functioneel ontwerp tot technische architectuur. Samen met je collega’s zorg je dat onze applicaties future-proof zijn en optimaal draaien. 

De komende tijd werken we aan het moderniseren en modulariseren van ons applicatielandschap. Dat betekent: veel ruimte om jouw ideeën en expertise toe te passen. Samen met je collega’s ontwikkel je nieuwe features, verbeter je bestaande functionaliteiten en zorg je ervoor dat zorgverleners minder tijd kwijt zijn aan administratie, zodat zij zich kunnen richten op hun verdere bedrijfsvoering.

We zoeken geen alleskunner die elk vinkje af kan kruisen, maar een enthousiaste developer die zich wil verdiepen én verbreden. Of je nu uit de Java/Spring-hoek komt en je kennis van Angular wilt versterken, of juist andersom: je krijgt bij ons de kans om beide kanten uit te bouwen. 

Wat zijn je belangrijkste taken/verantwoordelijkheden? 

- Meedenken over software-ontwerpen en deze vertalen naar robuuste oplossingen. 

- Nieuwe features ontwikkelen én bestaande functionaliteit verbeteren. 

- Clean code schrijven, mét geautomatiseerde (unit) tests. 

- 2e-lijns support leveren bij gebruikersvragen en incidenten. 

- Technisch aanspreekpunt zijn voor externe softwareleveranciers. 

- Werken aan diverse applicaties die het verschil maken in de dagelijkse zorg. 

Wie ben jij, en wat breng je mee? 

Java 

- Diepgaande kennis van Java & Spring (Boot, MVC, Batch). 

- Bedreven met Hibernate en SQL. 

- Ervaring met CI/CD-tooling en testing frameworks, zoals JUnit en Mockito. 

- Basiskennis van Angular is mooi meegenomen. 

Angular 

- Up-to-date kennis van Angular. 

- Skills in HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript & RxJS. 

- Ervaring met CI/CD-tooling en testing frameworks, zoals Jasmine. 

- Basiskennis Java & Spring Framework 

Soft skills 

- Je bent zelfstandig, neemt initiatief en werkt oplossingsgericht. 

- Je voelt je verantwoordelijk voor je werk én dat van je team. 

- Je durft fouten te maken, leert ervan en helpt je collega’s vooruit. 

- Je deelt je kennis graag en staat open om ook van anderen te leren. 

- Je hebt affiniteit met de farmacie en interesse in declaratieverwerking in de zorg. 

- Samenwerken met je collega’s geeft jou energie. 

Wat bieden wij jou? 

- Een dynamische werkomgeving met korte communicatielijnen en een informele cultuur; 

- Een salaris tussen €5000,- en €6250,- bruto per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur), afhankelijk van ervaring en achtergrond. Dit is geen absolute range, wel een goede indicatie; 

- Jaarlijkse bonus (bij goede resultaten) ter hoogte van een maandsalaris. 

- Reiskostenvergoeding (€ 0,23 per km) of een NS Business Card met volledige OV-vergoeding; 

- Thuiswerkvergoeding en flexibele werkmogelijkheden; 

- Een aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling met een lage werknemersbijdrage; 

- Minimaal 26 vakantiedagen op basis van een 40-urige werkweek, met de mogelijkheid om feestdagen flexibel in te zetten; 

- Diverse secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals korting op sportabonnementen via Bedrijfsfitness NL, een fietsleaseplan, workation-mogelijkheden, sabbaticalopties en mantelzorgverlof; 

- Tijd en ruimte voor vrijwilligerswerk onder werktijd. 

- Een inspirerende werkomgeving met een een gezellig, hecht team. 

Wie zijn wij? 

Clearing House Apothekers (CHA) is onderdeel van MSPS Groep B.V. – Medical Software & Processing Services . Samen met verschillende bedrijven binnen de groep (o.a. Infomedics en Vertimart) zetten wij ons in om de zorg slimmer, efficiënter en menselijker te maken. 

CHA is al ruim 30 jaar een betrouwbare partner voor apotheken in Nederland. Wij zorgen ervoor dat declaratie- en facturatieprocessen soepel verlopen, zodat apotheken zich volledig kunnen focussen op hun patiënten. Ons team bestaat uit ruim 20 collega’s: klein genoeg om elkaar écht te kennen, groot genoeg om impact te maken. Wij hebben een open cultuur, zijn ambitieus en zetten samen de schouders eronder. 

De sollicitatieprocedure 

Het eerste gesprek is een kennismaking met collega’s uit het team. Wie zijn wij, wie ben jij, wat neem je mee aan ervaring en vooral waar ben je naar op zoek? Daarna volgt een tweede ronde met een verdiepend gesprek. Mogelijk nodigen we je ook uit om een dagdeel mee te lopen zodat na afloop voor iedereen duidelijk is wat we van elkaar verwachten. 

Daarnaast is het belangrijk om te weten dat het verkrijgen van een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG) nodig is om de functie te kunnen vervullen. 

Reageren 

Ben je enthousiast geworden en geïnteresseerd in deze functie? Solliciteer dan vandaag nog met jouw CV met motivatiebrief. Wil je eerst meer weten? Kijk dan op https://www.infomedics.nl/werkenbij of neem contact op met onze Recruiter Chenara Vischer Heb je vragen? Je mag ons mailen naar ). 

Aan bureaus & recruiters: we got this. Profielen en cv’s die tóch ongevraagd worden toegezonden, zullen behandeld worden als directe sollicitaties van de kandidaat.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:

Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. 

Position description

You will integrate Sonar’s business-critical systems (e.g. Salesforce, Stripe, NetSuite) and build standalone solutions for specific needs. This will typically involve applying AWS event-driven architecture to solve internal user needs via a scalable and reliable end-to-end business platform.

You will be responsible for the entire lifecycle of these solutions (architecture, to implementation, to ongoing monitoring and maintenance/improvements), working directly and in close partnership with business functions (e.g. Sales, Finance, Product).

Your work (reliable, scalable, performant and secure applications) and skills (ability to translate complex business needs, coupled with a strong sense of ownership, urgency and partnership) will make you a trusted partner who drives significant efficiency and process improvements for the company.

What you will do 

- 
Design, build and maintain serverless, event-driven integrations on AWS (Lambda, EventBridge, SQS, DynamoDB, Secrets Manager).

Evaluate in-house and third-party API options, based on Sonar’s specific operating context.

-

- 
Follow governance principles (e.g. least-privilege IAM, secret management), processes (e.g. change management approvals) and tools (e.g. CI/CD to ship changes safely).

Experience and qualifications 

- 
5+ years of professional full-stack development experience.

- 
Proficiency in working with and steering AI coding tools (Codex, Claude, etc).

Hands-on AWS experience with serverless services and event-driven design.

Strong skills in a modern language (TypeScript preferred).

Clear written/verbal communication and experience with business/technical stakeholders.

- 
Stripe/Salesforce integration will be a significant plus; Databricks experience nice to have.

- 
Experience running production on-call for business-critical integrations.

- 
Proactive, driven and attention to detail - willingness to take ownership.

In-office culture 

We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having. 

Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.

Dein Profil

- Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Führung von Entwicklungsteams, idealerweise über DevOps, Frontend, Backend und Mobile hinweg, kombiniert mit eigener technischer Exzellenz.

- Fundierte Erfahrung im Aufbau und Betrieb skalierbarer B2B-SaaS-Architekturen, inklusive Schnittstellen, Integrationen und Automatisierungen für anspruchsvolle Grosskunden.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Query
description:
Headquarters: Canada (Remote), United States (Remote), United Kingdom (Remote) Mexico City, Mexico - Hybrid

About CircleCI Engineering

CI/CD has been solved. Now it's being reinvented. AI agents don't just run pipelines. They write code, trigger builds, interpret failures, and propose fixes. The interfaces that developers use to understand and trust that work don't exist yet. We're building them.

At CircleCI, our guiding principles aren't posters on a wall. We learn fast: we run experiments, accept failure, and scale what works. We think like the customer: every decision connects back to the developer sitting in front of a failing build at 2 am. We own the outcome: not just our slice of it, but the whole thing. If that's how you already work, you'll fit here.

About the Query Team

Every pipeline, job, and test that runs on CircleCI generates data, and that history is one of our biggest advantages in an agentic software delivery lifecycle. Flaky test detection, test insights, pipeline search, and agents that reason about why a build failed all depend on fast, reliable access to it.

The Query team owns the system that makes this possible. We pull product data out of the transactional services that create it and store it in datastores built for historical and analytical workloads. We serve it through domain-level APIs to CircleCI's product teams and to customers through our public API. Our goal is to make storing data "fire and forget" for every other team, and querying it fast and dependable at a scale that keeps growing.

What You'll Do

- Build AI-natively. AI is how we work. It's not a productivity layer on top of engineering, but the default starting point for how problems get approached and solved.

- Shape how we store data at scale. Own and harden our ClickHouse-based storage layer. Design schemas for known and emerging access patterns, and tune ingestion and query performance to support production-scale data.

- Build the pipelines that move our data. Design and own ingestion from event streams and durable workflows built on Temporal. Data should arrive reliably, stay queryable while it's in transit, and never slow down the critical path of the services that produce it.

- Serve data to the product and to customers. Evolve our platform into the default path for historical queries. Make getting historical data easy, not a bottleneck. Teams should be able to get what they need quickly and with minimal hand-holding, while Query keeps enough visibility into how the data is used to optimize ingestion and reads across every consumer. Build in the indexing, caching, and tiered storage required to keep it performant.

- Set technical direction. When the problem is complex or the answer isn't obvious, you lead the design discussion, write up the architecture decision, and make the call. You help decide which data domain we migrate next and how.

- Champion observability. Use Honeycomb, Datadog, and Rollbar to understand ingestion lag, query latency, and data correctness. For a data platform, operational data drives stability, not just incident response.

- Keep things moving. You take ambiguous data problems from design to production quickly, and you help the people around you move faster too.

You don't just patch problems, you ask why they happened. You'll fix the immediate issue, then solve the underlying team practice, process, or system that let it through.

What You'll Bring

- AI-native engineering practices. You use AI tools daily and can speak to what you've built, where they changed your approach, and where they fall short.

- Hands-on data experience. You've built or owned data-intensive systems such as ingestion pipelines, event-driven architectures, or analytical and time-series datastores. You understand the tradeoffs between transactional and analytical storage, and you've designed schemas and tuned queries for high-volume workloads. Experience with ClickHouse or another columnar database is a strong plus.

- Backend depth in Go. You're strong in Go, or strong in a comparable language and eager to work in Go: interface design, data modeling, service integration, and concurrency. Familiarity with React and TypeScript is a plus, since you'll occasionally work on the product surfaces that display this data.

- Distributed systems judgment. You understand delivery guarantees, idempotency, backpressure, and failure recovery. You know when to rely on a framework's reliability guarantees rather than building your own.

- Technical leadership. You've led the design of complex systems and made tradeoffs deliberately. You leave foundations others can build on. You raise the quality bar through reviews, mentoring, and direct feedback, not just through the code you write.

- A track record of shipping. 5+ years building and operating production backend systems. Your work has served real users, and you've treated latency, reliability, and correctness as design concerns.

Sound like you?

You care about how data powers the product, not just where it lives. You know how to make a datastore fast at scale, and have tuned schemas and queries against real production load. You think like a platform engineer, measuring your work by how much it unblocks the teams building on it. AI isn't a tool you reach for occasionally; it's a core part of how you approach and solve problems. If that sounds like you, we want to talk.

About CircleCI 

CircleCI is the world’s largest continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) platform, and the hub where code moves from idea to delivery. As one of the most-used DevOps tools - processing more than 3 million jobs a day - CircleCI has unique access to data on how the most effective engineering teams work, and the tools to help software companies successfully leverage the power of AI into their commercial applications. Companies like Hinge, HuggingFace, and Samsung use us to improve engineering team productivity, release better products, and get to market faster.

Founded in 2011 and headquartered in downtown San Francisco with a global, remote workforce, CircleCI is venture-backed by Base10, Greenspring Associates, Eleven Prime, IVP, Sapphire Ventures, Top Tier Capital Partners, Baseline Ventures, Threshold
Ventures, Scale Venture Partners, Owl Rock Capital, Next Equity Partners, Heavybit, and Harrison Metal Capital. 

CircleCI is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

How CircleCI Uses AI in Hiring 

At CircleCI, people make our hiring decisions. We use technology to support our recruiting team so they can spend more time on what matters most: getting to know you.

Where we may use AI 

- Job descriptions and messaging : AI may help draft job descriptions and role-specific messaging so they are clear and accurate.

- Application review : For some roles, we use an AI tool to review applications, including resumes and application responses, against criteria our hiring team sets for the role. The tool generates a fit score and summary to help recruiters organize and prioritize applications. 

- Interview notes : With advance notice, an AI note-taking tool may join interviews to record, transcribe, and summarize the conversation. This lets interviewers focus on talking with you. You will be told before each interview, and you may opt out at any stage by letting your recruiter know. If you opt out, the tool will not join, and your candidacy is not affected.

- Outreach : AI may help draft candidate outreach and scheduling messages, which our team reviews before sending.

Our commitment 

AI does not make hiring decisions at CircleCI. Our recruiters and hiring teams review candidates and make every decision to advance or reject an application. No candidate is rejected based solely on an AI score. We have tools and processes in place to test for bias and to review how these tools perform, and we adjust our approach as AI technology and the laws that govern it change.

Your choices 

You can ask for human-only review of your application, opt out of AI interview note-taking, request an accommodation, or ask questions about how we use AI. Contact recruiting@circleci.com . For how we handle your data, including retention, see our Privacy Policy.

title: Backend Engineer - Acquisition Technology
description:
Backend Engineer - Acquisition Tech - DE

Hybrid in London or remote within the UK

We’re looking for a Backend Engineer 

You'll be the first engineer on the German side of Acquisition Tech, owning the customer acquisition systems that decide which small businesses iwoca reaches and how they convert.

The company 

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team 

The Acquisition Tech team owns how iwoca reaches German small businesses – across paid advertising, SEO, social media, direct mail, and outbound sales – and how they become customers. The data and models behind every channel sit with the team.

You'll report to the engineering lead for iwoca's German market, based in London alongside the rest of the technical team. Day to day you'll work with a product manager and a data scientist in London, plus commercial strategy, marketing, and sales – some of whom sit in Germany.

You'll be the only engineer on the German side of acquisition, working in iwoca's UK Acquisition Tech team's codebase. You'll work with their engineers on code reviews and design decisions.

The role 

You'll build the backend behind iwoca's German acquisition technology – building on what already runs in the UK, and creating what Germany needs of its own.

- Ownership. You'll own the German side of the acquisition stack – from the lead-value signals iwoca sends to ad platforms, to the bidding and attribution built on them – and decide what to build from scratch.

- Technical strategy. You'll help shape the long-term roadmap. The team sets commercial objectives; you’ll shape the architecture, scaling, and technical direction.

- Funnel optimisation. You'll work with marketing and data science to target relevant businesses across paid search, direct mail, and outbound sales, and to convert more of them once they arrive. You'll integrate third-party APIs to minimise friction in sign-up and improve the lead data behind every channel.

- Data engineering. You'll build the pipelines, databases, and REST APIs behind the acquisition stack, plus the HubSpot tooling the sales team use.

- Models in production. You'll engineer the features that data scientists need, put their models into production, and set up the versioning and monitoring that keep them running.

The requirements 

Essential:

- Backend engineering. You have hands-on experience designing and building backend systems in Python, in production.

- SQL. You are comfortable in SQL beyond CRUD. You shape schemas, tune queries, and reason about how data flows through relational systems.

- End-to-end. You take work from an initial problem through to delivery, shaping solutions, making trade-offs, and iterating based on how systems are used.

- Commercial or product thinking. You're comfortable working directly with marketing and sales. You take a business goal, dig into the root of what they need and why, then shape what gets built – as well as owning how.

- AI leverage. You've built agentic workflows, or used AI to scale your engineering output beyond what you could deliver alone. You judge when to use it and when not to.

- Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail to your audience.

Bonus:

- Full-stack. You’re open to coding frontend elements, particularly in React or TypeScript.

- Python stack. You have worked with SQLAlchemy, scikit-learn, pandas, and PostgreSQL.

- Database design. You have designed, built, and managed relational databases.

- Analytics tooling. You have used Snowflake, Looker, or the equivalent.

The salary 

We expect to pay from £70,000 to £85,000 for this role. But, we're open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture 

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices 

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

- Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

- Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits 

- Flexible working hours.

- Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

- A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

- 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

- A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

- Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

- 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

- An employee equity incentive scheme.

- Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

- Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

- Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

- A learning and development budget for everyone.

- Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

- Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

Useful links:

- iwoca benefits & policies 

- Interview welcome pack (TAP)

title: Senior AI Engineer - Product
description:
About Mirakl: 

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl’s operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. For more information: www.mirakl.com .

Mirakl in Numbers: 

- 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40

- 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo

- 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France

Our Values: 

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

- 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success

- 🏆 Get Things Done: We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results

- 🚀 Go Above & Beyond: We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence

- 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture

- 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

1. The Team You'll Join 

You'll be part of our Mirakl Assistant team, led by Remi Takase, Senior Data Science Manager . The team is part of a passionate and skilled data organisation of Data Scientists, Research Scientists, Data Engineers and SREs, building on a state-of-the-art Machine Learning and Data platform. The Mirakl Assistant team is a new team that runs like a start-up inside a scale-up. Together, you'll be designing, building and scaling the conversational AI assistant that changes how our users work across Mirakl products.

The assistant knows the platform and the users, and helps them get the most out of Mirakl, from finding their way around the product, to understanding their business and growing it. We're taking it from conversational to action-oriented: users ask, and the assistant gets it done.

AI agents are fundamentally reshaping commerce software: what customers expect from it, how they interact with it, and how they integrate it into their business. At Mirakl, AI is a core part of our product strategy - from Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce. This is where you come in.

The position is a permanent contract, based in Paris or Bordeaux, with up to 1 day of remote work per week. 

2. Your Impact 

- Design, build and scale the core capabilities of the Mirakl Assistant, including RAG, LLM orchestration, tool use, memory and context engineering, from rapid prototype to robust production feature

- Own the full production lifecycle of the assistant: automated data pipelines, CI/CD, deployment, load testing, latency and resilience

- Run technical discovery and feasibility studies for new capabilities and integrations across Mirakl products

- Drive quality improvement through rigorous offline and online evaluation, data-driven experimentation and iteration

- Collaborate cross-functionally with Software, Data Engineering, SRE and Product teams to evolve the agentic foundations and translate user needs into capabilities

3. What You'll Bring to the Role 

Experience: 

- 5+ years of experience as a Machine Learning Engineer with strong software engineering skills, or as a Software/Data Engineer with hands-on AI and ML experience

- Proven track record of deploying AI/ML systems in production products, with an automation-first approach

- Proven experience building AI agents with LLMs, RAG, MCP and related technologies, including architectural design

- Strong experience in data-driven iteration, from experimentation to evaluation

Skills: 

- LLM orchestration and agentic systems design (RAG, MCP, LangChain, etc.)

- Software engineering proficiency in Python

- Solid grounding in machine learning algorithms and fundamental

- Rigorous metrics-driven evaluation and experimentation

- A "0 to 1" mindset: able to thrive in ambiguity and take an idea from exploration to production

- Product sense: understanding end users’ pain points and balancing technical excellence with customer impact 

- Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills

- Frontend development (TypeScript, React) is a plus

4. Tech Stack 

- Languages: Python, SQL, TypeScript

- Backend: FastAPI, LangChain, OpenSearch, Kafka, PostgreSQL

- Frontend: React (micro-frontend architecture)

- AI: LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.)

- Data Platform & Orchestration: Spark, Delta Lake, Databricks Workflows

- Observability: Langfuse, MLflow

- Infrastructure: Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, AWS, GCP

5. Languages 

- English: Fluent

- French: Fluent

7. Our Hiring Process 

We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match.

Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application - this helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.

- A 30-minute conversation with one of our Tech Recruiters to discuss your background, expectations, and what Mirakl can offer you

- A 1h30 technical interview with two members of the Labs team

- A 1h10 interview with the Hiring Manager

- A 1-hour STAR interview with future Mirakl colleagues to explore our values and culture

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. We are looking for passionate technologists to join our Pre-Sales organization to ensure that our growth is grounded and guided by strong technical alignment with our platform and the needs of our customers.

MongoDB Pre-Sales Solution Architects are responsible for guiding our customers and users to design and build reliable, scalable systems using our data platform. Our team is made up of seasoned technical sales professionals, software architects, entrepreneurs, and developers who take direct responsibility for customer success, including the design of their software, deployment, and operations. You'll work closely with our sales executives, helping customers solve business problems by leveraging our solutions, playing a key role in winning deals and driving the business forward. You'll be a trusted advisor to a wide range of users from startups to the world's largest enterprise IT organizations. 

This role can be based out of our Zurich office or remotely in the Switzerland region.

As an ideal candidate, you will have:

- Ideally 8 to 11 years of related experience in a customer facing role, with 5 to 7 years of experience in pre-sales with enterprise software

- Minimum of 3 years experience with modern scripting languages (e.g. Python, Node.js, SQL) and/or popular programming languages (e.g. C/C++, Java, C#) in a professional capacity

- Experience designing with scalable and highly available distributed systems in the cloud and on-prem

- Demonstrated ability to work with customers to review complex architecture of existing applications, providing guidance on how to improve by leveraging technology

- Excellent presentation, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to convey complex technical and business concepts in a clear and compelling manner to technology and business leadership

- Ability to strategize with sales teams and provide recommendations on how to drive a multi-threaded account strategy, aligning other MongoDB and ecosystem resources to move towards a mutually beneficial account plan

- The ability to travel up to 25%

- A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience

- Fluency in English and German

You may also have:

- Experience selling databases and/or deploying applications with any of the major cloud providers 

- Experience with database programming and data models 

- Experience in data engineering or AI/ML projects

- Understanding of popular sales methodologies/ frameworks such as MEDDPICC/ Command of the Message

- A MongoDB Certification

What you do at MongoDB:

- Design and Architect: Design scalable and performant applications, systems and infrastructure for large software projects leveraging MongoDB

- Customer Advising and Value Articulation: Guide customers on architecture patterns and optimisation strategies for MongoDB, while clearly communicating its business value to the relevant stakeholders

- Sales Partnership: Collaborate with the sales team to drive account success through account planning, opportunity prioritization/qualification and pipeline generation strategy, while taking ownership of the technical aspects (including but not limited to technical discovery, demos, proof of value, presentations, sizing and documentation)

- Demand Generation: Proactively generate demand within the sales territory through self-driven technical initiatives, participation in events such as industry trade shows and account-based marketing events

- Customer Success: Foster strong customer relationships, build champions and ensure customer success and satisfaction

- Innovation and Improvement: Continuously seek opportunities to innovate and improve MongoDB solutions and processes (e.g. by relaying field feedback to the product team), as well as proactively mentor other Solutions Consulting team members 

- Personal Training and Development: Engage in ongoing training and professional development to stay abreast of MongoDB product suite as well as industry trends

What you will learn:

MongoDB Product Suite Mastery:

- Core Database Server: Master the fundamentals and advanced features of MongoDB's core database

- Atlas and Advanced Services: Gain expertise in Atlas (fully managed cloud database service), Atlas Stream Processing, Atlas Data Lake, Atlas Full-Text Search, Atlas Vector Search, and Charts

- Relational Migrator: Learn to migrate from relational databases seamlessly

Market-Relevant Technologies:

- Hyperscaler Ecosystem: Gain expertise in designing complex systems utilizing cloud services on hyperscaler platforms

- Complementary Technologies: Enhance your skills with partner and complementary technologies such as Apache Kafka and Kubernetes

Modern Architecture Design:

- Design Patterns and Methodologies: Embrace best practices in microservices, DevOps, cloud, and security

- Cutting Edge RAG and AI Architectures: Help customers on their generative AI journeys and working with industry leading partners in the space

Sales Techniques and Soft Skills:

- Effective Communication: Master presentations, demonstrations, and whiteboarding

- Client Interaction: Develop strategies for discovery and objection handling

Industry Insights:

- Diverse Market Verticals: Gain exposure to a broad spectrum of interesting use cases across various industries

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB. 

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy , we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB , and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

title: Senior Quantum Physicist
description:
About IonQ: 

IonQ, Inc . [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance .

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before. 

Location: This role is based at our Oxford, UK office with the option to work a few days a week remotely.
Travel: Up to 5% 
Job ID: 1777

The Role: 

We are pioneering advancements in quantum computing by utilizing trapped ion technology and our proprietary laser-free quantum control methods. Our research and development efforts build on our fully integrated quantum processors that can be fabricated within standard silicon foundries. This unique approach allows us to leverage the highest-performing qubit technology while ensuring scalability and manufacturability using existing semiconductor fabrication technology. We approach quantum computing with a focus on minimizing errors, striving to achieve ultra-low gate errors at scale. Our immediate objective is to develop functional quantum computers within the NISQ regime, aiming to construct fault-tolerant machines that require minimal QEC overhead. Our recent breakthroughs include achieving 99.97% fidelity in two-qubit gates and 99.9992% fidelity in single-qubit operations without error correction, setting new industry standards for performance.

We are looking for Quantum Physicist to join our UK Science team at IonQ. Our Quantum Scientists work at the forefront of our research efforts to develop the next generation of quantum computers. 

They are responsible for validating and optimising the performance of our computers, playing a critical role in ensuring we are able to meet our research and development goals and timelines. Our Scientists’ work spans a broad range of areas from designing, coding, debugging and executing experiments, to developing and validating novel control schemes. They are responsible for documenting and sharing their findings with the aim of pushing the boundaries of system performance.

Responsibilities: 

As a Senior Quantum Scientist, you will typically be responsible for a combination of these different responsibilities:

- Prototyping and characterising coherent control and cooling schemes for trapped-ion qubits using laser and microwave fields.

- Calibrating and benchmarking quantum systems, focusing on achieving the highest fidelities for quantum circuit primitives (e.g. ion transport or gate operations) and full circuits.

- Validating emerging trap technologies, including integrated electronics and photonics for large-scale architectures.

- Analysing experimental data, debug complex hardware/software interactions, and ensure reliability of qubit operations.

Requirements: 

To be successful in this role, you will need a PhD in physics or a related discipline, with a strong foundation in atomic or qubit-related physics. Prior postdoctoral or industry experience is valuable, but we are open to applicants moving directly from a PhD.

We’re looking for someone with a solid background in quantum control, and hands-on experience in calibration, benchmarking, or coherent control of qubits, would be desirable. We’re looking for motivated scientists who can contribute to the progress of this fast moving, highly technical team and help the organisation meet our research goals.

You’d be a great fit with:

- Proven expertise in experimental AMO physics or quantum computing. Experience with trapped ions is beneficial though not essential.

- Prior experience in one or more of the following: spectroscopy or coherent control of multi-level systems, characterisation of control hardware, gate fidelity benchmarking or running quantum circuits on hardware.

- Strong proficiency in programming and data analysis, experience of Python or Rust is desirable.

- Strong collaborative skills, with the ability to work independently and as part of a fast-moving team.

- A track record of scientific communication through publications, talks and conferences would be advantageous.

Benefits: 

Be part of a team that’s shaping the future of quantum. We offer more than just a role, you’ll join a world class community of scientists, engineers and innovators working to unlock the full potential of quantum computing.

We offer a range of benefits, including opportunities to further your career alongside industry leaders, a competitive salary with IonQ stock options, an annual performance bonus, generous annual leave, flexible hybrid working, private medical and dental insurance for you and your family, and much more.

Join us and be part of the future of quantum computing.

description:
Software Engineer, Application Integration

In Brief 

- 
We're a rapidly growing startup on a mission to make healthcare proactive by empowering physicians, nurses, and care team members with real-time data to save lives.

- 
Join us in transforming healthcare from reactive to proactive. You’ll spearhead the engineering effort to build the bridge between massive, complex Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems and the Bayesian platform, delivering critical, real-time insights to help clinicians save lives.

Who We Are 

Bayesian Health’s mission is to improve patient outcomes by empowering clinicians with the insights they need to make the right decision for the right patient at the point-of-care. We’re a diverse team of clinicians, engineers, machine learning experts, product designers, and performance improvement leaders committed to enabling smarter, patient-specific care delivery through unlocking the power of data.

We’re funded by top tier tech and biotech investors: Obvious Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, American Medical Association’s venture arm, Catalio Partners, and LifeForce Capital. Our company has won many awards; most recent recognitions include: Forbes AI Top 50, World Economic Forum Tech Pioneer, Time Best Inventions, BioTech AI Company of the Year.

Read more about our recent publication in Nature Medicine that associates our products with lives saved. 

What you’ll do 

You will be at the forefront of a high-impact engineering mission, building the bridge between the Bayesian platform and the clinical workflows inside massive, complex Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems, delivering the real-time lifesaving insights that clinicians rely on. Working directly with our health system clients' EHR and clinical informatics teams, you'll bring our clinical insights to the point of care — in the right workflow, at the right moment — empowering care teams to make the best decisions for their patients.

Each integration is a partnership. An Implementation Lead owns the client relationship and project management; a Clinical Integration owns clinical workflow design and training. You own the technical workstream — which means you're the engineer in the room. When a clinician says the alert didn't fire for a patient, you have thirty minutes and their full attention to trace it from the EHR launch context through the API to the underlying data, and tell them what happened.

Responsibilities 

- 
Clinical Workflow Integration: Extend and configure the full-stack application across the EHR integration surface, coordinating with client EHR and clinical informatics teams, to deliver Bayesian's clinical insights to clinicians.

- 
Integration Testing & Troubleshooting: Implement automated integration tests and work directly with client technical teams and frontline clinicians during integration testing to investigate and resolve issues, ensuring smooth and timely integrations.

- 
Production Deployment & Go-Live: Execute the deployment process in close collaboration with the client's technical team, ensuring all configurations and builds for the application and workflow are successfully promoted to production for a seamless launch. During go-live week, you will serve as the technical point of contact for any application integration issues, both internally and with the client's teams, providing clear status updates to cross-functional partners so they can effectively manage client communication.

- 
Integration Tooling & Automation: Develop frameworks and tooling, leveraging LLMs and automation, to increase the efficiency and velocity of our platform integrations as we scale.

- 
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work alongside an Implementation Lead, Clinical Integration, and the client's technical teams to align the application integration workstream with the overall integration effort.

Minimum qualifications 

- 
BS in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience

- 
3+ years building and deploying full-stack applications into production, including integration with external APIs (React, TypeScript preferred)

- 
Strong ability to investigate and resolve application issues end-to-end

- 
Experience with cloud solutions (AWS, Azure, etc.) and relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, etc.) in a production environment

- 
Experience writing automated integration and end-to-end tests for production systems

- 
Strong communicator with a demonstrated ability to collaborate across functions, working effectively with internal stakeholders, including Product Managers, to align on priorities and deliver results.

Preferred qualifications 

- 
Experience building EHR-embedded applications such as SMART on FHIR, CDS Hooks, or Epic launch integration.

- 
Experience rolling out production deployments, supporting systems through go-live via an on-call or support rotation, and triaging production issues

- 
Experience working with enterprise customers, and the agility and responsiveness they require.

- 
Experience building internal tooling or automation, including leveraging LLMs, to improve engineering velocity

title: Software Engineer II (Full-Stack) - Consumer Order Experience
description:
Our Global Structure 

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Why Deliveroo?

We're building the definitive online food company, transforming the way the world eats by making hyper-local food more convenient and accessible. We're at the forefront of an industry, powered by our market-leading technology and unrivalled network to bring incredible convenience and selection to our customers.

Working at Deliveroo is the perfect environment to build a definitive career, motivated by impact on your own development, on Deliveroo as we scale, and on the marketplace and communities we serve.

Consumer Ordering Experience owns the core purchase journey: the store page, item page, basket, and checkout flow, across both app and web. It's a global team — the surfaces we build support all of our brands: Deliveroo, Wolt, and Doordash. You'd be the team's first dedicated web/full-stack engineer, helping us build out our web experience from the ground up.

What You'll Do

- Own and evolve the store, item, basket, and checkout experiences on web, working primarily in React and TypeScript

- Contribute to backend services written in Golang — deep Go experience isn't a hard requirement, but you should be comfortable picking up a new statically typed backend language

- Improve code structure, shape architecture, and review code across the team

- Partner closely with your Product Manager and fellow engineers to scope and ship changes to the ordering funnel

- Take part in the hiring process and support the growth of your teammates as the team scales

What We're Looking For

Must haves: 

- Strong full-stack experience — comfortable working across web frontend (React/TypeScript) and backend (Go, or similar) to unblock delivery end-to-end

- Experience designing, implementing and rolling out A/B experiments (or strong aptitude to quickly learn our experimentation platform) — including guardrail metrics, staged rollouts and reading results

- Comfortable operating in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment with shifting priorities and short XP cycles (weeks, not quarters)

- Strong ownership mindset — able to take a brief PRD through design, implementation, rollout and production monitoring with minimal hand-holding

- Track record of shipping incrementally and iterating on data rather than big-bang launches

- Willing to participate in an on-call rotation and respond to incidents

Nice to haves: 

- Experience coordinating engineers across multiple platforms (iOS/Android/Web/BE) on a single initiative

- Active use of AI-assisted coding workflows, and interest in building reusable tooling/skills for the team

We're looking for someone London-based who can work from our office 2–3 days a week alongside the rest of the team.

Why Join Us? 

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters—solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community organisers, proud parents, and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎 A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

💰 Share in the success you help create Competitive salary and equity options, so you’re rewarded for the impact you make.

➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our Tech Blog .

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Explore our Engineering Interview Guide here to help you feel confident at each stage.

Our Global Structure 

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion 

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

Privacy 

Deliveroo will process your personal information in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy .

Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness .

title: Principal AI Engineer (x/f/m)
description:
We are looking for a Principal AI Engineer to join the Practice Efficiency team at Doctolib.

Your mission will be to define and deliver how AI transforms the daily work of healthcare professionals — through intelligent scheduling, automated document processing, smart task management, and AI-assisted patient communication. As a Principal-level individual contributor, you will own the deepest technical challenges within the Practice Efficiency scope: setting the AI architecture bar, driving rigorous evaluation standards, and directly shaping how AI-powered features reach healthcare professionals and their patients at scale — starting with the Phone Assistant, currently one of Doctolib's most strategic product bets.

Working in the tech team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients.

What you'll do 

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

- Own end-to-end AI architecture decisions for Practice Efficiency — from model selection and agentic system design to production deployment patterns,, and strategic build vs. buy calls

- Architect and deliver agentic applications at scale, defining how Practice Efficiency AI features are structured, evaluated, and iterated on in production

- Design robust, scalable AI infrastructure: model and prompt versioning, guardrails, uncertainty quantification, cost optimisation, and observability — enabling the team to ship reliably and fast

- Lead the technical delivery of the Phone Assistant's AI capabilities, balancing ambitious product ambitions with engineering rigour and production reliability

- Ensure responsible AI delivery in a regulated healthcare context, embedding explainability, GDPR/HDS compliance, and human-in-the-loop design across all Practice Efficiency AI features

- Partner closely with Product Managers and cross-functional stakeholders to translate customer and business needs into sound technical decisions, acting as a bridge between engineering depth and product delivery

Who you are 

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You'll be a great fit if you: 

- Have 10+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 5 years focused on building AI products — including experience building AI systems before the rise of large language models, giving you strong fundamentals in evaluation, data pipelines, and system design under uncertainty

- Have a strong background in building and operating large-scale distributed systems — we value deep systems engineering expertise and will consider profiles who bring exceptional scale experience alongside a solid grounding in AI

- Have hands-on experience designing and shipping agentic applications, with a clear understanding of the challenges around reliability, observability, and evaluation in production agentic systems

- Are product-centric by nature: you have worked closely with Product Managers and product organisations, bring genuine business sense and customer closeness, and see yourself as part of the product delivery chain — not just the technical one

- Are fluent in English

It would be fantastic if you: 

- Have experience with LLM fine-tuning, RAG systems, or automatic speech recognition in production environments

- Have built AI products in healthcare, financial services, or another regulated domain where safety and auditability are non-negotiable

- Have contributed to or built shared AI platforms used by multiple product teams

Life at Doctolib Tech 

- Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to country and healthcare specialty requirements.

- Our stack in this product area is Ruby on Rails and TypeScript/React in the monolith, Kotlin for new services, with Postgres, Redis and Kafka underneath.

- We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here .

Want to learn more about our tech culture and environment? Visit the Doctolib Tech site . 

What we offer 

- A Deutschlandticket (Germany-wide public transport pass) fully paid for by Doctolib

- 28 vacation days + 1 additional day for each full calendar year of employment (up to a maximum of 30 days)

- Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy

- Company health insurance with great supplementary benefits through our partner Allianz

- Company pension scheme (bAV) through Allianz with an employer subsidy of 40% (15% within the probationary period)

- The Doctolib Parent Care program, which includes one month additional parental leave and much more

- Enrollment in Doctolib's long-term employee value sharing plan called DoctoGrowth

- Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care

- Subsidized sports membership through our partner Urban Sports Club

- A flexible workplace policy offering both hybrid and office-based mode

- Alongside healthy snacks and our regular breakfast buffet, we provide a subsidized meal benefit

- For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support

- Relocation support in case of international mobility

- Access to the best AI tools for coding, development and dedicated training

Our interview process 

- Recruiter Interview

- System Design Interview

- Behavioral Interview

- Engineering Manager Case

- At least one reference check

We want your experience to be clear, respectful, and transparent. Learn more about our hiring process on our candidate experience page .

Job details 

- Permanent position

- Ruby on Rails, TypeScript, Kotlin

- Full-time

- Location: Berlin

- Hybrid work setup (up to 2 remote days per week)

- Start date: as soon as possible

We welcome everyone 

At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. This translates into our recruitment process. We evaluate candidates based solely on qualifications and motivation, without any form of discrimination.

The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, or disability.

To ensure equal opportunities, we invite you to exclude personal information (e.g., pictures, age) from your applications. If you require any accommodation, please let us know for support during the hiring process.

Join us in building the healthcare we all dream of!

Your data privacy 

All information provided is processed by Doctolib for application management. For data processing details, click here: Germany | France | Italy | Netherlands . Please contact hr.dataprivacy(at)doctolib.com for inquiries or to exercise your rights.

title: Staff Software Engineer - Market Data
description:
About Dune 

Dune's mission is to make onchain finance observable. We're the industry standard for onchain data: a blockchain data and intelligence provider that institutions, protocols, and analysts trust to understand the onchain world and the frontiers of finance. We deliver structured datasets, spanning stablecoins, RWAs, tokens, lending, trading, and more, from 130+ chains and counting, to 1,000+ industry leaders including Visa, WisdomTree, FINRA, the IMF, Bloomberg, Standard Chartered, Coinbase, Forbes, and the Financial Times.

We're a tight knit team of ~50 hard working people, spread across Europe and eastern US timezones 🌍️, having an outsized impact on the industry. We take pride in being ambitious and doing world class work while staying humble and lighthearted. We believe in building open, verifiable data that lets individuals and institutions do deep research into ecosystems like Ethereum, Solana, Robinhood and many more.

We're backed by some of the world's best investors. In February 2022, we announced our Series B funding round led by Coatue and Union Square Ventures, an important milestone that let us double down on our mission.

If you like being challenged and want to work together with a brilliant team on an important mission, come join us.

Learn more about us: 

About Dune
https://dune.com/about 

Values and working at Dune

https://dune.com/careers 

About the role 

Dune is building market data solutions for institutional customers who need timely, accurate and reliable financial data they can depend on. Our team turns onchain activity into realtime feeds and associated reference data along with historical data capture.

You will work on our new market data platform, and help shape how it evolves to support the growing features and customer base. You’ll design systems that can grow across chains, protocols and product capabilities while making clear decisions about correctness, latency, reliability, and cost.

This is a hands-on Staff Engineer role. You will be expected to turn ambiguous requirements into designs and deliverable work, implement difficult parts yourself, and help other engineers own meaningful parts of the platform. AI-assisted development is a core part of how we expect you to work, paired with strong engineering judgment and ownership of what you ship.

In this role you will 

- 
Design and build distributed systems for ingestion, normalization, processing, storage, and delivery of realtime market data from blockchain and other relevant sources.

- 
Build and operate streaming solutions that handle event ordering, timestamps, duplicates, replay, gaps, and recovery, including blockchain reorganizations and finality where they affect customer data.

- 
Build reliable client feeds and APIs with clear delivery contracts, schema evolution, access controls, and predictable behavior under load or when consumers fall behind.

- 
Partner with teams across Dune on reference data models and historical data capture.

- 
Define and improve service objectives and data quality measures.

- 
Instrument latency, freshness, completeness, and correctness, and turn incidents into lasting improvements in recovery and operations.

- 
You will debug independently and drive root cause analysis to a fix that holds.

- 
Own services through deployment and production support, including participation in the team’s on-call rotation.

- 
Use AI throughout development: explore designs, implement changes, build tests, investigate failures, and improve documentation. Develop repeatable workflows and share what works with the team.

- 
Lead technical decisions across team boundaries, write clear designs, and mentor engineers through implementation and review.

You might be a great fit if 

- 
You have built and operated distributed backend or data services with demanding reliability and performance requirements. You understand their failure modes and can debug problems across service and data boundaries.

- 
You have experience with realtime streaming systems, including concurrency, state management, backpressure, and recovery. You care about data correctness, from timestamps and numeric precision to schema changes and corrections.

- 
You have strong computer science fundamentals and backend engineering skills. Experience in Rust, Go or comparable languages is also valuable.

- 
You turn ambiguous requirements into pragmatic designs and production services, and help other engineers deliver parts of the solution.

- 
You communicate clearly in writing and work effectively with a distributed team.

- 
Financial or market data experience at a financial institution.

Not required but a plus 

- 
Onchain data experience: blockchain indexing such as with EVM or Solana.

- 
Reference data experience: instrument and entity masters, identifier mapping, effective-dated records, or tokenized asset and fund data.

- 
Experience at a company where the data is the product.

Perks & Benefits 

- 
A competitive salary and equity package 🚀. Both salary and equity is top 25% of companies in the space

- 
Our employee equity scheme has world-class employee-friendly terms with a heavily discounted strike price (~90%) and a 10-year exercise window

- 
5 weeks PTO + local public holidays (that can be swapped to suit you) 🏖

- 
A fully remote-first approach 🧑‍💻 within a distributed team with flexible working hours; you structure your own day 

- 
Say goodbye to meeting overload! We believe in a healthy mix of async and sync work, so you can focus on what truly matters—no more wasted time on endless meetings!

- 
Good health is important, so we offer private medical insurance, dental & vision as standard 🩺

- 
We believe in paid parental leave 👶 to help you celebrate this important milestone, transition to your new life, and bond with your new baby. We offer 16 weeks to primary and 6 weeks to secondary caregivers, fully paid. Plus a 2-week part-time phased return at full pay to help you get used to your new (and slightly more complex!) schedule

- 
Quarterly offsites in various exciting locations as a company or team to connect, work together and have fun (so far in Tuscany 🇮🇹 Berlin 🇩🇪 Austria 🇦🇹 and Athens 🇬🇷).

- 
On top of this 👆each person gets a yearly travel allowance to connect and co-work with someone or a team of people for a few days.

- 
An allowance for your at-home setup, to ensure you are happy, comfortable and productive. If you prefer a local co-working space, we’ll pay for your desk.

- 
An annual allowance for your Learning and Development needs.

- 
Work with some of the best people you’ll ever get to meet!

- 
And of course, you get some awesome Dune swag! ✌️😎

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
