title: Frontend Engineer
description:
At Catawiki, every day brings the extraordinary! Whether it’s Daniel Ricciardo’s Formula 1 Car , a Woolly Mammoth’s Skeleton , Lady Gaga's Jumpsuit or Usain Bolt’s running shoe , we encounter exceptional objects every day.

We’re a one-of-a-kind marketplace for buying and selling special objects. Each week, more than 100,000 unique items are auctioned, all carefully curated by our passionate in-house experts.

Having sold over 25 million unique objects, our mission is to become the world’s most popular destination for special objects. As a growing, diverse and sustainable scale-up, we proudly live by three core values. If these values resonate with you, we’d love to explore how you can join us.

- Taking ownership and driving impact 

- Being open to change and feedback

- Being passionate about our mission and our customers. 

Your Mission 

Join one of Catawiki’s main Development Verticals, Demand , Supply or Fulfilment , and help us improve the experience of buyers, sellers, and internal teams across our platform. Working alongside Backend, Frontend, iOS, and Android Engineers, you’ll build product innovations for Catawiki’s apps and web app.
You’ll collaborate closely with QA, UX Designers, Product Managers, and with the support of a Tech Lead Manager to create beautiful, adaptable web frontends on top of scalable microservices. While your product area may vary, your goal will remain the same: deliver reliable, high-quality experiences that make a meaningful impact for our users.

What You'll Do 

Here at Catawiki, you will make an impact by improving and delivering product innovations for the Catawiki platform:

- Build impactful product experiences by improving and delivering innovations across the Catawiki platform for buyers, sellers, customer service, and internal operations teams.

- Create adaptable web frontends on top of scalable microservices using our core frontend stack of TypeScript and ReactJS.

- Deliver responsive, accessible experiences that work well across desktop, tablet, and mobile screens.

- Optimise product performance by measuring and monitoring systems and using insights to improve the experiences you build.

- Experiment and learn by partnering with Product Managers and UX Designers on A/B tests, using data analysis to validate ideas and iterate.

- Collaborate across disciplines with engineers, QA, design, and product colleagues to build scalable and maintainable solutions.

What You’ll Bring 

You are a Frontend Engineer with extensive frontend experience in multiple technologies, with an impressive portfolio of past frontend deliveries, and eager to expand your knowledge and impact, ready to take the next step in your career. As a Senior Developer, you are effective in lifting the level of your team, and you love to cooperate with Frontend Engineers of other teams.

- Extensive frontend experience : Demonstrated experience as a Frontend Engineer, using JavaScript or TypeScript as your main stack, with a strong portfolio of frontend deliveries.

- Strong web foundations : Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS, along with an understanding of HTTP/S, the Critical Rendering Path, CORS, caching, and CDNs.

- Modern frontend expertise : Familiarity with libraries and frameworks such as ReactJS, NextJS, Redux, CSS Modules, Tailwind, and/or Rails.

- Product-focused collaboration : Proven experience in product companies, working closely with engineers and Product Managers as part of an autonomous, cross-functional team.

- Production ownership : Experience designing, implementing, deploying, monitoring, and managing applications with a focus on availability, latency, and consistency - you build it, you run it, you love it.

- Quality-minded engineering : An understanding of principles such as SOLID and DRY, with consideration for accessibility, security, SEO, performance, testing, observability, internationalisation, and typing when building features.

- Collaborate and grow with your team : You take initiative, welcome new challenges, help raise the level of your team, share knowledge across teams, and actively expand your skills and impact.

- Experiment, learn, and iterate : You validate ideas quickly, iterate based on insights, and are willing to discard what does not work - then build validated solutions for long-term scalability and maintainability.

Familiarity with NodeJS and experience running it in production is a plus. It will help you collaborate effectively across the stack and optimise frontend-backend interactions.

How We Work 

- Our Engineering teams are interdisciplinary, bringing together Backend, Frontend, iOS, and Android Engineers with QA, UX Design, Product Management, and Engineering leadership.

- Teams take ownership of their product area and work together to ship new features, learn new things, and pursue meaningful technical challenges.

- We use a test-and-learn approach, combining experimentation and data with a focus on maintainability and long-term quality.

- We value passionate engineers who have a strong eye for detail, take initiative, support their colleagues, and enjoy working in a diverse and dynamic environment.

Where You'll Be 

This is a Hybrid role based in Amsterdam. You will work from our Amsterdam HQ a minimum of 2 days per week. 
At this time, we are only considering candidates who are already based in the Netherlands . As a result, relocation support is not available for this position . We can, however, provide visa transfer from current Dutch employer .

In Return 

You’ll be part of an enthusiastic, highly motivated team of 800+ Catawikians . 

- A competitive Annual Gross Base Salary depending on your level, competencies, and overall experience.

- A Work From Home Allowance to help with your monthly household bills.

- Commuting between your home and our office is covered by Catawiki.

- Amazing Office right in the centre of Amsterdam.

Why You'll Love Working with Us 

- Create a visible impact by working at scale in a global organisation serving millions of customers across 80+ categories. In our flat structure, every role has a broad scope and directly impacts both our customers and the business.

- Learn and grow through our Learning & Development initiatives, including clear development plans and mentorship programmes to support your career progression.

- A culture of connection defines us . We’re a passionate, diverse team of 800+ Catawikians representing 60+ nationalities. We foster an inclusive and queer-friendly environment where everyone is encouraged to bring their full self to work.

- Celebrate life’s moments with us. You’ll receive a €100 Catavoucher when you join, a €50 Catavoucher on your birthday, and an extra day off each year to “Pursue Your Passion ” . We also offer additional leave for key work anniversaries and important life events. Benefits may vary by location.

Our Offices and Way of Working 

Our vibrant offices in Amsterdam and Lisbon are designed to inspire collaboration. Most Catawikians operate in a hybrid setup, combining office-based and remote work, with a minimum of two days per week in the office, unless a role is explicitly stated as fully remote or fully office-based.

Interested? 

Apply with an English CV and Cover Letter. By applying, you agree to Catawiki’s Applicant Privacy Policy. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support the review of your application. AI may help us assess how your experience matches the requirements of the role, but hiring decisions are always made by our recruitment team

title: Tech Lead Manager, Mid Market & Celebrity - LATAM
description:
Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 100,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.

The Opportunity 

We don't just use AI. We build with it, ship with it, and think with it. With a generous budget for tokens, our engineers use AI agents to write, review, and ship production code every day. We are building toward a world where humans design systems and AI builds them, and we are already far along that path.

We are hiring a hands-on Tech Lead Manager to lead our Mid Market & Celebrity (MMC) team. This team works side by side with our celebrity and mid market customers and the MMC sales org to build the features and customizations that help those customers grow on the platform. You will be the technical voice in the room from the first conversation. The team vets customization use cases on inbound leads before deals close, builds the agreed functionality after close, and turns the best of that work into capabilities every Luxury Presence customer can use.

This role pairs technical leadership with solution engineering. You will work directly with customers and sales to shape what we build, then lead the team that builds it.

What You'll Do 

Be the technical partner to MMC sales and customers. Join conversations with prospects, customers, and vendors. Vet customization use cases quickly and explain what is possible, what it takes, and what the tradeoffs are, so deals move forward with confidence.

Practice solution engineering. Turn ambiguous customer needs into clear, scoped, supportable solutions. Translate between customers, sales, product, and engineering, and keep every party aligned.

Build and deliver after close. Plan and schedule the work, and deliver customer functionality with high quality.

Turn one-off builds into platform capabilities. Spot the solutions worth generalizing and graduate them into reusable capabilities for all customers, not only MMC.

Lead and grow the MMC team. Manage 2-4 direct reports. Own coaching, 1:1s, direct feedback, and career development. Treat management as a craft.

Deliver the MMC charter. Partner with product and design to deliver the engineering commitments in the current MMC charter.

Own system health. Be accountable for DORA metrics and the health of all MMC-related services.

Stay hands-on. Contribute through code and design reviews, architecture, and thorny debugging, and go deep with architecture leads on the path to mature solutions.

What We're Looking For 

Attributes 

- You lead from the front. You are close to the code, technically respected, and you grow engineers through clear feedback.

- You communicate clearly and directly. You explain complex tradeoffs to customers, vendors, sales, and executives, and you build trust quickly with external parties.

- You think like a solution engineer. You can listen to a customer, find the real need, and shape a solution that is realistic to build and support.

- You build with AI daily and expect your team to do the same.

- You hold strong opinions, loosely. You have a view on how AI changes architecture, team structure, and engineering culture.

- You think in systems and connect technical decisions to customer outcomes and business value.

- You are energized by ambiguity and speed. Ownership here is real.

- You like to have fun at work. We take our craft seriously, but not ourselves.

Skills and Experience 

- 8+ years of professional software engineering experience with meaningful senior or staff-level time, plus 2+ years managing engineering teams.

- Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as solution engineering, scoping, or vetting customer requirements before a sale.

- Track record of turning custom or one-off work into reusable platform capabilities.

- Deep expertise in TypeScript, Node.js, and React, with the full-stack fluency to reason about the request path from UI to data.

- Experience designing and operating scalable microservice architectures in cloud-native environments (AWS preferred).

- Strong understanding of GraphQL, event-driven systems (Kafka), and PostgreSQL.

- Experience operating production systems with SLOs and incident response, and familiarity with DORA metrics.

- Experience leading high-impact initiatives from concept through production in a SaaS environment.

Tech Stack 

- Frontend: React, Tailwind, Apollo

- Backend: Node.js / TypeScript microservices

- Data: PostgreSQL

- Infrastructure: AWS, Kubernetes, Lambda

- Messaging: Kafka, Redis

Compensation

Additional Information

Join us in shaping the future of real estate 

The real estate industry is in the midst of a seismic shift, and the future belongs to those who break new ground. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the proptech and marketing sectors, Luxury Presence challenges the status quo of what technology can do for real estate agents, leaders, and brokerages.

We're a team of agile and tenacious innovators working collaboratively to drive the industry forward. Together, we build game-changing products that empower modern real estate entrepreneurs to dominate their markets. From award-winning web design to agile SEO solutions to cutting-edge AI tools, we deliver tech that anticipates market shifts and keeps our clients ahead of their competition.

Founded in 2016 by Stanford Business School alum Malte Kramer, Luxury Presence has grown to a global team ranked on the Inc. 5000 fastest-growing companies list three years in a row. We're backed by world-class investors, including Bessemer Venture Partners, NextEquity Partners, Toba Capital, and Switch Ventures, and have raised $89 million to date.

More than 20,000 real estate businesses rely on our platform, including 30% of the Wall Street Journal RealTrends top agents and teams. Additionally, many of the industry's most powerful brokerages rely on Luxury Presence as a trusted business partner.

Luxury Presence has earned a spot on BuiltIn’s Best Places to Work list every year since 2020. Our founder and CEO was named a 2024 HousingWire Tech Trendsetter, and we’ve won multiple Tech100 Awards. Inman has also honored us twice: with the 2025 Innovation Award for Best AI-Powered Platform and the 2026 title of Best Proptech Company.

Luxury Presence is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.

title: IT Systems Automation Engineer (f/m/x)
description:
bonial helps you save time, money and paper! 

We are a digital advertising partner for offline businesses - we support retailers in their marketing activities and help them find a new audience. Would you like to join and be a part of digitalisation of retail? 

bonial is part of Axel Springer SE and is disrupting the retail landscape as the leading "Drive to Store" partner in Germany and France. Through our platforms " kaufDA " and " MeinProspekt " in Germany, and “ Bonial ” in France, we connect millions of users with their favorite shops and brands—driving real impact every single day.
We are in the midst of an exciting growth phase, scaling fast and transforming the way people discover retail. At bonial, we thrive in a high-performance, fast-paced environment fueled by motivated, results-driven individuals who are passionate about making a difference. If you’re looking to be part of a dynamic team that’s shaping the future of retail, we’d love to meet you. 

bonial welcomes both full- and part-timers! 

About The Role 

IT Operations keeps the company's core productivity, identity, and device ecosystem running smoothly and securely. As IT Systems Automation Engineer, you will own the design, implementation, and maintenance of automation across our corporate IT platforms (including M365, Google Workspace, JAMF, Microsoft Intune, Atlassian & Slack). You'll reduce manual work for the team, improve consistency and security across the employee lifecycle. You’ll help build the scripts, integrations, and workflows that let a 6-person team support the whole organization efficiently. This is a hands-on engineering role within IT Operations, not a helpdesk position - you'll spend most of your time building and improving systems rather than handling day-to-day tickets. 

What You’ll Do 

- Automate the employee lifecycle: Design and maintain automated workflows for onboarding, offboarding, and role changes across M365, Google Workspace, JAMF, Intune, and Slack (provisioning/deprovisioning accounts, licenses, group memberships, and device enrollment) 

- Device management: Build and maintain JAMF (macOS/iOS) and Intune (Windows/mobile) configuration profiles, compliance policies, and automated patch/update workflows. 

- Identity & access automation: Automate group and license assignment, conditional access rules, and access reviews across M365 and Google Workspace, working closely with the security team where relevant. 

- Collaboration tooling: Manage and automate Slack workspace administration - channel provisioning, app/integration approvals, user lifecycle, and usage policies. 

- Scripting & integration: Write and maintain scripts (PowerShell, Google Apps Script, or similar) and use APIs to connect systems that don't natively integrate. 

- Documentation & runbooks: Document automation logic, workflows, and recovery procedures so the rest of the team can support and extend what you build. 

- Monitoring & reliability: Set up monitoring/alerting for automated workflows so failures (e.g., a broken onboarding script) are caught and resolved quickly. 

- Continuous improvement: Identify manual, repetitive IT Operations tasks and propose/build automation to eliminate them. 

- Vendor & tooling evaluation: Assess new automation tools or platform features (e.g., new Intune or JAMF capabilities) and recommend adoption where it adds value. 

- Agentic support: Design, build, and operate AI agents that resolve common IT support requests end-to-end (e.g., password resets, access and software requests, device troubleshooting) via Slack or the service desk, connecting them to M365, Google Workspace, JAMF, and Intune through APIs, with clear guardrails, approval steps, human escalation paths, and audit logging. 

- AI enablement: Roll out and administer AI tools across the organization (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, Claude AI/Code, or similar), including license assignment, data access and governance settings, and usage policies, working closely with security, legal, and the works council where relevant, and support employees with onboarding guides, training materials, and best practices. 

What We’re Looking For 

- Required: 

• Experience in IT Operations, Systems Administration, or a similar role with hands-on scripting/automation responsibility. 

• Practical experience administering at least two of: Microsoft 365 (Entra ID/Exchange/SharePoint admin), Google Workspace, JAMF, Microsoft Intune. 

• Working proficiency in at least one scripting/automation language (PowerShell, Python, Bash, or Google Apps Script) and comfort using REST APIs. 

• Understanding of core identity and device management concepts: SSO, MDM/UEM, conditional access, device compliance. 

• Ability to document processes clearly for a small team that needs to maintain what you build. 

- Nice to Have:

title: Full-Stack Engineer (Backend Leaning) - Creative Agents
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- 
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- 
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- 
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

- 
High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- 
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- 
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

- 
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- 
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

- 
Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- 
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- 
Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- 
Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- 
Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- 
Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We are looking for a backend-leaning full-stack engineer to help build the next generation of Creative Agents at ElevenLabs.

Our ambition is to make agents a primary way people create across ElevenCreative. We are building systems that turn ideas into high-quality audio, image and video, bringing models and creative tools together without requiring users to become prompting experts.

The creative agent is already live. You will join a small team shaping its capabilities and architecture, with ownership from backend systems and agent infrastructure through to the customer-facing experience. You will help discover what works, turn experiments into reliable features, and use real customer feedback to guide what we build next.

Your responsibilities will include: 

- 
Building production agents and expanding their capabilities through prompts, tool use, orchestration, new models and MCP integrations.

- 
Designing and operating reliable backend systems for asynchronous creative generation and long-running tasks, with strong performance, observability, scalability and security.

- 
Developing shared evaluations and live quality monitoring, including model-based assessment of image and video outputs.

- 
Owning features end to end, from identifying user needs and prototyping to shipping across the stack and supporting them in production, alongside product, design and engineering.

You will help shape both what the agent can do and how people use it across ElevenCreative. The work combines substantial greenfield development with improving and operating a live product.

Requirements

We care about evidence of exceptional engineering: products you have shipped, difficult problems you have solved, and systems you have owned.

We are looking for:

- 
Strong backend engineering skills, experience operating production systems, and sound fundamentals in APIs, cloud infrastructure, storage and asynchronous processing.

- 
Hands-on experience developing agents, with an understanding of prompts, tools, execution logic, evaluations and the challenges of reliable, secure operation.

- 
Evidence of independent, end-to-end ownership and confidence working across the stack, including frontend delivery when needed.

- 
Good product judgement, clear communication and enthusiasm for creative agents.

We may also consider exceptional engineers with closely relevant experience. Familiarity with HTTP, WebSockets and asynchronous workers will help you build reliable communication between services and recover from failures.

Experience with multimodal generation, creative editors, MCP, or building products in a small, fast-moving team would be particularly valuable.

Location: 

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.

title: AI Resident UK/EMEA
description:
About Ema 

Ema builds AI Employees for HR, IT and Finance. Our AI Employees take on the busy work across the employee experience, from recruiting, onboarding and benefits to IT support, invoice processing and payroll, so people can spend their time on work that needs them. Founded by former executives from Google, Coinbase, Flipkart, and Okta, our team includes engineers from premier tech companies and graduates of Stanford, MIT, UC Berkeley, CMU, and IITs.

We are backed by industry leading investors including Accel, Naspers/Prosus, Creaegis, Section32, and angels like Sheryl Sandberg and Dustin Moskovitz. Headquartered in Silicon Valley and with offices in London, Bangalore and Vancouver, Ema is at the frontier of what Agentic AI can do in production. We ship real systems that run real business processes at scale.

The residency 

The AI Residency is a 6-month builder role, not a research placement. Every engineer at Ema owns delivery end to end — from understanding the customer's problem to shipping, measuring and supporting it in production — and residents are held to the same bar. You won't be parked on one project: you'll contribute across several avenues, all toward one goal — creating real value and impact for our enterprise customers.

- Real production work. You work in the production codebase, on real customer problems and real production data. Recent residents have shipped agent harnesses, eval infrastructure, inference-cost reductions, PII redaction, automated QA pipelines and backend service hardening used by enterprise customers.

- End-to-end ownership. You take work from a problem statement to a shipped, measured result — design, build, test, launch, and the follow-through until it's reliable.

- Mentorship. A senior mentor, weekly 1:1s, regular reviews with your team, and exposure to the founders and engineering leadership.

- A path to full-time. Top-performing residents are offered full-time roles at Ema. Several of our engineers started as residents.

Choose your specialist track 

Whichever track you choose, you own delivery end to end. The track decides where you go deepest.

- Backend. Go and Python services, APIs and data models for multi-tenant SaaS. Integrations that let agents take real actions in SAP, ServiceNow, Workday, Teams and Slack.

- AI/ML. Agents, harnesses and context engineering; evals and LLM judges calibrated against human labels; retrieval and memory; post-training (SFT, preference optimisation, RL) and distilling frontier behaviour into cheaper models.

- Systems & Infra. Kubernetes and cloud (Azure, GCP), regional deployments and data residency, model serving, observability, CI/CD and reliability at enterprise scale.

Where you'll contribute 

Over the residency you'll work across several of these avenues, not just one:

- Customer deployments. Build and ship AI Employees for UK and European enterprises, working with the people whose problem it is.

- Platform and product. Turn patterns from the field into Ema's core product: new connectors, agent primitives, APIs and tooling.

- Quality and evaluation. Make agents measurably better: benchmarks from real workflows, failure mining, and the loop where production traces become training and eval data.

- Reliability and cost. Latency, uptime, inference cost and observability. Quality per pound is a metric we track.

- Trust and compliance. PII detection and redaction, data residency, and audit-ready evidence for customers under UK GDPR and the EU AI Act.

What we're looking for 

- A builder's mindset and high agency. You find a way to ship rather than waiting for the blocker to clear, and you follow your work into production.

- Final-year undergraduates, MSc/MEng and PhD students, recent graduates and self-taught builders are all welcome. What matters is what you've built.

- Strong engineering fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, and clean code in Python, Go or a similar language. You're comfortable in a large production codebase.

- Real depth in your chosen track. Backend: services, APIs and data modelling. AI/ML: ML fundamentals, PyTorch, LLM systems or evals. Systems & Infra: Linux, containers, cloud and networking. One area you can teach us beats five you've touched.

- Honest measurement as a habit. You define what "done" and "better" mean before you build, and you'd rather kill your own feature with a clean experiment than ship it on a hunch.

- Clear communication. You can explain your work to engineers, customers and leadership, in writing and in person.

Show us what you've built 

The best way to capture our attention is to point us to something you've built. Include a link — a GitHub repo, a live URL, a demo, or a write-up — with your application.

Logistics 

- Location: Hybrid, from our London office.

- Term: 6 months, flexible start.

- Stipend: £ 2,500 - £ 3,000 / month.

- Right to work: You must have the right to work in the UK for the length of the residency.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.

Ema Unlimited is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or genetics.

title: Manager, Software Engineering, Operations
description:
Want to lead engineers building software that helps pros get the job done and know exactly how their business is doing? 

Then Jobber might be the place for you! We’re looking for a Manager, Software Engineering to be part of our SP (Service Provider) Operations group, focused on helping Service Providers run their day-to-day operations efficiently and effectively.

Jobber exists to help people in small businesses be successful. We work with small home service businesses, like your local plumbers, painters, and landscapers, to transform the way service is delivered through technology. With Jobber they can quote, schedule, invoice, and collect payments from their customers, while providing an easy and professional customer experience. Running a small business today isn’t like it used to be—the way we consume and deliver service is changing rapidly, technology is evolving, and customers expect more. That’s why we put the power and flexibility in their hands to run their businesses how, where, and when they want!

Our culture of transparency, inclusivity, collaboration, and innovation has been recognized by Great Place to Work, Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, and more. Jobber has also been named on the Globe and Mail’s Canada’s Top Growing Companies list, and Deloitte Canada’s Technology Fast 50™, Enterprise Fast 15, and Technology Fast 500™ lists. With an Executive team that has over thirty years of industry experience of leading the way, we’ve come a long way from our first customer in 2011—but we’ve just scratched the surface of what we want to accomplish for our customers .

We help employees grow professionally; we have a ton of onboarding resources, tutorials, hackathons and buddies to support learnings and provide opportunities to innovate. We have a range of experience levels on teams which allows for mentor/mentee opportunities. Leaders at Jobber work with empathy and support employees to build healthy work-life harmony. Bring your dedication and passion to this job to fulfill your goals.

The team: 

In this role, you will manage the engineering teams behind one of Jobber's most important domains, Jobs Teams, as part of the greater SP Operations Group. The Jobs Team is at the heart of how service businesses operate, and we are constantly improving how service providers orchestrate work from start to finish so they can confidently deliver every job with quality. You will work alongside peers from Product Management, Design, and the rest of the Engineering Leadership team to ensure the tools we build help small businesses run more efficiently and grow with confidence!

The role: 

As a leader within the SP Operations group, you will manage the engineering teams to deliver high quality, on time while they get to grow and learn along the way. The SP Operations group's mission is to help Service Providers run their businesses as efficiently as possible. We build the tools that help with day-to-day operations, from scheduling and managing work and crew to ensure every job gets done, to giving business owners the visibility they need to understand their business health and make informed decisions.

Reporting to a Senior Manager of Software Engineering, the Manager of Software Engineering will lead and support their team members in developing their skills and advancing their careers—all while contributing to our mission of empowering small businesses. You'll also play a key role in shaping the technical direction of our platform, ensuring it remains reliable and high-performing as we scale Jobber.

The Manager, Software Engineering will: 

- 
Live and breathe performance facilitation. You want to work with your team(s) to help them master their individual crafts, while also collaborating to build extraordinary experiences and systems.

- 
Be committed to the success of your people. You will help them set goals, have regular 1-on-1s, and provide constructive feedback and coaching to ensure your team's success. You’ll work to understand employees’ career direction and work to empower their journey by acting as a mentor and coach.

- 
Develop a world-class team alongside a world-class organization. You’ll participate in recruiting events and the hiring process while also working to level up your internal team while implementing new processes, all to develop a world-class engineering department.

- 
Remove roadblocks and build guardrails. You’ll work with the other leaders to create and maintain an environment where people can rapidly produce top-quality work that ultimately helps our customers be successful.

- 
Collaborate with other stakeholders across the business. Whether it’s our Management teams within Product, or our Business Technology teams, you’re working closely with other Jobberinos to find the best solutions in Jobber for small businesses.

To be successful, you should have: 

- 
A track record of success in being an established software engineer, as well as time spent in a leadership position, guiding a team in the delivery of quality software.

- 
Strong full-stack technical background, including design and architectural experience. 

- 
A drive to succeed and deliver impactful projects on time. For a high performing team with a solid roadmap that might look like getting out of their way, but for a team whose delivery is in doubt, it means getting in and getting dirty, and working with the team to find a path back to success.

- 
The ability to be agile in an agile environment. You’ll need to be able to lead and teach your team to adapt to change, while also thinking critically and creatively to find answers to problems.

- 
Effective written and oral communication. Being transparent with your team and establishing an open dialogue will be a key to success in supporting your coaching conversations and discussions.

- 
To be a leader and mentor. You’ll bring your shared experience into conversations to influence and provide constructive feedback to direct reports throughout the journey to ensure goals are being met and exceeded.

- 
Familiarity or comfort in AI tools and AI augmented development rhythms.

Highly desired, but not a dealbreaker: 

- 
Previous experience with our development stack: ReactJS, Typescript, Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, and GraphQL.

- 
Previous experience with building zero to one projects from initial discovery and design, through implementation, and into delivery and measurement.

Location: 

We believe great collaboration is intentional, and sometimes that means coming together in person to build, brainstorm, and connect. To support this, the role is open to candidates based in one of our hub cities: Edmonton, Toronto, Vancouver, or Kitchener-Waterloo.

Compensation: 

At Jobber, we also believe that compensation should be transparent, fair, and supportive of your experience and growth. This role has a minimum annual salary of $169,200 CAD, a midpoint of $199,100 CAD , and a maximum salary of $228,900 CAD, designed to reflect the progression from learning the ropes to truly excelling.

We design our compensation to reflect each new hire's skills, experience, and the complexity of the role, ensuring a fair and competitive salary. Our range is intentionally broad to support growth and long-term impact, with fully established hires typically starting around the midpoint. The higher end of the range is reserved for those who have demonstrated deep expertise and lasting contributions, while offers below the midpoint reflect strong potential with room to develop. This approach ensures that compensation aligns with both an individual's current capabilities and their opportunity for future growth.

Base salary is just one part of a total compensation package that will include equity rewards, annual stipends for health and wellness, retirement savings matching, and an extended health package with fully paid premiums for body and mind. Your professional growth matters to us too! You'll have access to a dedicated talent development program that includes career coaching and opportunities for career development.

We believe in transparency and open conversations about compensation. If you have any questions about our approach, we're happy to discuss them throughout the hiring process!

What you can expect from Jobber: 

- 
A total compensation package that includes an extended health benefits package with fully paid premiums for both body and mind, matching in RRSP, TFSA or FHSA, and stock options.

- 
A dedicated Talent Development team and access to coaching, learning, and leadership programs to help you grow your career, reach your goals, and unlock your full potential.

- 
A unique opportunity to build, grow, and leave your impact on a $400-billion industry that has no dominant player...yet.

- 
To work with a group of people who are humble, supportive, and give a sh*t about our customers.

We believe that diverse teams perform better and that fostering an inclusive work environment is a key part of growing a successful team. We welcome people of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to working with applicants requesting accommodation at any stage of the hiring process. 

A bit more about us: 

Job by job, we’re transforming the way service is delivered. Your lawn care provider, home cleaning service, plumber or painter could use Jobber to better connect with their customers, save time in the office, invoice faster, and get paid! We’re bringing tens of thousands of people together with technology to deliver billions of dollars a year in services to happy customers. Jobber exists to help make these small businesses successful, and when they’re successful we all win!

title: Research Data Scientist
description:
🪐 Discover our galaxy 

Join the Future of Work ! Malt is Europe's leading freelance marketplace, connecting over 1,000,000 talented freelancers with 100,000+ companies. Founded in 2013, we're transforming how work gets done through our tech-powered, human-centered platform. What makes us different: 

- A diverse team of 600 Malters across 6 European countries 

- A culture that champions equality (50% of our Comex are women) and inclusive growth 

- Backed by top investors including ISAI, Serena Capital, Eurazeo Growth, Goldman Sachs, and BPI 

- A mission to give everyone the freedom to work differently 

Ready to help shape the future of work? Your next chapter starts here! 🪐 

Explore your future career 🔭 

We are looking for a Research Data Scientist to take ownership of Marketplace Economics and Public Thought Leadership within our specialized Research team, reporting directly to Marc Palyart (Director of ML).

Working alongside two Machine Learning Researchers, you will be Malt's go to expert in applied economics and causal inference. You will combine rigorous econometric methods with a pragmatic, product and business oriented mind modeling two-sided marketplace dynamics (liquidity, fee elasticity, supply-demand balance, search frictions) to directly improve product conversion.

Some of the questions you might explore :

- How is the freelancing market evolving in time ? What drives supply and demand in freelance markets, and how do workers and companies respond to changing economic conditions?

- What makes a market place efficient and what are the frictions that prevent beneficial matches ? How to solve these frictions ? 

- How do prices, platform fees, and supply and demand elasticities shape marketplace dynamics and participants' behavior?

Key responsibilities ✨ 

- 
Marketplace Economics : Investigate the economic mechanisms driving marketplace dynamics, supply-demand imbalances, liquidity, pricing elasticity, and matching efficiency.

- 
Applied Causal Inference & Experimentation: Formulate falsifiable economic hypotheses, design quasi-experimental and experimental setups (Diff-in-Diff, Instrumental Variables, Fixed Effects), and isolate true causal mechanisms within complex, multi-sided platform interactions.

- 
External Research & Flagship Thought Leadership: Co-author Malt’s research publications as well as macroeconomic barometers in close partnership with Marketing, translating raw platform telemetry into compelling public narratives for industry leaders and tier-1 media.

- 
Cross-Functional Strategic Partnership: Collaborate closely with Product, ML, Marketing, and C-Suite stakeholders to identify high-impact research questions, challenge assumptions, and uncover underlying economic mechanisms. 

- 
Hands-On Data Engineering & Modeling: Write clean SQL on BigQuery and engineer robust, reproducible analytical pipelines in Python, leveraging modern AI-assisted tools to maximize research velocity.

About you 🧑‍🚀 

- 
Academic Foundation: PhD (or Master's degree with equivalent proven empirical research track record) in Economics, Econometrics, Quantitative Social Sciences, or a related empirical discipline. Strong Quantitative and Research Background

- 
Empirical Econometrics & Modeling: Proven expertise in microeconomic modeling, causal inference, and empirical identification strategies (e.g., panel data, Instrumental Variables, Diff-in-Diff, selection models).

- 
Applied Research Mindset: You combine scientific rigor with a pragmatic approach to solving real-world economic problems. You know how to adapt your methods and the depth of your analyses to the question at hand.

- 
Hands-On Programming: Advanced proficiency in Python (Pandas, NumPy, Statsmodels, SciPy) and high-level SQL on modern cloud data warehouses (e.g., Google BigQuery, Snowflake).

- 
Stakeholder Fluency: Exceptional ability to scope ambiguous problems, communicate complex econometric findings to non-technical leaders, and constructively challenge stakeholder assumptions.

- 
Full professional proficiency in English. 

If you're excited about using unique marketplace data to explore meaningful economic questions, shape real-world decisions, and contribute to a deeper understanding of the future of work, we'd love to hear from you!

How to join the mission? 🚀 

- 
First call with Luke our Tech Talent Acquisition Manager, to better understand your background, aspirations and explore a few technical topics (45 mins)

- 
Interview with Marc (Director of ML), your future manager, to discuss your experience, the role in more detail and ask you a few technical questions (60 mins).

- 
Research discussion with your future colleagues to walk through two pieces of work: a research project of your choice, and one proposed by us. (90 mins)

- 
Take-home coding test (2 hours or optional if you have enough open source projects online)

- 
Final interview (45mins) with Claire (CTO)

Malt is the perfect space to thrive personally and professionally 💫 

- Onboarding: Before easing into your new role, you’ll spend your first week learning about our culture, products, and services with other new joiners at our office in Paris

- Equity: Every Malter is entitled to stock options 

- Malt sabbatical: Every three years, all Malters are entitled to a one month fully paid sabbatical leave

- Free books: If you’re interested in learning more about any topic relevant to Malt’s business, just tell us the books you’d like to read, and we’ll order them for you—without any questions asked or approval processes to follow

- Team building events organized every year

Ready? Get your ticket to Malt 🪐 

At Malt, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We recruit based on skills, experience, and potential, without any form of discrimination related to age, gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, or disability. title: Staff Software Engineer (Interfaces)
description:
About the Team 

As a Staff Software Engineer at Netlify, you'll join a collaborative team that values continuous learning, mutual support, and shared growth. Together, we create tools that help developers build faster, more intuitively, and with greater impact. Our Experience team owns the core product experience at Netlify, which is every way a human or an agent interacts with the platform, from our React-based web application to CLI, MCP, SDK, and API. If users interact with it directly, it's likely ours. We're reimagining how developers experience web development by thoughtfully integrating AI into our workflows - not as a novelty, but as a practical tool that enhances how we build the web.

With our team, you'll help set technical direction for our product area, mentor a highly senior team of engineers, and shape user experiences that serve millions of developers. You'll work closely with Product, Design, and engineering leadership, and partner with teams across the organization to build, iterate, and scale meaningful solutions. You'll have the autonomy to guide what we build and how, and the influence to bring others along with you, all while staying hands-on in the codebase.

We're looking for thoughtful engineers who enjoy owning problems end to end, collaborating across disciplines, and solving complex technical challenges for products that millions of developers rely on every day. AI is a foundational part of how we build, so we value engineers who are excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI-assisted workflows while continuing to apply strong engineering fundamentals. We believe the best engineering happens when talented people are trusted to solve difficult problems together, share what they're learning, and create space for different perspectives to shape better solutions.Â With our team, you'll have real ownership from day one - not a tiny slice of a massive codebase. Engineers here are trusted to make decisions, shape technical direction, and move quickly while collaborating closely with Product and Design.

What You'll Do 

- Use your deep expertise in full-stack development (TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, and React) to ship reliable, scalable, performant code across our product suite, and set the patterns that others on the team and across the org follow.Â 

- Own the technical direction for our product area, including the web app, CLI, MCP, SDK, API, and docs, by defining architecture and roadmap alongside your manager, Product, and Design, and make tradeoffs explicit so decisions are easy to understand and revisit

- Lead large, ambiguous projects that span multiple teams from conception to delivery, such as our application rewrite and upcoming CLI rework, writing RFCs, driving alignment, and managing risk and timelines

- Design and evolve user-facing features and product APIs for both humans and agents, recognizing that the best interface isnât always a React application. Build them to scale to millions of developers worldwide, with a clear view of reliability, performance, and long-term maintainability.

- Make thoughtful product and interface decisions on your own with the overall customer experience top of mind

- Set the bar for engineering practices - testing, documentation, observability, and performance optimization - and lead how the team pragmatically uses AI tools, sharing what works and what doesn't

- Turn ambiguity into clear plans, guiding both early-stage prototypes and production-ready applications that directly impact user experience and business metrics

- Mentor and grow engineers through code reviews, design reviews, pairing, and sponsorship, raising the technical level of the whole team

- Practice proactive async communication and create visibility across projects by documenting your workflows and decision-making clearly

- Participate in on-call rotations, lead incident follow-up, and drive continuous improvement efforts that reduce technical debt and prevent recurring problems

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams and engineering leadership to shape user flows that enhance the developer experience across our platform, and contribute to hiring and team growth

What You'll Bring 

- Deep expertise in TypeScript and JavaScript, with a long track record of designing, shipping, and maintaining production-quality software in modern full-stack environments

- A history of building interfaces developers use directly, such as web apps, CLIs, APIs, SDKs, or other dev tools, and a strong sense of what works well for developers (and, by extension, agents)

- Passion for building strong user-facing experiences, including working with React and modern frontend architecture and making architectural decisions that hold up as products and teams grow, paired with the backend knowledge to design software well beyond the UI

- Strong product and design instincts. This isnât about visual polish - itâs about making thoughtful decisions about how users interact with a product.

- Strong proficiency with Go and/or Ruby for backend services and API development, with a thoughtful approach to reliability and performance

- Hands-on experience with React and modern frontend architecture, including making architectural decisions that hold up as products and teams grow

- Demonstrated ability to raise the technical bar: providing direction to senior and staff-level engineers, distributing ownership, mentoring, shaping standards, and influencing decisions beyond your own team

- Extensive experience delivering features and services that serve large user bases, including designing for scale and operating systems in production

- A track record of leading technically complex, cross-team projects from ambiguous problem to shipped outcome, including writing RFCs and building consensus

- Demonstrated ability to raise the technical bar: mentoring senior and mid-level engineers, shaping standards, and influencing decisions beyond your own team

- Experience writing high-quality, testable code that's reliable and maintainable over time, and setting that expectation for others

- Proficiency using and experimenting with AI-assisted development tools, with sound judgment about when and how to apply them and the ability to help others do the same

- Experience contributing to open-source projects or working in public codebases is a plus

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, especially in asynchronous, remote-first environments, with the ability to explain tradeoffs to engineers, leadership, and non-technical partners

- Critical thinking abilities and a solution-oriented approach to complex technical challenges, with the judgment to prioritize and say no when needed

- A collaborative approach to problem-solving with curiosity about how your work supports teammates, users, and broader goals

- Growth mindset and openness to learning new tools, technologies, and best practices

- Passion for working in a collaborative environment with diverse teams across distributed locations

This Role is a Great Fit If 

- You're energized by building user-facing products and features that directly impact millions of developers' daily workflows

- You thrive in collaborative environments, working closely with your team and cross-functionally to turn ideas into reality

- You enjoy the autonomy and influence of staff-level work - setting technical direction, writing RFCs, and driving decisions across teams while staying connected to the people doing the work

- You find satisfaction in making other engineers better, whether through mentoring, design reviews, or setting a clear example

- You see ambiguity as a creative opportunity and can navigate uncertainty to build practical solutions and bring clarity to others

- You see AI as a multiplier for your skills, not a shortcut, and can articulate where it helps, where it doesn't, and how you use it

- You're excited by new tools, challenges, and opportunities to grow, even when they feel a little uncomfortable at first

- You want to work on a fully remote team that believes in autonomy, transparency, and building a better web, together

Applying 

Not sure you meet 100% of our qualifications? Please apply anyway! 

When applying please include:Â 

A resume or short listing of your job history & skills (link to a LinkedIn profile would be fine). We appreciate a cover letter explaining why you would enjoy working in this role at Netlify to get to know you a bit better, though this is not required and will not impact your application. Our mission is to âbuild a better webâ and that cannot be done without a diversity of skill sets, backgrounds and thoughts.Â 

Of everything we've ever built at Netlify, we are most proud of our team. Netlify is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are devoted to building a team of people with diverse backgrounds and lifestyles. Driving equality empowers our team, enables us to innovate, and helps us maintain a more inclusive environment. We donât discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, race, military/veteran status, citizenship, pregnancy status, or any other differences. If we can do anything to provide a better interview, i.e. accommodate a disability, then please let us know by emailing accommodations@netlify.com.Â 

About Netlify 

Netlify is a platform that lets you create, share, and run anything on the web: a website, an app, an agent experience, whatever you can dream up. Use your own tools or ours to build it, collaborate with your team, get it live, and keep it running. Anyone, from people just starting out to seasoned developers, can create pro-level web experiences that really work, really well.

We are a Series D company that has raised over $200M from investors such as Andreessen Horowitz, Kleiner Perkins, EQT, Bessemer, BOND, and Menlo Ventures. As a fully distributed company, we aim to create a company culture where the best idea can come from anywhere and strive to be thoughtful, compassionate, and collaborative in our work. If this sounds like something youâd like to be part of, weâre excited to connect with you!

At Netlify, we are committed to a compensation philosophy that prioritizes fairness and equity, positions our employee compensation competitively in the market, recognizes and rewards performance, and takes a comprehensive approach to our rewards package. We anchor our compensation philosophy on a market-based approach, therefore salary ranges may differ depending on the labor cost in a particular location. The salary provided is in addition to robust benefits and participation in Netlifyâs equity plan. Our hiring range for this role is targeted at $182,000 - $248,000 for most US-based locations, $175,000 - $235,000 CAD in most Canada-based locations, and Â£105,000 â Â£144,000 GBP for most UK-based locations.Â Candidates outside the US, Canada, UK, or in premium markets should consult with their Talent Acquisition partner regarding location-based ranges, as they may be higher or lower than the average US range listed. The starting pay will be determined based on multiple factors, including expertise and skills, market demands, experience, internal equity, and applicable geographic location. title: Junior Go Backend Developer (f/m/d)
description:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. adjoe Ads is our programmatic in-app advertising platform that seamlessly connects advertisers and publishers through direct integration of our Android and iOS SDKs. Every ad decision happens in under 200ms across 10 million daily users, powered by real-time bidding algorithms and user quality prediction models that match the right ad to the right user at the right moment.

Engine Behind 120M Processed Auctions Daily

The Ad Network team builds and operates the backend services that power adjoe Ads' programmatic advertising engine. The core challenge is straightforward to state and hard to solve: for every incoming ad request from a mobile SDK, decide within milliseconds whether it's a good fit for any active campaign — and at what price to bid.

To solve this, the team has built a Real-Time Bidding platform of 20+ Go microservices that orchestrate ad auctions at 1,500 bid requests per second , integrate with external demand partners via OpenRTB , and connect to ML models making 50 billion predictions daily across 600+ features to optimize bid pricing. The stack runs on Kubernetes , with Kafka handling event streaming, DynamoDB and Elasticache powering low-latency data access, and Prometheus and Grafana providing observability across the entire system.

Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For: 

- Golang Backend Foundation: You have a Computer Science degree (or related field) and hands-on experience writing Golang. You will use this foundation to contribute directly to our production backend services from day one at adjoe, rather than writing isolated or throwaway code.

- Proven Project Portfolio: We look for engineers with tangible projects to show, not just coursework. You will leverage the architectural lessons from your past builds—what worked, why you built it, and what you would change—to design and scale our live systems.

- Modern Infrastructure Stack: You are comfortable working with REST APIs, version control via Git, and CI/CD pipelines. You will use these core tools, along with your familiarity in cloud platforms like AWS, GCP, or Azure, to reliably deploy your code into our environments.

- Iterative Code Ownership: You will work alongside experienced engineers who will rigorously review your pull requests. We need someone who parses technical feedback directly and uses it to continuously refine their system design and coding standards.

🌎 We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team. 

What’s in It for You? 

At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day.

- Go Big. Own projects with impact on 770M users and push adtech boundaries.

- Move Fast. Ship solutions multiple times a day, learn from results, and keep momentum.

- Be Direct. Solve problems openly and collaborate across teams.

- Thrive Together. Grow with a diverse, global team of people from over 40 different countries that learn from each other.

- Have Fun. Celebrate wins, enjoy daily victories, and bring your energy.

We welcome applications from people who will contribute to the diversity of our company.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend (Identity International)

title: Senior Fullstack Developer
description:
As a full-stack developer you work hard on making Independer.nl better, faster and responsive. You don't do this alone, but always within one of our 9 (international) scrum teams. Our multidisciplinary teams consist of developers (front and back end), testers, designers and product owners. Together you tackle several major key projects and our ongoing migration to the cloud.

You can count on working with tools and techniques like C#, .NET 10, Angular 19 onwards, TypeScript (JavaScript), Nx and SASS. And after our migration to the cloud we're focusing on Azure, App Services en YAML pipelines. 

Specifically: 

- You want to make a valuable contribution to the website – you contribute from your expertise, plan and execute own tasks, respect the 'Definition of Ready' and the 'Definition of Done'. You understand stakeholder and customer requirements. 

- You want to grow your expertise – we help by providing an environment where you are allowed to make mistakes, a personal growth budget, lots of freedom and colleagues you can learn from. 

- You strive for predictability & stability – you deliver reliable, high quality software. You bring working software to production while improving the way we work. The deliverables are aligned with our product strategy and seen from a customer perspective. 

- In addition to being a team player, you also like autonomy – you want to grow in your area of expertise, but understand the challenges faced by other areas of expertise and how different areas of expertise can best work together. Furthermore, you are curious about the Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) aspects for your own area of expertise. 

- You are open to using AI tools in your daily work - and know how to apply them in a supportive and responsible way to improve efficiency, quality and collaboration, while always maintaining human ownership and final responsibility over the output. 

- You always go for an optimal customer experience (just like us) – and that with an impact of millions of visitors a year.

Why Independer?
Despite the fact that we belong in the list of the largest online platforms in the Netherlands (such as bol.com , coolblue and takeaway) Independer is still a relatively small club of around 250 specialists. This makes our culture flexible, open and lively. A flat hierarchy in which freedom and daring are central.

The technical environment that we offer is complex, challenging and constantly changing. We want the best (online) environment for both our customers and our colleagues. This means that the focus is on 'getting the latest and greatest tech'. We focus on .NET Core, Azure (DevOps) and Angular (19.0). And in case we missed anything, we look forward to your input!

The fact that we've been around for 25 years is thanks to our open, relaxed culture and our colleagues. True Independers think in terms of possibilities, dare to make mistakes and help each other. All that in an environment where you can play pool or darts in your breaks and where no one is surprised if you walk into our office in Hilversum in your shorts or flip-flops.

Some of your colleagues have been proud Independers for years and that is not without reason: Independer is constantly developing and you grow with us. That makes you the owner of your own career. 

We can officially call ourselves a Great Place to Work. We received this title from our colleagues and Great Place to Work Netherlands. What does that mean? Our colleagues call it a fine organizational culture where they want to work with pleasure, trust and pride. 

What we're looking for in a new colleague? 

- You're 5+ years active as a Fullstack Developer/ Software Engineer. 

- You have a good understanding of Internet technology and software development in general (C#, .NET, ASP.NET MVC, OOP, SQL etc.) 

- In terms of frontend, you bring experience and interest in Angular (modern), Javascript and Typescript. 

- You are a strong team player who enjoys collaborating, sharing knowledge and supporting colleagues. 

- You take initiative, you are stress resistant and accurate. 

- You are eager to get started, but always want to know the why. 

- Furthermore, we find it important that you can teach us something and can enthusiastically tell us about other projects you've done. 

- A big advantage would be if you have experience with: .NET CORE, Azure and StoryBook.

What do you get from us? 

- A salary between €5000 and €7200 gross per month (excluding vacation pay and annual bonus) 

- A premium free-of-contribution pensionplan, 30 vacation days, travel allowance and a home office and internet allowance. 

- Flexibility in working hours, and the possibility to work 50% from home (and even several weeks a year from abroad). 

- Lots of room to grow and develop - through our Independer-wide training offer or on an individual level. 

- Fun events, drinks and various (bi-)weekly sports activities. 

- An extensive, fresh and healthy lunch in our company bakery every day. 

- A nice office -with free parking- full of enthusiastic colleagues, at the edge of the Hilversum Mediapark.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Capacity and Quota Management)
description:
About Nebius: 

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role:

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the team building the Capacity and Quota Management control plane — the system that decides who gets compute, when, and how much.

Idle GPUs are waste. Overallocated ones are a contract you can't keep. Our platform consists of two core components: a capacity reservation engine managing guaranteed GPU reservations and their lifecycle, including rebalancing and auto-reclamation logic; and a Quotas Control Plane that manages quotas across all Nebius services, handles customer quota requests, and runs the algorithms that distribute resources. Both are exposed through APIs that give external customers, internal users, and downstream services visibility and control over their limits.
This is a high-ownership role. You will define how Capacity and Quota Management matures, from the technical foundations to the tradeoffs that outlast any single feature.

title: AI/ML Engineer - Production AI & LLM Systems (India)
description:

AI Engineer | India

Employment Type: Full-Time 
Experience Level: Mid-Level 
Compensation: ₹15,00,000 – ₹22,00,000 per year (15–22 LPA), commensurate with experience and technical expertise 

Position Overview 

The AI Engineer at Volga Partners will design, develop, and deploy advanced, production-ready AI solutions, including Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, agentic AI workflows, and intelligent automation technologies.

This role requires a strong combination of AI research, hands-on model training and optimization, and software engineering expertise, with the ability to translate innovative AI concepts into scalable, reliable, and practical business applications.

Working closely with software engineers, product teams, and leadership, the AI Engineer will lead the development and integration of high-performance AI solutions that solve complex business challenges, enhance operational efficiency, and deliver measurable value to our global clients.

Key Responsibilities 

AI System Development 

- Design, develop, and deploy AI systems, including LLMs, RAG, agentic workflows, and ML/DL solutions. 
- Select appropriate models and architectures while balancing accuracy, latency, cost, and complexity. 
- Train and fine-tune models using PyTorch or Keras, including data preparation and evaluation. 
- Implement and benchmark research methods before adoption. 
- Build APIs, inference pipelines, and backend integrations. 
Production & Optimization 

- Own evaluation of metrics and track quality, latency, and cost. 
- Monitor, debug, and optimize AI systems post-launch. 
- Ensure production readiness and identify regressions before they impact users. 
Collaboration

- Partner with software engineers and product teams to integrate AI into applications. 
- Contribute to technical discussions and technical decision-making. 
- Document architecture, implementation approaches, and key technical decisions. 
Research & Experimentation 

- Read and evaluate ML research papers. 
- Implement promising methods and reproducing results where applicable. 
- Adapt emerging techniques into production-ready systems. 
- Contribute to continued innovation across AI and engineering initiatives. 

Working Relationships 

The AI Engineer will collaborate with: 

- Engineering leadership and product teams. 
- Software engineers and backend developers. 
- Global AI research and development teams. 

Success in This Role 

Success means you can build with AI and deliver reliable production solutions, not simply experiment with AI models. 

You should be able to: 

- Deliver production-ready AI systems with measurable impact. 
- Translate research into practical engineering solutions. 
- Collaborate effectively across distributed teams. 
- Document and share technical knowledge for scalability. 
- Adapt to evolving technical and business priorities. 

Work Environment 

This is a fully remote position based in India. Candidates should be comfortable working independently and collaborating with globally distributed teams across different time zones. 

Required Work Schedule 

This AI Engineer role requires working Monday through Friday, 7:30 PM–4:30 AM or 8:30 PM–5:30 AM IST in India, depending on U.S. daylight saving time?

The ability to consistently work the assigned schedule is a required and non-negotiable condition of this role. Candidates must be comfortable working overnight hours and maintaining reliable availability throughout the assigned shift.

Due to project deadlines, production needs, client requirements, or other business priorities, occasional weekend availability or schedule adjustments may be required. Weekend work is not intended to be the standard schedule but flexibility to support business needs when necessary is expected

Our Hiring Process 

We value your time and aim to keep our recruitment process transparent, efficient, and engaging. 

1. Initial Recruiter Screening 

An introductory video call with a member of our Recruiting team to discuss your background, experience, career goals, salary expectations, and any initial questions you may have about the role or Volga Partners. 

2. Practical Skills Assessment 

Candidates who successfully complete the initial screening will receive a practical assessment to complete asynchronously. 

The assessment is designed to evaluate technical knowledge, problem-solving ability, and how you approach a real-world engineering scenario. 

3. Assessment Review 

Our team will review your submission against the technical requirements of the role. 

Candidates who meet the required criteria will advance to the final interview stage.

4. Technical / Coding Interview
Candidates who pass the assessment will meet with our Engineering team to further evaluate their technical skills, experience, and AI Engineering knowledge

5. Final Interview – CTO 

A deep-dive conversation with our Chief Technology Officer focused on technical alignment, your assessment approach, architectural thinking, problem-solving, and overall alignment with the role and team. 

Required Qualifications 

- 3+ years of hands-on AI/ML engineering experience, with at least one system deployed to production. 
- Strong NLP fundamentals, including tokenization, embeddings, classification, NER, and information extraction. 
- Strong engineering skills across coding, Git, testing, API/system design, and debugging. 
- Hands-on model training experience using PyTorch or Keras. 
- Understanding generative model architectures, including Transformers and VAEs. 
- Production experience with LLMs, including RAG, embeddings/vector databases, and prompt/evaluation design. 
- Experience with FastAPI or similar frameworks, Docker, and at least one cloud platform such as AWS, GCP, or Azure. 
- Ability to read ML research papers and translate ideas into working code. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Familiarity with agent frameworks such as LangGraph or LangChain. 
- Experience with Kubernetes, CI/CD, and model-serving infrastructure.

Compensation & Benefits

title: Langfuse - Product Designer
description:
Why Design at Langfuse

Your work will shape how engineers build with AI. 

Langfuse is often the primary interface engineers use to debug, evaluate, and improve their LLM applications. The designs you ship will be used for hours each day by thousands of developers and non-developers. They'll tell you about it in GitHub issues, on X, and in our community Slack channels. Everything we build is open source (MIT-licensed) and immediately visible.

The design challenges here are genuinely hard. You're designing for technical users and business users alike who care about information density, speed, and precision. Traces contain dozens of nested LLM calls with massive prompts and completions. Users need to set up evaluators, manage prompt versions, configure integrations, and build monitoring dashboards before they even start analyzing results. You need to make both the setup and the daily use feel intuitive and easy.

You will also have direct exposure to how cutting-edge LLM applications are built. Deeply understanding the problems our users solve will make you a better designer and along the way makes you an expert on LLM engineering yourself.

You will grow at Langfuse by

- Owning our product design end-to-end. You'll be the first dedicated designer at Langfuse. Today, our engineers design as they build, which has gotten us far, but we need someone who can elevate the entire experience. You'll own the design system, and visual language across the product. You'll set the standard for how Langfuse looks and feels.

- Making data-dense interfaces intuitive. Langfuse surfaces traces, scores, costs, latencies, token counts, prompt versions, and evaluation results. You'll figure out how to present complex, nested data in ways that help engineers find what they need fast.

- Simplifying complex workflows. Our users run evaluations across datasets, compare experiment results, manage prompt versions, and set up monitoring. You'll map these workflows, identify friction, and design flows that feel obvious in hindsight.

- Collaborating directly with product engineers. You'll pair with engineers, whiteboard solutions together, and ship designs that work within our existing component system (shadcn/ui, Tailwind). You'll create reusable, consistent UI patterns that the whole team can build with.

- Shipping design straight to code. You'll use AI coding tools to implement smaller design fixes, build components for the design system, and polish UI details yourself. We are not looking for a perfect engineer here but for someone who can help themselvesherself.

What we're looking for

- Experience in designing complex web applications, incl. a portfolio showcasing product work that users loved

- Take ownership of our UI/UX made for developers

- You want to talk to users

- Hard worker and thrive working in a small and accountable team

- Good understanding of best in class UI/UX

- Excited about open source software and dev tools

Bonus points: 

- You can ship frontend code (we use Next.js, Tailwind, shadcn/ui) 

- ML/AI experience or familiarity with the LLM tooling ecosystem 

- Former founder or early startup experience 

- Contributions to open source projects or design systems 

- Side projects that show craft and taste 

No candidate checks all boxes. If you feel you are a good fit for this role, please go ahead and apply.

Perks 

- Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

- Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

- Equity in the company - Every new eligible team member who joins our company receives equity.

- Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

- A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

- Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here . Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

Als Senior Data Engineer kom je in dienst bij LINKIT en ga je aan het werk bij toonaangevende opdrachtgevers in mobiliteit, energie en financiële dienstverlening. Als Senior Data Engineer maak je zo het verschil op zowel technisch als strategisch niveau.

Je werkt in de Data Engineering squad: een groep Explorers (zo noemen wij onze collega’s) die elkaar scherp houdt op vakmanschap en samen bouwt aan oplossingen voor complexe dataomgevingen. Kennis delen is de norm, niet de uitzondering. Om de twee weken kom je op vrijdag terug naar het hoofdkantoor in De Meern voor de clubdag, waarin we tijd investeren in leren, verbinden en vooruitkijken.

Lees hier meer over de Data Engineering squad.

- 5+ jaar ervaring in data engineering binnen complexe omgevingen.

- Ervaring met batch/streaming dataverwerking.

- Ervaring met CI/CD op cloudplatformen.

- 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om tijdelijk vanuit het buitenland te werken.

- Elektrische leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding.
