Sollicitatieprocedure 

We willen je leren kennen, en jij ons. Daarom houden we het persoonlijk en concreet.

- Kennismaking: Een eerste gesprek over wie je bent, wat je drijft en of er een match is.

- Verdiepende gesprekken: Twee gesprekken over je ervaring, werkwijze en hoe jij past binnen de squad en bij onze klanten.

- Aanbieding: Als het klikt, volgt een concreet aanbod.

Vragen vooraf? Neem contact op met Tabea Hensel via 

Over ons 

LINKIT is opgericht in 1998 en gegroeid van IT-bemiddelaar naar kennisgedreven IT-organisatie, met ruim 250 Explorers uit meer dan 25 nationaliteiten. We werken voor grote organisaties in overheid, finance en logistiek als partner die meedenkt van vraagstuk tot oplossing. Als Senior Data Engineer ga je aan het werk bij toonaangevende opdrachtgevers, met een contract bij LINKIT. Je bepaalt je eigen richting, met een ongelimiteerd opleidingsbudget en de ruimte om te groeien op een manier die bij jou past.

Rethink it with LINKIT.

Norm also powers Norm Law, LLP, an affiliated AI-native law firm whose attorneys advise leading institutions on complex corporate matters.

AI Fluency: 
Norm prefers all team members to be fluent in AI. Successful candidates actively use AI in their day-to-day work to support thinking, creation, and problem-solving. They use it to improve the quality and speed of their work and to continuously refine how work gets done end-to-end.

Candidates should be prepared to demonstrate and discuss their AI usage throughout the interview process, including concrete examples of tools, workflows, and outcomes. We look for practical, hands-on experience, not theoretical familiarity.

This Role 

We are hiring a hands-on Tech Lead for Norm Compliance, the team that owns Norm's compliance platform for asset managers: the product behind marketing and content review at some of the largest financial institutions in the US. You are an IC-style engineer who can also set an engineering roadmap and lead a team; you will lead up to seven engineers, own every technical decision inside the platform, and ship code yourself at least half of the week.

The platform has been shipping for years. You will ramp with the engineers who know it best, then set its direction.

How You'll Work 

The team is fully remote in the US and reports to the General Manager of Norm Compliance. You set the platform's technical direction, from architecture and standards to a roadmap you shape with the product manager and the General Manager. The team owns the platform end to end, including the infrastructure it runs on. Day to day you work with a product manager who owns the backlog and our commitments to clients, and with a client engagement/deployment strategy team that owns the relationships: you decide how the work gets done and how long it takes, they decide what we take on and when, and nothing reaches a client without both. The team runs its own on-call.

You Will 

- Own architecture, technical standards and code review for the platform, and contribute production code every week.

- Set the engineering roadmap for the platform with the product manager and the General Manager.

- Hire, onboard and grow a team of Staff and Senior engineers.

- Run on-call escalation.

- Answer clients' technical questions, in writing or through meetings, along the client engagement/deployment strategy team.

- Learn the platform with the engineers who run it today, ship with their review, then own it.

Skills & Experience - Core 

- Bachelor's or Master's in computer science or an equivalent field, or equivalent practical experience

- 8+ years building production software, including 3+ years leading a team of four to eight engineers while still shipping code

- Python and TypeScript in production; Postgres or similar; AWS

- Experience taking over a large codebase built by others and running it

- Experience setting and delivering a technical roadmap for a product with enterprise clients

- Experience on client calls, answering hard technical questions without over-promising

- Clear, brief writing

Skills & Experience - Pluses 

- Clients in financial services or another regulated industry

- Experience with LLM-backed products, Terraform, or a workflow engine such as Temporal

- Experience splitting a release pipeline or a shared repository, or hiring a team from zero

What Success Looks Like - 90 Days 

- You know the platform's architecture and its largest clients, and have shipped with code review from the team

- You own the platform's technical decisions and run on-call escalation

- The team has run an incident end to end, and you, the team and the product manager have a written way of working

Comp and Benefits 

$220,000 - $290,000 a year plus equity. 

The range displayed in this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salary for this position. Within the range, individual pay is determined by various factors, including job-related skills (as uncovered during the interview process), experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed here reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity or benefits. We offer a competitive salary along with equity compensation. Our comprehensive benefits package includes a 401(k) plan with an employer match. Employees enjoy top-tier insurance coverage, encompassing health, dental, hospital, accident, and vision plans. You'll thrive in our fast-paced learning environment where professional growth is constant.

This role is fully remote within the United States, with core hours on US Eastern time. You will start in our New York office at One World Trade Center. Norm employment, US residency and work performed from the US are conditions of the role; because our clients are financial institutions, offers are conditional on a background check, including E-Verify. Visa sponsorship or transfer is not available for this position.

If you're interested in the role but aren't sure whether you're a good fit, we'd still like to hear from you.

To learn more about Norm, visit our website .

title: Senior Data Scientist, Model Risk Management (R14365)
description:
Headquarters: Remote - India

Who We Are 

Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually. 

Location Note 

We’re excited to consider talent currently based in India, as well as candidates who are open to relocating to India for this opportunity. Please note that, as this is a "Remote–India" position, the role must be performed from within India. 

The Opportunity 

We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join Oportun’s Model Risk Management team and help provide independent oversight of models used across the business. You’ll evaluate model design, methodology, assumptions, implementation, performance, and ongoing monitoring to help ensure models are appropriate, well-controlled, and aligned with Oportun’s risk-management standards. 

This is a senior individual contributor role that combines quantitative analysis, independent model validation, governance, and cross-functional influence. You’ll work closely with model developers, Risk, Data Science, Compliance, Internal Audit, and other stakeholders to challenge model approaches, identify material risks, and strengthen model risk practices across Oportun. 

At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in. 

What You'll Do 

Your day-to-day 

- You’ll independently review and validate statistical, machine learning, and decisioning models used across Oportun, including models supporting consumer credit loss forecasting, liquidity and funding, and capital markets activities. 

- You’ll assess model methodology, assumptions, data quality, feature selection, implementation, performance, stability, and limitations. 

- You’ll perform quantitative testing, benchmarking, sensitivity analysis, back-testing, and other validation activities. 

- You’ll review model monitoring frameworks and help identify performance deterioration, emerging risks, and areas requiring remediation. 

- You’ll evaluate model documentation for completeness, clarity, reproducibility, and alignment with model risk management standards. 

- You’ll provide effective challenges to model developers and business stakeholders while maintaining constructive working relationships. 

- You’ll communicate validation findings, model risks, limitations, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. 

- You’ll support model governance processes, including model inventory, risk tiering, validation scheduling, issue tracking, and remediation follow-up. 

- You’ll partner with Risk, Compliance, Data Science, Product, Engineering, and other teams to strengthen model controls and governance practices. 

- You’ll help improve model risk frameworks, validation methodologies, documentation standards, monitoring practices, and governance processes. 

- You’ll use data and analytics to identify trends and emerging risks across the model portfolio. 

- You’ll look for thoughtful ways to use AI tools to improve research, analysis, documentation, testing, and model risk workflows while maintaining appropriate human review. 

- You'll look for ways to use AI tools thoughtfully — to work smarter, reduce manual work, and make better decisions faster 

Who You Are 

The right fit looks like this 

You’re a rigorous and curious quantitative professional who enjoys understanding how models work, where they can fail, and how their risks should be managed. You’re comfortable challenging assumptions, asking detailed questions, and supporting your conclusions with clear analysis. 

You combine technical depth with strong judgment and communication skills. You can work independently, explain complex quantitative issues clearly, and build credibility with model developers and senior stakeholders. 

You're comfortable navigating complexity and don't wait for perfect information to move forward. You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, and expect the same in return. 

What You Bring 

Skills & experience 

Required 

- 5+ years of experience in data science, model validation, model risk management, quantitative risk, statistics, or a related field. 

- Strong understanding of statistical modeling and machine learning techniques such as logistic regression, gradient boosting, decision trees, neural networks, or similar methods. 

- Strong understanding of how defaults, recoveries, prepayments, loan seasoning, and macroeconomic conditions influence consumer loan portfolio losses and cash flows. 

- Experience developing or validating consumer credit loss forecasting models using methods such as vintage/cohort analysis, roll-rate or transition models, survival analysis, time-series models, or probability of default (PD), loss given default (LGD), and exposure at default (EAD) frameworks.Strong proficiency in Python, R, SQL, or similar quantitative programming tools. 

- Experience working with large datasets and performing advanced statistical analysis, model testing, or performance evaluation. 

- Strong understanding of model validation techniques, performance metrics, benchmarking, sensitivity analysis, stability analysis, and ongoing monitoring. 

- Experience evaluating model assumptions, data quality, limitations, implementation, and business use. 

- Experience independently leading complex analytical or validation work from scoping through final conclusions. 

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document technical findings and explain complex model risks clearly. 

- Strong analytical judgment, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills. 

- Ability to work independently while partnering effectively with model developers, Risk, Compliance, and senior stakeholders. 

Nice to Have 

- Experience in model risk management or independent model validation. 

- Experience with credit risk, fraud risk, consumer lending, fintech, banking, or another regulated financial services environment. 

- Familiarity with model governance frameworks, model inventories, risk tiering, validation schedules, issue management, or regulatory expectations. 

- Experience validating machine learning or AI models. 

- Experience developing or validating liquidity, funding, or cash-flow forecasting models, including evaluating funding needs and liquidity under stress scenarios. 

- Familiarity with capital markets models used for loan valuation or securitization, including assessing how key assumptions affect valuations and projected cash flows.Experience with AWS, SageMaker, Databricks, or other cloud-based analytics and modeling platforms. 

- Experience with Spark, PySpark, Hive, or other large-scale data technologies. 

- Master’s degree or PhD in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, Finance, or another quantitative discipline. 

- Experience using AI-assisted tools to support research, coding, documentation, validation, or quantitative analysis. 

Our AI Mindset 

We b uild with AI. We lead with judgment. 

AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work. 

We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting , willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle. 

In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together . 

Why Oportun 

What's in it for you 

Oportun offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your physical, financial, and professional well-being. Benefits vary by country of employment. 

Some of the benefits available to eligible employees include: 

India Benefits: 

Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance 

Provident Fund 

Life & Accident Insurance 

Internet, Fuel, Meal & Telephone Allowances 

Eligibility and plan details vary by location and employment status. To learn more about Oportun and our benefits, visit oportun.com/careers #LI-REMOTE #LI-SS1 

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment opportunities without regard to race, age, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status or any other category protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. 

California applicants can find a copy of Oportun's CCPA Notice here: https://oportun.com/privacy/california-privacy-notice/ . 

We will never request personal identifiable information (bank, credit card, etc.) before you are hired. We do not charge you for pre-employment fees such as background checks, training, or equipment. If you think you have been a victim of fraud by someone posing as us, please report your experience to the FBI’s Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3). 

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/oportun-senior-data-scientist-model-risk-management-r14365

title: Data Platform Lead
description:
Studytube maakt professionele ontwikkeling toegankelijk. Klanten willen zien wat hun leren oplevert, de business wil sturen op cijfers die kloppen en onze AI-ambities staan of vallen met goede data. Daarom zoeken we een Data Platform Lead die het fundament bouwt waar heel Studytube op draait. 

De rol 

Data werkt bij Studytube als hub-and-spoke. Jij leidt de hub: het gedeelde dataplatform binnen Engineering, met infrastructuur, pipelines, het lakehouse en de gedeelde datamodellen. De spokes zitten in de business, van finance en product tot Customer Success en GTM. Zij bouwen de analyses en dashboards, jij zorgt dat de data eronder klopt, vindbaar is en meebeweegt met het product. 

Je rapporteert aan de Head of Engineering en geeft leiding aan de data engineer. Op termijn breiden we het team uit met een analytics engineer. Je bent een player-coach: je zet de koers uit en bouwt zelf mee. 

Wat je doet 

- Je bent eigenaar van het dataplatform en de architectuur, en stelt de roadmap op samen met de spokes. 

- Je zorgt voor één versie van de waarheid. De spokes bepalen wat een actieve learner is, jij zorgt dat die definitie één keer gebouwd wordt en overal hetzelfde getal oplevert. 

- Je bouwt het platform als product: self-service, documentatie en heldere afspraken, zodat analisten zelfstandig vooruit kunnen. 

- Je legt het datafundament voor AI, voor features in het product en voor interne toepassingen op bedrijfsdata. Je team bouwt zelf sneller met AI-tools. 

- Je neemt het Databricks-platform over van een externe partij, inclusief een high-security omgeving, en denkt mee over de toekomst van onze stack. 

- Je richt governance in het platform in: toegang, datakwaliteit, lineage, retentie en verwijdering, GDPR-proof. 

- Je weegt verzoeken van de spokes tegen elkaar af en legt je keuzes uit, ook als het antwoord nee is. 

- Je coacht het team, werft mee aan de uitbreiding en spreidt kennis, zodat niets van één persoon afhangt. 

Je hebt eerder een dataplatform opgezet of volwassen gemaakt, het liefst in een scale-up. Je bent technisch diep, maar denkt vanuit je gebruikers: een analist die een tabel niet vindt of niet vertrouwt, is voor jou een platformprobleem. Je legt trade-offs uit aan zowel de directie als een developer. 

Je bent pragmatisch, nieuwsgierig naar wat AI verandert aan het vak en haalt energie uit het laten groeien van anderen. 

Must-haves 

- 8+ jaar ervaring in data, waarvan minimaal 2 jaar als lead van een team of platform. 

- Hands-on ervaring in de hele keten: een cloud data platform en pipelines, en SQL, dbt en Python in productie. 

- Databricks in productie (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog), bij voorkeur op Azure. 

- Terraform of andere infrastructure-as-code en CI/CD met GitHub. 

- Dimensioneel modelleren, een semantische laag en data governance in de praktijk. 

- Praktische ervaring met AI-tools in data-ontwikkeling of met data voor AI-toepassingen. 

- Stakeholders tot op directieniveau meenemen in een roadmap. 

- Engels op professioneel niveau; Nederlands is een pré. 

- Bereid tot een Nederlandse veiligheidsscreening (VGB). 

Mooi meegenomen: een warehouse-migratie, data contracts, B2B SaaS of edtech, gereguleerde of publieke omgevingen. 

Stack 

Snowflake, Databricks (Azure), Fivetran, dbt, GitHub, Metabase, Looker. 

Wat we bieden 

- Een competitief salaris en de ruimte om data bij Studytube neer te zetten. 

- Hybride werken: 3 dagen op kantoor in de Houthavens, 2 dagen thuis. 

- 25 vakantiedagen plus een vrije dag op je verjaardag. 

- 3% pensioen via a.s.r., volledig betaald door Studytube. 

- € 1.000 leerbudget per jaar, waarvan de helft voor welzijn of je thuiswerkplek. 

- LevelUp Academy, Studygym, MacBook Air en € 10 telefoonvergoeding. 

- Verzorgde lunches tegen een kleine bijdrage, kwartaaluitjes en een jaarlijks bedrijfsfeest. 

Studytube is het all-in-one leerplatform voor meer dan 600 organisaties, onder wie Bol.com, a.s.r., CZ, Manpower en VolkerWessels. Met 200+ collega’s willen we het nummer 1-platform voor professionele ontwikkeling in Europa worden.

title: AI Experience Engineer (Conversational AI)
description:
Upgrade helps customers move in the right direction with affordable and responsible financial products. Since 2017, we’ve helped over 7.5 million customers access over $42 billion in consumer credit. With a relentless focus on improving our customers' financial well-being, we build products that put more money in their pocket and support their journey toward a better financial future. We’re backed by some of the most prominent technology investors and were most recently valued at $7.3B. 

We’re consistently recognized for our collaborative and inclusive culture. Most recently, we were named one of the World’s Top Fintech Companies by CNBC, Best Places to Work by Built In, Best Places to Work by the San Francisco Business Times, America’s Greatest Workplaces by Newsweek, Best Startup Employer by Forbes, and Healthiest Employers by Phoenix Business Journal. 

We’re looking for new team members who get excited about designing and delivering new and better products. Come join us and help build a better financial future for millions of people. 

About the Role: 

An AI Experience Engineer owns the full lifecycle of the journeys our customers have with Upgrade's AI agent on chat, voice and email: creation, optimization, edge case handling and containment growth. They build journeys in Sierra's no-code tooling, partner with Upgrade's product groups to bring their servicing flows to the agent, and are accountable for whether the agent resolves the customer's issue safely, accurately and without a human.

We are hiring an AI Experience Engineer to own Upgrade's customer-facing AI agent. You will sit between engineering, product and customer operations. You will turn servicing workflows, such as making a payment, checking loan details, updating an address or enabling autopay, into production journeys and keep improving them after launch. You will build and own the journeys end to end, from first draft to steady state. The work is part builder, part analyst: design the flow, handle the edge cases, read the transcripts, and keep raising containment. Containment, CSAT, transfer quality and hallucination rate are your metrics.

Within your first year, you will own a portfolio of journeys across products (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, HELOC, Deposits) and help set the standards for how Upgrade builds, tests and ships AI experiences.

Our Core Technologies 

Sierra Agent Studio (no-code journeys), Sierra simulations and conversation analytics, GraphQL and REST APIs (as journey tools), Genesys (contact center handoff), SumoLogic, Grafana, SQL, Javascript/Typescript, Claude and other LLM tools.

What You'll Do 

• Journey creation: Design and build Sierra journeys in Agent Studio for chat, voice and email, from discovery with operations through production rollout

• Optimization: Review transcripts, recordings and analytics every week, find where conversations fail or transfer, and ship fixes to journey logic, instructions and knowledge

• Edge case handling: Map the unhappy paths (failed payments, mismatched identity, delinquent accounts, unsupported requests) and make sure each ends in a correct answer or a clean handoff

• Containment: Own containment and CSAT targets per journey, run staged rollouts (1% → 100%), and prioritize the work that moves those numbers most

• Product partnership: Work with product groups (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, Deposits) to scope new journeys, keep journeys current as products change, and define the APIs the agent needs

• Safety and compliance: Apply tiered authentication and step-up verification, verbatim compliance language and guardrails against hallucination and off-policy answers

• Handoffs: Design transfers to human agents in Genesys with accurate summaries and auth context

• Testing: Build simulation and regression suites so every journey change ships with evidence it did not break existing behavior

• Monitoring: Watch latency, errors and drop-offs in SumoLogic and Grafana, and own the alerts

• Voice tuning: Latency, filler phrases, interruptions, personality and tone

• Sierra relationship: Be the technical owner on our side, escalate platform issues and shape roadmap asks

What We Look For: 

• 3–5 years of Frontend Software Engineering experience, or equivalent experience in Solutions Engineering, Conversational AI or Technical Product roles

• Working knowledge of how LLM agents behave: instructions, tool calls, knowledge retrieval, and where each one fails

• Experience building evaluations for non-deterministic systems: test sets, simulations, LLM-as-judge, regression gates

• Enough technical depth to read API specs, work with backend engineers on REST and GraphQL integrations, and reason about authorization and permission scopes

• Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, with the ability to build and maintain coded journeys and integrate APIs within conversational AI platforms.

• Product and customer mindset: you understand ops procedures, you read transcripts, care about tone, and measure success by whether the customer's problem got solved

• Ownership in production: rollouts, monitoring, log analysis and incident response

• Clear writing and the ability to work with non-engineers in operations, compliance and legal

Nice To Have: 

• Hands-on experience with Sierra Agent Studio, or a comparable no-code agent platform (Decagon, Ada, Kore.ai, Google CCAI, Amazon Lex/Connect)

• Voice AI experience: speech-to-text, text-to-speech, latency tuning, barge-in handling

• Contact center systems such as Genesys, and agent handoff design

• Background in fintech or another regulated industry (UDAAP, FDCPA, TCPA, PCI, SOC 2)

• Conversation design or UX writing experience

What We Offer You: 

• Competitive salary ($140K-$180K CAN) and stock option plan

• Paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance 

• Flexible PTO

• Opportunities for professional growth and development
• Paid parental leave

• Health & wellness initiatives

Environmental & Working Conditions 

Work is performed indoors in a fast-paced environment that requires the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet established workflows, schedules, and service expectations.

Employees regularly input, retrieve, and exchange information accurately using digital systems and applications to support operational and customer service objectives.

The role requires the ability to receive and exchange information with customers, peers, supervisors, and cross-functional partners through available communication channels, which may include meetings, email, phone, and digital collaboration tools, and may involve real-time, verbal, or in-person exchanges depending on business need.

Job duties may involve managing a high volume of inbound and/or outbound customer interactions and work activities using telecommunications and computer systems. The role requires the ability to read, analyze, and interpret information displayed on computer screens and remain in a working posture for extended periods, consistent with the demands of the position.

Work may be performed in a contact center, office, or remote environment, depending on business needs and the nature of the role. Onsite work environments may include shared workspaces, standard office lighting, and moderate background noise typical of customer service or operational settings.

Employees working remotely are responsible for maintaining a secure and productive workspace with reliable internet connectivity that supports company systems and safeguards the confidentiality of company and customer information.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state and local laws. 

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. 

Upgrade does not accept unsolicited resumes from staffing agencies, search firms, or any third parties. Any resume submitted to any employee of Upgrade without a prior written agreement in place will be considered the property of Upgrade, and Upgrade will not be obligated to pay any referral or placement fee. Agencies must obtain advance written approval from Upgrade's Talent Acquisition department to submit resumes and only in conjunction with a valid, fully executed agreement.

title: Machine Learning Engineer, Assistance Engineering
description:
Headquarters: Remote-USA

Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. 

The Community You Will Join: 

Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence are at the heart of the Airbnb product. From Trust to Payments, and from Customer Service to Marketing we rely on ML to ensure that guests and hosts have the best possible experience with Airbnb. 
The Core ML team in Assistance Engineering is the team responsible for adopting the Agentic AI technologies to enable an intelligent, scalable and exceptional customer service experience. We are responsible for developing the Chat AI assistant, Voice AI Assistant and more! The team is constantly exploring the SOTA Agentic architecture, develops and enhances various AI models, ML services and leverages tools including SFT, Reinforcement learning, Distillation, RAG/Search, LLM evaluation and testing automation, feedback-based learning and guardrail for a wide range of applications in Airbnb. 

The Difference You Will Make: 

We believe our current customer experiences in these domains are only scratching the surface of the innovations that are possible, and that science is at the heart of delivering a step-function change for our Guest and and Host on Airbnb. 
You will build and leverage cutting edge AI technologies to transform Airbnb’s customer service by delivering personalized, easy-to-use and proactive customer service experience. 
Many of the initiatives you’ll tackle are in their early conceptual stages. You will have the opportunity to shape these ideas from inception to production, turning visionary concepts into impactful realities.

A Typical Day: 

- Champion the development of novel ML systems, product integrations, and performance optimizations to solve real-world problems

- Work cross-functionally with product, design, and other engineering counterparts to design and build efficient AI solutions for Airbnb CS products

- Learn and share the latest AI/ML technologies with the team.

Your Expertise:

- Hands-on expertise in LLM, including pretraining, fine-tuning (SFT, RLHF, GRPO), prompt engineering, RAG architectures, and LLM evaluation frameworks

- Experience building Agentic AI systems — including multi-agent orchestration, tool-use, planning, memory, and autonomous reasoning pipelines (e.g., ReAct, LangGraph, AutoGen, or similar)

- Experience of shipping production-grade ML/AI systems at scale, with deep understanding of ML infrastructure, model serving, and MLOps best practices

- Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across Engineering, Product, and Design organizations

Your Location: 

This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity. Click here for the up-to-date list of excluded states. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list. If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from. 

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging: 

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. 

We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com . Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process. 

We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application. 

Equal Employment Opportunity: 

Airbnb values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Airbnb are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.

How We'll Take Care of You: 

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits. 

Pay Range

$162,000 — $186,000 USD

title: Software Engineer - Secure Container Images
description:
With more than 10 billion pulls , Canonical's container images are trusted by developers worldwide to build and run software securely and at scale. That trust rests on our commitment to hardened, production-ready images.

As a member of the team, you will own the path from upstream source to published image, turning open source software into tested, signed, and continuously maintained artifacts that developers can deploy with confidence.

This is fast-paced, multi-disciplinary software engineering. Because most of the software we package originates from third-party upstreams, you will work across a broad range of container technologies and hundreds of open source projects, often in several programming languages, integrating and maintaining them so they are easy to consume on Ubuntu. Automation is central to the role: you will build the pipelines that package, build, test, and publish images at scale.

Your seniority in this role will reflect your software engineering experience and your ability to mentor and guide more junior colleagues.

- A genuine appetite for learning and for working outside your comfort zone

- A Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, a STEM field, or a similar discipline

- An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university

- Business level written and spoken English.

- Sincere personal motivation aligned with our mission.

- International travel 2-4 times a year for company events up to two weeks long.

- Reliable, delivering high quality work that builds trust and confidence.

- Accessible, collaborating to build products and systems that are usable.

- Hands-on experience building minimal and distroless container images

- Familiarity with security or compliance frameworks such as CIS, NIST, FedRAMP, or DISA STIG

- Evidence of contributions to open source projects

If your experience is close but does not match every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We value transferable experience from Linux packaging, release engineering, build systems, platform engineering, and open-source maintenance.

title: Langfuse - Senior Product Engineer, Integrations
description:
Why Integrations Engineering at Langfuse 

Your work puts Langfuse into developers’ hands. 

Our SDKs are downloaded 26M+ times per month, and for many developers the first thing they touch is an integration — a few lines of code that connect their favorite framework to Langfuse. When that experience is seamless, they’re wow’ed. When it’s not, we might have lost them. You’ll own that critical first impression across 40+ framework integrations.

You’ll live at the frontier of LLM application development. 

The AI framework ecosystem moves fast — new agent frameworks, orchestration libraries, and model providers emerge every week. You’ll be among the first to instrument them, giving you unmatched exposure to how cutting-edge AI applications are built. The developers you serve are some of the most ambitious software engineers in the world, and working closely with them will make you an expert on LLM engineering yourself.

Everything you build is open source and immediately visible. 

All Langfuse integrations are MIT-licensed. When you ship a new integration or improve an existing one, thousands of developers benefit the same day — and they’ll tell you about it in GitHub issues, on Twitter, and in our community channels.

What You’ll Do 

- Build and maintain framework integrations. Langfuse integrates with 40+ frameworks and model providers: OpenAI SDK, Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Pydantic AI, OpenAI Agents, CrewAI, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, LiveKit, and many more. You’ll own these integrations end-to-end — from initial implementation to ongoing maintenance as frameworks evolve. When a new framework gains traction, you’ll be among the first to instrument it.

- Design new integration patterns for emerging frameworks. When a framework or a new agent orchestrator appears, you’ll evaluate it, design the right instrumentation approach (callback handler, decorator, OTEL auto-instrumentation, or a combination), build the integration, write the docs, and ship it. You’ll develop strong opinions on what makes a great integration experience.

- Contribute to the core SDKs. While integrations are your primary focus, your work will surface needs in our Python and TypeScript SDKs. You’ll contribute improvements to the core SDK when your integration work demands it — whether that’s a new hook point, better context propagation, or performance optimizations.

- Write documentation and integration guides. At Langfuse, docs are part of our core product. When you ship a new integration, the guide ships with it. You’ll own the integration docs, quickstart tutorials, cookbooks, and migration paths that help developers get started in minutes.

- Be a voice in the developer community. You’ll engage with framework communities, respond to integration-related GitHub issues, write blog posts about new integrations, and be present in our Slack/Discord channels. You’ll build relationships with framework maintainers and represent Langfuse in the broader AI developer ecosystem.

What We’re Looking For 

- Passionate about the LLM ecosystem. You’ve built real applications with frameworks like LangChain, Pydantic AI, Vercel AI SDK, LlamaIndex, or similar — or you have a deep willingness to go deep and get your hands dirty with every major framework in the space. You’re excited about this ecosystem, not just familiar with it.

- Strong in Python and/or TypeScript. You write clean, reliable code. You don’t need to be a systems-level performance expert, but you care about code quality and understand that integrations run inside other people’s production systems.

- Product-minded engineer. You think about the developer who’s going to use your integration at 11pm trying to ship a feature. You obsess over the getting-started experience: how many lines of code does it take? Is the error message helpful? Does the docs example actually work?

- Self-directed and motivated. You know how to develop conviction about what to build and how to ship it. You don’t wait for detailed specs — you investigate the framework, talk to users, and propose the right approach.

- Excited about open source and developer community. You genuinely enjoy talking to developers about their integration challenges, writing clear documentation, and contributing to open source projects.

- Thrives in a small, accountable team. Your output is visible and matters. You’re comfortable owning outcomes, not just tasks.

CS or quantitative degree preferred, but not required. We care far more about what you’ve built and your hunger to learn. 

Bonus Points 

- Experience with OpenTelemetry internals or observability instrumentation

- Contributions to popular open source projects, SDKs, or developer tools

- Experience building developer tooling, CLIs, or client libraries

- Former founder or early startup experience

- Active presence in AI/ML developer communities (blog posts, talks, open source)

No candidate checks all boxes. If you feel you are a good fit for this role, please go ahead and apply. 

Projects You Could Own 

- Build and ship a Langfuse integration for an emerging agent framework (e.g., OpenClaw, new OTEL-based instrumentation)

- Design the integration pattern for a new category of AI tools (e.g., voice agents via LiveKit/Pipecat)

- Create comprehensive quickstart cookbooks that get developers from zero to traced in under 5 minutes

- Work with the OpenTelemetry community to improve GenAI semantic conventions

- Maintain and upgrade our most popular integrations (OpenAI, LangChain, Vercel AI SDK) as those frameworks ship breaking changes

title: Senior Software Engineer - Cloud Partner Integrations
description:
About the team

Most providers make customers migrate their data to them. We're doing the opposite: bringing ClickHouse Cloud into the environments our customers already trust, so their data stays useful right where it lives.

Those environments come in a few shapes. Some are major cloud data platforms that run ClickHouse as a native service, so customers get it without leaving the tool they already use. Some are BI and visualization tools that need ClickHouse to show up as a fast, first-class data source behind their dashboards. And some are developer and data platforms we connect through marketplaces and identity federation with a couple of clicks or agentic calls. Every integration is unique, but the goal is the same every time: ClickHouse should feel like a first-class citizen in every environment.

The craft is finding the patterns underneath different integrations. As one of the first backend engineers, you'll help shape the technical defaults for this team. You'll have end-to-end ownership, but you'll also work inside the constraints of platforms you don't own: thin documentation, unfamiliar deployment topologies, and timelines governed by partner approval cycles. - Owning the architecture: auth and identity flows, multi-tenancy, how data moves and where it's allowed to live, performance, and what happens in production

title: AI Fabric Architect
description:
fal is the generative media ecosystem powering the next generation of AI products. We build the infrastructure, tools, and model access that teams need to move from idea to production, and do it at scale without compromise. For developers and enterprises, fal is the foundation that makes generative media not just possible, but practical: a unified platform where high-performance inference, orchestration, and observability come together to unlock new categories of AI-native products.

As generative media reshapes industries across a market projected to grow by hundreds of billions over the next decade, fal is becoming the ecosystem that ambitious teams build on.

About this role 

You are the architect of the network that our GPU clusters run on. You own the fabric end to end, from the NIC in each GPU server through the spine and leaf across the AI fabric, and you know that in AI infrastructure the network is core to the machine. As fal brings its own GPU capacity online across multiple sites, you will define the fabric architecture every site is built from, and then personally make sure it gets built and performs. This is not an architecture-only role. We are a small team moving fast, and the right person is as comfortable writing a port map, tracing a bad optic, or tuning congestion control on the data center floor as they are setting technical direction.

What you will do:

title: Senior ML Engineer (R14284)
description:

Who We Are

While the title is Senior ML Engineer , this opportunity is specifically focused on ML Platform Engineering rather than ML model development or data science.

We're looking for engineers with strong software engineering fundamentals and hands-on experience building, scaling, and operating the platforms and infrastructure that enable machine learning in production. The emphasis is on ML infrastructure, MLOps, model serving, platform reliability, and production engineering , rather than primarily developing, training, or fine-tuning ML models.

Location Note 

We’re excited to consider talent currently based in India, as well as candidates who are open to relocating to India for this opportunity. Please note that, as this is a "Remote–India" position, the role must be performed from within India. 

The Opportunity 

The Machine Learning Platform team builds the software foundations that enable data scientists and machine learning engineers to develop, validate, deploy, and operate models safely and efficiently in production. In this role, you’ll lead complex platform work from business context through production outcomes, combining hands-on engineering, architectural judgment, production ownership, and mentorship. In your first year, success means leading meaningful platform initiatives, improving reliability and developer experience, and becoming a trusted technical leader for the ML platform. 

At Oportun, we move fast and hold each other to a high bar. You’ll partner across Data Science, Product, Risk, Fraud, and Engineering to solve ambiguous problems and move the needle for members and the business.

- You’ll partner with Data Science, Product, Risk, Fraud, and Engineering teams to translate ambiguous business needs into practical technical solutions. 

- You’ll own significant technical initiatives end to end and lead complex production investigations—clarifying requirements, leading design, delivering safely, measuring results, and implementing durable fixes. 

- You’ll raise engineering quality through thoughtful code and design reviews, mentor engineers through pairing and technical guidance, and contribute to platform technical strategy. 

- You’ll look for ways to use AI tools thoughtfully to work smarter, reduce manual work, and make better decisions faster. 

Who You Are 

The right fit looks like this 

You do not need detailed implementation direction to be effective. Given an ambiguous problem and sufficient context, you can define the technical approach, explain trade-offs, align stakeholders, lead delivery, and own the outcome after launch. 

You’re comfortable navigating complexity and don’t wait for perfect information to move forward. You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, mentor others, and connect engineering work to member, business, and operational outcomes. 

What You Bring 

Skills & experience 

- You’ll have 5+ years of professional software-engineering experience building and operating production systems, with strong programming skills in Python and deep knowledge of API design, distributed systems, service architecture, testing, and software-design fundamentals. 

- You’ve demonstrated experience designing and operating reliable, scalable cloud-native services or data-intensive systems, with experience in ML platforms, model serving, feature engineering, data platforms, MLOps, or related systems. 

- You bring practical experience with SQL, databases, caching, and tracing data or requests across multiple systems, plus familiarity with the ML lifecycle from feature engineering and model training through evaluation, deployment, serving, monitoring, and governance. 

- You have experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Git-based workflows, and production observability, and you can evaluate technical alternatives and clearly communicate recommendations, trade-offs, risks, and dependencies. 

- You’ve demonstrated the ability to mentor engineers, improve engineering practices, lead through technical influence, and connect engineering work to member, business, product, and operational outcomes. 

Nice to Have

- Experience building feature platforms, model-serving systems, workflow-orchestration platforms, or internal developer platforms. 

- Familiarity with monitoring model quality, data quality, feature coverage, latency, reliability, or cost efficiency, and experience working with sensitive data in a regulated or financial-services environment. 

- Experience with Java or another backend language in addition to Python, and familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT or Copilot to improve personal productivity. 

Our AI Mindset 

We b uild with AI. We lead with judgment. 

AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work. 

We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting , willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle. 

In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together .

title: Senior Data Scientist, People Analytics & Research
description:
Headquarters: Remote - USA

Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. 

The Community You Will Join: 

People Analytics & Research is a strong team of Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and Analysts. Our work is highly sought-after, and impacts stakeholders in our People function, and across the business. In this role, you'll take on some of the hardest questions about Airbnb's workforce - how we recruit, pay, develop, and retain our people - partnering with leaders across Recruiting, Compensation, Talent, and the wider business to turn rigorous analysis into decisions they act on. 

The Difference You Will Make: 

The People Analytics & Research team is looking for an experienced Data Scientist to lead and/or contribute to our most important research - applying causal inference and quasi-experimental methods to high-stakes people questions: how we recruit, hire, promote, and retain a best-in-class workforce; how we keep key company processes fair; and how work itself is changing. Employee listening and survey analysis are part of the mix, but the heart of the role is rigorous inferential research on observational people data. The role is highly cross-functional, and you will partner with Recruiting, Talent Leaders, Compensation, Legal, and Diversity & Belonging. We need a Data Scientist with a proven track record of translating data into insight and action.

If you have a proven background in this field and are excited to help build Airbnb’s community, we want to hear from you.

A Typical Day: 

- Collaborate with partners and stakeholders to understand people-related business problems, and gather relevant people data to analyze

- Utilize appropriate statistical models and data science methodologies to gain insights, explain, or predict a wide variety of people-related processes, such as recruiting and hiring, promotion, retention, pay equity, productivity, and organizational effectiveness, among others

- Translate data and insights into meaningful visualizations and stories to drive strategy, action, and decision-making with leaders across the business

- Align research priorities with business priorities and take a customer-focused mindset in working with stakeholders

- Lead the team's compensation analytics - the recurring, legally sensitive analyses that inform Total Rewards decisions on pay, compensation structure, and talent awards - in close partnership with Employment Legal and Total Rewards

- Lead design and measurement of Airbnb's quality-of-hire metric with Recruiting, and own sensitive statutory and governance reporting

- Be a constant learner, active listener, and teacher to advance data science, people analytics, and Airbnb

- Use AI fluently - including the team's AirPanda platform and LLM-based agents - to accelerate analysis, prototyping, and synthesis, and to extend what a single researcher can deliver

Your Expertise: 

- 5+ years in industry experience and a Master's degree/PhD in a quantitative field

- Deep experience with causal inference on observational data and quasi-experimental research design and analysis

- Proficiency in R or Python for statistical analysis, and SQL for data access

- Familiarity with survey design and analysis, as one of several methods in the toolkit

- Experience applying data science to compensation, recruiting, or broader workforce and organizational questions, including work with legally sensitive data

- Ability to communicate clearly and effectively to cross functional partners of varying technical levels and drive impact

- Experience working with large practical datasets

Your Location: 

This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity. Click here for the up-to-date list of excluded states. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list . If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from. 

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging: 

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. 

We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com . Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process. 

We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application. 

Equal Employment Opportunity :

Airbnb values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Airbnb are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.

How We'll Take Care of You: 

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits. 

Pay Range

$180,000 — $210,000 USD 

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role. 

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @ airbnb.com or @ ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

title: Software Engineer - Agent Team
description:
Are you ready to own something big? Automox is turning IT admins into IT heroes by replacing traditional tools with our award winning cloud-native endpoint management platform. Our product works autonomously and so do our teams. We value a ‘one team’ mentality where everyone’s unique skills contribute to an environment that encourages collaboration and ownership. At Automox you’re enabled to do your best work, grow your career, and have an impact that will be noticeable. WE ARE A_TOMOX… all that’s missing is U! 

OUR TECH STACK 

- Backend Languages: Go, TypeScript, Java, PHP

- Frontend Languages: TypeScript, Vue 3, Tauri (Rust)

- Operating Systems: Windows, Linux, MacOS

- Databases/Data Tools: PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, Redis, S3

OVERVIEW 

Our Engineering team builds products that autonomously manage endpoint configuration, security, and patching across Windows, macOS, and Linux devices. We value a "one team" mentality, empowering our engineers with autonomy, collaboration, and meaningful ownership of impactful solutions. At Automox, you’ll do your best work, grow your career, and see the direct impact of your contributions.

You are a curious software developer who is dedicated to your craft and enjoys solving big problems; you write code that you are proud of and can hit the ground running with support from the team. You understand that SaaS software delivery necessitates innovation and speed of execution. You want to be a part of a creative and enterprising team with challenging problems to solve. You pride yourself in owning problems but don’t want to work in a vacuum to solve them. Collaborating with the team to come up with the best solution for your customer is what fuels your fire. 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING 

- Research, design, develop, secure and solutions that facilitate communications with over 2 millionAutomox agents deployed globally.

- Extend, enhance, and evolve event driven services to provide new and exciting features in the Automox platform and in our endpoint software.

- Contribute to continuous improvement by testing, performance tuning, refactoring, making usability improvements, and automation.

- Evaluate technical options, make a clear recommendation, and move forward in a way that invites feedback and iteration.

- Operate with a quality-first mindset. Your approach to testing sets you apart from your peers.

- Make data-driven decisions. You understand the impact of your development before it reaches production.

BACKGROUND AND SKILLS REQUIRED 

- Programming experience in Golang or Java is preferred although we'll consider polyglots. The right candidate will show versatility writing and developing software in a variety of languages over their career.

- 3 - 5 years of experience designing, developing, testing, and monitoring applications deployed in a high availability SaaS environment.

- Professional experience shipping frontend features in a modern JavaScript framework using TypeScript. You don’t need to be a UI specialist, but you should be comfortable owning the UI half of a feature you built the backend for.

- Experience building production applications in cloud environments (AWS) with a strong emphasis on security best practices.

- Enjoy scaling microservice architectures and large-scale event ingestion platforms. Have familiarity scaling websockets, real-time messaging systems (Kafka, MQTT), and non-relational database systems like DynamoDB, and DevOps.

- Excellent communicator, thrives within a tightly knit, cross-functional remote team environment.

- Impactful collaborator working with other engineers, Product Managers, Program Managers and Technical Support.

NICE TO HAVE 

- Experience building desktop or cross-platform applications.

- Experience with software that runs on customer endpoints across macOS, Windows, or Linux (such as agents, installers, or system services).

- Experience writing automated end-to-end tests (Python, Playwright, or similar)

How We Work 

We run a 70/20/10 model across our engineering pods: 70% of sprint capacity goes to primary roadmap, 20% to tech debt and service health, and 10% to learning and exploration. That last 10% is protected — it's how we invest in our engineers and stay sharp as a team.

We're moving toward full service ownership, where the team that builds it, runs it. That means you'll understand your services at a level most engineers don't get to — cost profiles, failure modes, operational behavior — and you'll have the autonomy to make them better.

We have an Architecture Review Board (led by our Principal Engineer) that provides guardrails and review for significant technical decisions. You'll have input there as your experience grows.

The salary range listed is the base pay range for this position. In addition, the total compensation package includes bonus, equity and benefits. Actual earnings may be less or more depending on a candidate's direct experience, skills, industry knowledge, and location.

Automox is the cloud-native IT operations platform for modern organizations. Our award-winning answer to modern IT operations and best-in-class results earned Automox four straight quarters of record growth. title: Remote Office Assistant

As an Office Assistant, you will help support daily administrative operations, assist with entry-level bookkeeping, organize client documents, support internal reporting, and help maintain accurate company records. We are looking for talented and diligent candidates who perform well on our skills assessments. Strong skills test performance may be considered even if a candidate does not meet every preferred experience or educational background requirement.

Why Join Coalition Technologies?

- 100% remote work with a company that has supported remote team members for more than a decade

- Competitive profit-sharing bonus plan, with up to 50% of company profits paid to full-time employees each month

- Competitive Paid Time Off plan that supports work-life balance

- Subsidized gym memberships

- Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance packages for eligible US-based team members

- International Health Insurance Reimbursement Program for eligible international team members

- Device upgrade and learning reimbursement programs

- Career development plans with clearly defined goals and rewards

- Additional job-specific incentives and bonuses

Office Assistant Responsibilities 

As an Office Assistant, your duties will include:

- Answering phones and emails

- Completing entry-level bookkeeping tasks, including recording expenses, organizing receipts, and maintaining transaction records

- Resolving billing issues with clients and internal team members

- Providing account access, usage reports, data analysis, and other ad hoc support for team members

- Supporting quality assurance checks for internal and client-facing reports

- Organizing new client contracts, creating invoices, and processing client payments

- Contributing to internal database maintenance, upkeep, and data entry

- Researching, ordering, and distributing company-wide gifts two to three times per year

- Organizing company events, competitions, and special projects throughout the year

Required Skills and Qualifications 

The ideal candidate will have:

- Willingness to learn, grow, and collaborate with the team and company as a whole

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills

- High level of discretion, ethics, and trustworthiness

- Strong attention to detail and organizational skills

- Ability to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, and data entry tasks

- Innovative thinking and willingness to challenge existing methods when improvement is possible

- Availability to work 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Pacific Time

- Reliable remote workspace with a fast computer, quality internet, camera, microphone, and speakers

Preferred Skills 

- The following experience is preferred but not required:

- Intermediate spreadsheet skills

- Experience with bookkeeping or financial record keeping

- Experience with Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, QuickBooks Online, and Google Workspace

- Experience supporting billing, invoicing, reporting, data entry, or administrative operations

Remote Work Environment 

Coalition Technologies is a fully remote company. Our team works remotely with the support of time tracking software, structured communication, and a company culture designed to help remote team members succeed. We have supported remote team members for more than a decade and welcome qualified applicants from around the world.

Growth Opportunity 

This position offers a strong opportunity for growth. Successful Office Assistants at Coalition Technologies have advanced quickly and earned promotions within the Accounting team and across other departments.

Compensation 

For candidates located in California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, the starting base pay for this position ranges from $15 to $25 per hour. For candidates outside of California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, compensation may fall outside the listed range.

title: SaaS Engineer
description:
About Mistral 

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role 

We are seeking a talented SaaS Engineer to take ownership of the full lifecycle of our SaaS and Software portfolio, from spend and license management to day-to-day governance and tooling policies. This will cover both Internal IT and Engineering SaaS and Software used across Mistral.

You will be the go-to person for everything SaaS: how much we spend, who has access, whether our tools are secure and compliant, and how new tools are evaluated and approved. You will map our AI connectors, integrations, MCPs and other tooling, define the associated policies, and report on costs and usage. Working closely with Security, Compliance, Finance, IAM and Procurement, you will help define and enforce how software is adopted across the company.

If you enjoy combining technical expertise, financial ownership and operational governance, this role offers the opportunity to shape how a fast-growing global organization manages and scales its software ecosystem.

What You Will Do 

SaaS Cost and Billing Management 

- Own the SaaS budget: track spend, forecast costs, and report on SaaS expenditure to Finance and IT leadership.

- Manage vendor contracts, renewals, and license tiers, working closely with our Procurement Manager and negotiating pricing at renewal where relevant.

- Regularly audit licenses and seats, reclaim unused seats, and eliminate redundant or overlapping tools.

- Work with IT leadership to define policies and budgets related to AI usage across Mistral.

- Detect and reduce shadow IT spend and consolidate vendors wherever possible.

- Build and maintain a complete and accurate SaaS inventory, including costs, owners, contracts, and renewal dates.

SaaS Governance and Operations 

- Ensure SAML/SSO and SCIM provisioning are enforced across all supported SaaS applications, working with our IT Engineers and IT DevOps teams to close existing gaps.

- Design and roll out RBAC policies across our SaaS portfolio.

- Run periodic user and access reviews, auditing accounts, licenses, permissions, and privileged access while ensuring proper offboarding cleanup.

- Keep collaboration and engineering tools clean, organized, and properly managed.

- Define and enforce naming conventions, ownership rules, and lifecycle policies for SaaS accounts and workspaces.

- Act as the escalation point for SaaS access issues and tooling-related questions from across the business.

SaaS Assessment and Policy 

- Define and maintain the company's SaaS and Software assessment and procurement policies, covering intake, evaluation, approval, and decommissioning workflows.

- Lead new tool evaluations in partnership with Security (vendor risk assessments and security reviews), Compliance (data protection, GDPR and DPAs), Finance (budget impact), and Procurement (contracting).

- Maintain a vendor risk and compliance matrix for the existing SaaS portfolio, tracking certifications such as SOC 2, ISO 27001 and HIPAA, as well as data processing agreements.

- Own the internal tool catalog: publish approved tools, highlight restricted ones, and guide employees toward compliant alternatives.

- Contribute to IT policy documentation and internal training and awareness around software and tool usage.

What We're Looking For 

- 3–5+ years of experience in IT operations, SaaS management, IT asset management, or a similar role.

- Hands-on experience administering IT SaaS platforms, including SSO/IdP solutions such as Okta, Entra ID and Google Workspace, SCIM provisioning, and tools such as Slack, Notion, Bitwarden and Microsoft 365 or equivalent.

- Hands-on experience with engineering and cloud platforms such as GitHub, GCP, AWS and Azure.

- Proven experience in license and seat management, as well as SaaS spend optimization.

- Familiarity with AI tooling and models, including Mistral and other providers, and an understanding of how they integrate into SaaS environments, billing, and budgets.

- Good understanding of identity and access management concepts, including SAML, SCIM, RBAC, and the principle of least privilege.

- Familiarity with vendor security reviews and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001 and GDPR.

- Experience working cross-functionally with Security, Legal/Compliance, Finance, and Procurement teams.

- Strong organizational skills and a documented, process-driven mindset.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. French is a plus.

Bonus:

title: Senior Data Scientist (R14369)
description:
Headquarters: Remote - India

Who We Are 

Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually. 

Location Note 

We’re excited to consider talent currently based in India, as well as candidates who are open to relocating to India for this opportunity. Please note that, as this is a "Remote–India" position, the role must be performed from within India. 

The Opportunity 

We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist to support our Marketing Data Science team and accelerate new member growth through predictive modeling and advanced analytics. You'll build prospect targeting and conversion prediction models that help Oportun identify promising prospective members, improve acquisition conversion rates, and reduce customer acquisition cost (CAC). You'll own models end to end—from feature development and validation through production deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement—in partnership with Marketing, Growth, Product, and Engineering. 

What You'll Do 

Your day-to-day 

- You'll develop and deploy machine learning models for prospect targeting and conversion prediction to increase new member acquisition. 

- You'll analyze internal prospect and application funnel data, marketing campaign and engagement data, third-party consumer and alternative data, and credit bureau data to build predictive features and identify growth opportunities. 

- You'll apply statistical and machine learning methods, including logistic regression, gradient boosting, and related techniques, to improve targeting accuracy and conversion rates. 

- You'll own reusable pipelines for data preparation, feature engineering, training, scoring, deployment, and ongoing model monitoring. 

- You'll partner with Marketing, Growth, Product, and Engineering to translate model outputs into actionable acquisition strategies and reliable production workflows. 

- You'll measure model effectiveness and business impact through new member acquisition, targeting accuracy, conversion rates, customer acquisition cost, and production reliability. 

Who You Are 

The right fit looks like this 

- You're a curious, rigorous data scientist who turns complex data into reliable models and practical business decisions. 

- You enjoy ambiguous growth problems, take ownership of outcomes, and balance predictive performance with measurable acquisition impact. 

- You're comfortable navigating complexity and don't wait for perfect information to move forward. 

- You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, and expect the same in return. 

What You Bring 

Skills & experience 

Required 

- 4+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, predictive modeling, or a related field. 

- Strong Python and SQL skills and hands-on experience working with large, complex datasets. 

- Experience applying statistical modeling and machine learning techniques, such as logistic regression and gradient boosting, to business problems.
