title: Senior IT Engineer
description:
Health can’t wait . 

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Mission 

Alan is scaling internationally (800+ employees, 100+ healthcare professionals, 5+ countries) and needs IT Engineers to build and own the internal technology platform every Alaner works on: identity and provisioning, endpoint and SaaS security, the tooling behind our clinics, and the automation that keeps IT from scaling linearly with headcount.

The scope below is what the team owns, not a checklist for one person. You'll be staffed on one or two of these areas at a time, according to your strengths and interests, and it will evolve through time based on company needs and personal appetite.

Staying close to users keeps us building the right things: you'll spend up to 2-3 days a month on IT support, seeing first-hand where friction lives and what's worth automating next.

Scope 

⚙️ Platform & automation 

- Own and extend automations on Alan Home, our internal provisioning engine

- Maintain, extend and improve helpdesk automation, SaaS provisioning flows, and onboarding/offboarding pipelines

- Own the meeting room AV and room-booking platform as a product, replicable across offices

🔑 Identity & access 

- Own the IT side of the employee lifecycle (onboarding, offboarding, mobility between jobs and countries) across Google Workspace, SSO/SAML and our SaaS ecosystem.

- Grow our role-based access model: extend it to more tools and refine the permission groups, so access is granted by role rather than case by case

- Make employee lifecycle events reliable, fast and auditable end-to-end

- Own access reviews and least-privilege models; produce and maintain the evidence our auditors rely on

- Own SaaS procurement and license management: vendor relationships, renewals, and cost optimization across our stack

🔒 Endpoint & SaaS security 

- Own the Mac fleet in Kandji: enrollment at scale, role-based blueprints, fleet compliance

- Cloudflare WARP, SaaS security controls

- Maintain and strengthen our ISO 27001 certification and drive ACPR and pentest remediation on the endpoint and platform scope

🩺 Health Professionals IT 

- The IT layer behind Alan's clinics: practitioner tooling, equipment, access

- Role and permission automation for healthcare professionals, and their support and escalation process

🌍 Internationalisation 

- Make international expansion something IT accelerates, not something it slows down: a repeatable process where every new market (Canada, KSA, Armenia...) launches on our standard stack from day one

- Bring acquired entities onto that same platform

Milestones 

First 3 months 

- Acquire technical knowledge on Alan's platform: Alan Home, Google Workspace/SSO, Kandji, Cloudflare WARP

- Take one project end-to-end and ship a first increment

- Join the IT oncall team as technical escalation

First 6 months 

- Own a workstream end-to-end

- Deliver one automation or hardening initiative end-to-end

- Take up documentation and automation on your scope and reduce significantly the bus factor on it

- Mentor IT teammates on your core expertise

First year 

- Deliver measurable IT toil reduction on your scope

- Set the technical standards on your domain: how we build, document and review it

- Build strong cross-functional partnerships (Engineering, Security, Workplace, Clinic, People, Audit)

- Contribute to hiring and onboarding new teammates

3 years 

- Lead major projects end-to-end across several communities

- Be the reference the team relies on across at least two domains

- Mentor the IT team and beyond, and scale IT without a linear increase in manual work

As the community grows, there is room to take on more responsibility: leading a crew, owning cross-community projects, mentoring, hiring.

What we're looking for 

Must-have - Technical/hard skills: 

- 5+ years in IT engineering, platform, systems or corporate engineering , with real ownership of production-facing systems

- Depth in at least one area (platform & automation, identity, endpoint & security) and demonstrated range beyond it. 

- You write code: not necessarily as a full-time software engineer, but Python, APIs and pull requests in a shared repo should feel normal

- Structured problem-solving: diagnoses methodically, asks the right clarifying questions, thinks about failure modes and rollback

- Comfort with regulated environments: health data, ACPR, ISO 27001, HDS

- Automation & AI appetite : uses AI tools smartly to accelerate their own delivery, with an instinct for what should be automated or delegated to AI rather than repeated

Must-have - Behavioral / soft skills: 

- Ownership & autonomy: drives topics forward without hand-holding, including when they cross into someone else's perimeter

- Written communication: Alan is written-first; decisions get argued in public documents and challenged by people outside your team

- Pragmatic judgment: balances "perfect" vs. "good enough", decides with incomplete information

- Documentation culture: reduces bus factor through clear documentation and knowledge sharing

Nice-to-have skills / Bonus points if you have: 

- Experience with an internal provisioning or IdP-driven automation platform

- Kandji or another MDM at scale

- Cloudflare Zero Trust / WARP, Datadog

- Audit remediation experience (ISO 27001, HDS)

- Multi-country rollouts, or IT integration after an acquisition

- Having mentored, coached or led a (small) crew

- Health or healthtech ecosystem familiarity

Languages: Fluent English & Professional French

- Experience building LLM-powered product features.

- Familiarity with GitHub Actions and Terraform.

- Experience with Python or similar languages.

- Bring cross-domain universal consent to general availability.

- Reduce friction in how customers onboard and deploy Consent.

- Build tooling and education that help engineers, Customer Success, and Solutions Architects self-serve on Consent.

- Help lead resolution of high-severity issues as part of the on-call rotation.

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role: 

We are seeking a talented and motivated, best-in-class Senior Data Engineer. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement. This position will own the data pipelines, transformations, and reporting processes that support accurate, complete, and timely furnishing of customer account information to credit bureaus.

This role presents an opportunity to work in a fast-paced, high growth environment while taking hands-on ownership of a critical customer-facing data function. You will dig into account data and code, debug SQL and Python workflows, and carry issues from investigation through verified resolution. You will partner with Customer Service to resolve technical dispute escalations, with Compliance to apply approved reporting requirements, and with Engineering when a fix is needed in production services or the consumer app. We are looking for an independent problem solver who can manage recurring reporting operations while improving the systems behind them.

What You’ll Do: 

- Own recurring credit bureau furnishing operations, including data preparation, validation, submissions, bureau feedback, exception resolution, and reconciliation 

- Build, maintain, and debug SQL transformations, Python scripts, and data pipelines that produce credit reporting data

- Trace discrepancies from account activity and source records through transformation logic to furnished outputs; identify root causes and implement lasting fixes 

- Investigate escalations from Customer Service, explain what happened to account data and what should be reported under approved policies, and provide evidence to support their dispute responses 

- Identify all accounts affected by reporting defects, implement corrections and controlled reprocessing, and verify the resulting reporting outcomes 

- Develop automated tests, reconciliations, monitoring, and alerts to catch inaccurate, incomplete, duplicate, or unexpected reporting before submission 

- Partner with Engineering on defects in production services or the consumer app, providing reproducible examples, affected-account analysis, and clear requirements; validate fixes through the reporting pipeline 

- Work with Compliance to translate approved reporting requirements into technical rules and escalate ambiguous reporting scenarios 

- Document reporting logic, data lineage, procedures, and incident resolutions so the process is repeatable and can be supported by others 

What We Look For: 

- Degree in computer science, engineering, data science, or a related quantitative discipline

- 5+ years of relevant experience in data engineering or software engineering, including hands-on ownership of production data pipelines and operational workflows

- Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, account-level reconciliation, data profiling, and troubleshooting transformation logic

- Strong Python skills, including the ability to read unfamiliar code, debug existing scripts, and implement maintainable fixes

- Demonstrated ability to independently investigate ambiguous problems, prioritize recurring operations and incidents, and carry issues through to verified resolution 

- Experience with version control, code review, automated testing, monitoring, and safe deployment and reprocessing of data workflows

- Excellent problem-solving skills, with a track record of tracing data defects across systems and preventing recurrence

- Strong business judgment and communication skills; able to explain technical findings to Customer Service and Compliance and work effectively with Engineering 

- Fluent in English

- Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills: 

- 
Experience with credit reporting dispute workflows, e-OSCAR, Metro 2 format, and investigating escalations from customer support teams

- 
Experience with dbt, Redshift, PostgreSQL, AWS, and workflow scheduling or orchestration tools

- 
Experience in consumer lending, servicing, payments, financial services, banking, fintech, or BNPL

The Tech You’ll Work With: 

- Python

- Redshift, PostgreSQL

- Data build tool (dbt) 

- WS, G Suite, Mac

- Coding agents Claude, ChatGPT

Interview Process: 

- Application submitted (you are here)

- Wonderlic test (30-40 min)

- Interview with recruiters (30 min)

- Online coding assessment focused on SQL, Python, and debugging

- Verbal case study interview. Walk through a credit reporting discrepancy, trace the data and code, and explain how you would correct and prevent the issue.

- Verbal behavioral interview. Share examples of independently resolving data incidents, improving reliability, and partnering with Engineering and Customer Service.

- Offer

About You: 

- You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.

- You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things

- You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.

- You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.

- You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.

- You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome? 

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

title: Care Advisor I
description:
About Ardent

At Ardent, we believe that the "product" in the BPO industry is our people and their time. We partner with mission-driven healthcare organizations to bridge the health literacy gap in the U.S. healthcare system. Our mission is to cut through the red tape of healthcare by pairing patients with expert advocates, ensuring they have the tools to make better decisions and achieve better outcomes.

We are a high-growth, intense, and heart-led team. Ardent isn’t a place to coast; it’s a place to redefine the patient experience through urgency, precision, and empathy.

About the Role

As a Care Advisor I, you will serve as the operational backbone of the patient journey. This is a hybrid role that blends high-touch customer support with rigorous backend operations. You will be the human voice and heart of our service, supporting patients and healthcare advocates via phone, email, and chat.

Your goal is to handle escalated patient inquiries that require thoughtful problem-solving and relationship management. 

This role focuses on addressing complex patient concerns, processing sensitive requests, and preserving patient relationships during challenging interactions. You aren’t just answering questions; you are orchestrating a seamless workflow between clinical teams, advocates, and patients to ensure world-class outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

- Omnichannel Support: Resolve inquiries to complete satisfaction via phone, email, and chat, acting as the primary point of contact for members throughout their journey.

- Operational Execution: Manage the backend tasks required to move members through healthcare processes, including appointment confirmations, medical information retrieval, and troubleshooting.

- Relationship Management: Build strong, empathetic bonds with clients and advocates, navigating tough conversations with grace and a solution-oriented mindset.

- Process Improvement: Identify bottlenecks or "friction points" in the customer journey and collaborate with leadership to implement automation or workflow optimizations.

- Technical Troubleshooting: Act as a natural troubleshooter, guiding users through basic browser, mobile app, or connectivity issues related to the platform.

- Data & Feedback: Meticulously document all interactions in the CRM and track feedback to help our partners build a world-class experience.

- Liaison & Coordination: Facilitate quick resolutions for site-specific issues and ensure seamless handoffs between clinical teams and advocates.

What You Bring to the Table

- Experience: 1–3 years of experience in customer service, healthcare advocacy, or BPO operations.

- Empathy as a Superpower: You thrive on helping people from all walks of life and are comfortable forming quick bonds with clients, even when they are upset or stressed.

- Technical Fluency: You are a quick learner with computers, CRM systems (like Salesforce or Zendesk), and digital communication tools.

- Operational Curiosity: You don’t just follow a script; you want to understand the "why" behind the process and suggest better ways to get things done.

- Reliability: You are disciplined in a remote environment, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced "startup" atmosphere.

- Mission-Driven: A genuine passion for healthy living and a desire to help people navigate the complexities of the healthcare system.

Requirements & Work Environment

- Remote Work-Home: Enjoy the flexibility of a 100% remote role with the support of an established, connected team.

- Work Hours: Ability to work full-time including evenings and weekends

- Education: High school diploma or equivalent.

- Internet: Must have a high-speed, stable internet connection with a router capable of a wired (plug-in) connection and speeds of 100 Mbps download and 20 Mbps upload.

- Workspace: A dedicated, distraction-free home office space.

- Location: Must be based in Douglas (Roseburg), Josephine (Grants Pass), Jackson (Medford), or Coos (Coos Bay) Counties in Oregon.

Perks and Benefits

- Health & Wellness: Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance plans.

- Time Off: Paid Time Off (PTO) and paid holidays.

- Recognition & Rewards: Monthly and quarterly performance awards for those who consistently exceed KPIs and deliver exceptional care.

- Employee Referral Program: Earn potential significant bonuses for bringing top-tier talent into the Ardent Outsourcing Services family.

- Growth: Access to continuous coaching, professional development, and a culture that emphasizes learning from mistakes.

- Paid Training Program: A robust onboarding experience to set you up for success with our systems and platforms.

Up for the challenge? We’re looking for someone with heart, grit, and a "get it done" mentality. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, we look forward to meeting you.

This job description is intended to convey the general nature and scope of the role. Responsibilities may evolve based on business need. Ardent is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Applied AI Engineer
description:
About BJAK 

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role 

We are looking for applied AI engineers to build AI-native systems for BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This is not a research-only role. We need builders who can use AI to automate real workflows, improve products, reduce manual work and make financial services easier for users and teams.

What You Will Build 

- 
Build AI agents, workflows, tools and automations that solve real customer, product and operations problems.

- 
Apply LLMs, retrieval, tool calling, evaluations, guardrails and automation to practical financial workflows.

- 
Create AI-assisted experiences for onboarding, support, KYC, risk review, CRM, operations, document handling and product intelligence.

- 
Work with product and engineering teams to identify what is worth building, then build it quickly and improve it in production.

- 
Design around real constraints: accuracy, hallucination risk, latency, cost, security, compliance and user trust.

- 
Turn manual processes into reliable AI-enabled systems that can scale.

What We Look For 

- 
Hands-on engineering ability, not just AI strategy or management experience.

- 
Experience building AI agents, LLM apps, RAG systems, automation workflows, copilots or AI-enabled tools.

- 
Strong coding ability in Python, TypeScript, JavaScript or similar practical stack.

- 
Good judgement on what should be automated and what should not.

- 
Able to ship working systems, test quality and improve reliability over time.

- 
Fintech, banking, support automation, risk, KYC, fraud, CRM or operations automation experience is a strong plus.

This Role Is Not For 

- 
People who only want research projects with no production ownership.

- 
Candidates who treat AI as demos instead of working systems.

- 
Engineers who do not care about evaluation, reliability or user impact.

- 
People who overclaim AI impact without evidence.

- 
Builders who cannot work with product, ops and business teams.

The Bar 

We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.

Location 

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Austria . We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Austria .

Language 

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process 

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Technical interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

About Edconic 

Edconic is a leading player in the alternative, experiential education space. We partner with the world's largest and most well-known brands to create and run schools that capture the legacy and value of each brand. Our students get truly unique, once-in-a-lifetime experiences that help shape their future and give them the skills they need to reach their goals.

Our Mission: 

Edconic exists to help learners stand out, move forward, and build meaningful futures in the fields that inspire them. We bring together education and industry, partnering with iconic global organizations to create transformative learning experiences. Our programs are created and delivered by educators and industry practitioners, giving learners access to professional experts, real world challenges, and practical skills. As early career opportunities shrink, we offer credibility, connections, and hands on experience that internships once provided. We prepare learners not simply for their first job but for a lifetime of growth. 

Our values 

• Transformative education: relationship-rich, experiential learning that draws out each learner’s potential.

• Belonging: a community where learners, educators, experts, and staff can bring their authentic selves and support one another.

• Stewardship: as a family-owned organization, we think in generations, developing talent, caring for our partnerships, and building an impact that lasts.

The Role 

We're looking for an experienced Front-End Developer to join our web team, which owns every Edconic digital property – from our school websites to landing pages and email templates. You'll work alongside designers, IT, and MarTech to build solutions that serve real business needs while protecting each brand's unique identity.

You'll be one of two developers on the team, working directly with our lead developer. That means real ownership of your work, a genuine voice in how we build, very little process overhead, and a codebase that is actively moving toward a modern, standardized WordPress stack. We value craft: fast pages and code that the next developer can read.

What You'll Do 

- Build and maintain public-facing websites, micro-sites, and landing pages in collaboration with our lead developer, IT, and MarTech.

- Work with UX/UI designers to confirm the technical feasibility of designs, then translate them into polished, responsive pages that stay true to each brand.

- Build and maintain custom WordPress themes across both of our stacks: modern block-based builds (ACF Blocks, core blocks, block patterns, theme.json) and established classic themes built on PHP templates, Advanced Custom Fields, and Sass.

- Collaborate with our lead developer to shape the team's coding standards, tooling, and workflow, and help migrate our existing sites toward our new modern stack.

- Stay current on emerging web standards and bring ideas to the table where they genuinely fit.

What You Bring 

- 4+ years of front-end web development experience, with strong skills in semantic HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, and WordPress.

- The ability to build a custom WordPress theme from scratch using PHP templates and Advanced Custom Fields.

- Strong CSS skills across Sass and modern native CSS (custom properties, nesting), and solid vanilla JavaScript.

- Comfort working in Git/GitHub with pull requests and code reviews, and with npm-based build tools and the command line.

- A habit of writing semantic, well-structured HTML that covers accessibility basics, with an eye for reuse, cross-browser compatibility, performance, and SEO.

- Experience building and testing HTML emails.

- Strong UX/UI sensibilities and a desire to sweat the small stuff.

- A proactive, self-directed working style – you can run with a project independently and prioritize across several at once.

- Excellent written and verbal communication – you're positive, collaborative, objective, and solution-oriented.

Bonus Experience 

- Modern WordPress block development: ACF Blocks, block.json, theme.json, and block patterns.

- Composer, Bedrock or other Roots tooling (Sage/Blade, Trellis), Vite, or CI/CD with GitHub Actions.

- Deeper accessibility experience (WCAG, ARIA, assistive-technology testing).

- CRM and marketing automation integration (Salesforce, Pardot/Account Engagement).

- Multilingual WordPress sites.

- A modern JavaScript framework such as React or Vue.

- UX or UI design, and design tools such as Figma and Adobe Creative Suite.

How We Use AI 

AI-assisted development is a new and evolving part of our workflow. We use AI coding tools to speed up research, scaffolding, review, and routine work, and you're welcome to do the same.

AI is a tool here, not a substitute for expertise. You are accountable for every line of code that you ship, which means you must be able to write, review, debug, and explain production code entirely on your own. Expect to demonstrate those skills without AI assistance during the interview process.

Location, Travel & Eligibility 

- Fully remote within the United States. Occasional travel to our New York office may be required.

- Must be legally authorized to work in the US.

- Bachelor's degree preferred (Computer Science, Interaction Design, Graphic Design, Communications, or a related field); equivalent professional experience is equally welcome.

Our Commitment 

Edconic supports and embraces diversity and inclusiveness, and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement listed here. Reasonable accommodations are available to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role and to participate in the interview process.

The above statements describe the general nature and level of work for this position. They are not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills. Edconic reserves the right to modify this job description at its sole discretion.

title: Senior Atlassian Cloud Administrator
description:
Role Description 

As a Senior Atlassian Cloud Engineer at Dropbox, you will design, build, and evolve the platforms that help our employees collaborate and get support. With a focus on Jira Service Management (JSM), you will own solutions that simplify service delivery, automate manual processes, and improve the employee experience.

You will lead the design and implementation of service workflows, portals, integrations, asset management, and AI-powered support experiences. Your work will also strengthen the security, reliability, and governance of our broader Atlassian ecosystem, including Jira Cloud and Confluence.

Partnering with Engineering, Corporate IT, Security, and other stakeholders, you will translate complex needs into scalable, maintainable solutions. You will take projects from discovery through delivery and ongoing operations, making technical decisions that balance immediate needs with long-term platform health.

Our Engineering Career Framework is viewable by anyone outside the company and describes whatâs expected for our engineers at each of our career levels. Check out our blog post on this topic and more here .

Responsibilities 

- Own the design, implementation, and ongoing improvement of Jira Service Management capabilities that make employee support simpler, faster, and more effective.

- Build scalable workflows, service portals, queues, service-level agreements (SLAs), and automation across incident, request, problem, and change management.

- Develop secure, maintainable integrations between Atlassian Cloud and enterprise systems using APIs, webhooks, and scripting.

- Improve employee self-service through Confluence knowledge bases, Rovo, and AI-powered support experiences.

- Develop JSM Assets and configuration management capabilities that improve data quality, asset visibility, and service delivery.

- Strengthen governance, access controls, security, and operational reliability across Jira Cloud, JSM, and Confluence while reducing configuration complexity and technical debt.

- Partner with stakeholders across teams to define requirements, evaluate technical tradeoffs, and deliver projects from discovery through rollout and ongoing support.

- Create reusable configuration patterns, documentation, and runbooks, and use operational metrics and employee feedback to guide improvements.

On-call work may be necessary occasionally to help address bugs, outages, or other operational issues, with the goal of maintaining a stable and high-quality experience for our customers.

Requirements 

- 9+ years of relevant experience in enterprise Atlassian platform administration, engineering, or equivalent technical work.

- Deep expertise in Jira Cloud and Jira Service Management, including configuration, permissions, governance, and troubleshooting.

- Demonstrated experience designing and implementing JSM workflows, service portals, queues, SLAs, and automation.

- Experience building and maintaining integrations using REST APIs, webhooks, and scripting.

- Strong understanding of SaaS security, access management, and operational reliability.

- Proven ability to solve ambiguous technical problems, make sound design decisions, and independently own complex projects through delivery.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document technical solutions and collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- Practical experience (or strong interest) using AI tools in day-to-day development, along with a thoughtful approach to validating outputs and integrating AI into your workflow.

title: Lead Product Manager, Inference

The role 

Mistral is building a sovereign AI cloud. Our inference platform already serves production traffic at scale. We are hiring a Lead Product Manager to own the inference portfolio within our Cloud & Inference organization.

You will work on state of the art infrastructure, in close collaboration with our science and research engineering teams. Your job is to turn that infrastructure into products that AI-native startups and enterprises pay for, integrated with our developer platform Studio.

What you'll do 

- Strategy and vision: define the vision, strategy, and annual goals for the inference portfolio, aligned with customer needs and company objectives. Benchmark the managed-inference field and pick where we win.

- Fluency in the economics of the business: gross margin, unit economics, and the tradeoffs behind token pricing and GPU capacity.

What You'll Own 

- 
Build and ship Android features using Kotlin.

Create clean mobile flows for insurance, payments, claims, renewals and financial services.

- 
Work with product and design to simplify complex user journeys.

- 
Use analytics, user behaviour and production issues to improve the product.

What We're Looking For

Strong Android fundamentals and experience shipping production apps.

- 
Good knowledge of Jetpack, Coroutines, Flow and modern Android architecture.

- 
Strong sense of mobile UX, usability, edge cases and user flows.

- 
Experience integrating REST APIs and debugging production issues.

- 
Fast execution, high ownership and strong attention to product quality.

- 
App links, GitHub, screenshots or examples of shipped work are a strong advantage.

Tech Stack 

- 
Kotlin

- 
Jetpack Compose

- 
Android SDK

- 
Coroutines & Flow

- 
SQL / NoSQL

- 
TensorFlow Lite (on-device inference)

The Kind of Builder We Want 

- 
Thinks in user journeys, not just screens.

Cares about making complex financial products feel simple.

Moves fast without creating messy code.

Notices UX, performance and reliability issues before users complain.

Honest about what they personally built, what was team-owned and what impact they can or cannot claim.

Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.

Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany . We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany .

title: Senior Software Engineer - Product Core Team
description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! 

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. 

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. 

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. 

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. 

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. 

About BLP 

Join BLP and help make the world's business processes autonomous.

Our agentic AI platform helps enterprises worldwide remove manual execution from their core business processes, enabling those processes to run autonomously end-to-end, with greater control and productivity gains of 5–10×.

Today, more than 550 enterprise customers rely on BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. Across more than 40 countries, our platform automates purchase-to-pay and order-to-cash processes for organizations ranging from mid-sized companies to Fortune 500 enterprises with complex global operations.

Our success is built on deep expertise in business processes and technology, a differentiated product, and strong product-market fit, as reflected in a continually expanding customer base.

As one of Europe's fastest-growing AI companies, BLP is entering its next phase of growth with the backing of Goldman Sachs Alternatives as a minority growth investor. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we are expanding our presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

About the role 

- What you'll do and for whom. You build and run the core backend service our product teams rely on, from its APIs and persistence layer to email, user provisioning, and cross-tenant capabilities for large enterprises. Through those teams, your work reaches the 20'000+ people who use our Purchase-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash agents every day.

- Where you'll work. You join the Product Core Team, about 12 engineers. You work closely with the senior backend engineer who owns these areas today, in a large production Go codebase with well-established patterns, and with the frontend engineers who build the UIs on top of your APIs.

- What success looks like. In your first year, you own one core area end-to-end, for example, user provisioning, outbound email, cross-tenant capabilities, analytics, or workflow configuration, from the Go service to the customer using it.

What you'll do 

- Build the service that product teams build on. Design, build, and evolve the core APIs behind document processing, approval workflows, administration, and analytics, with clear contracts so product teams can ship on top of them without workarounds.

- Own the persistence layer. Each tenant has its own isolated MySQL database. You evolve the abstraction product teams build on (a tenant-scoped unit of work, typed repositories, and shared type-safe querying) so that isolation, transactions, and permissions are right by default.

- Scale BLP for large enterprises. Extend our cross-tenant capabilities so customers with many subsidiaries and business units can manage users, permissions, and documents across all of them from one place, correctly, securely, and fast.

- Own email, in and out. Own our email document ingestion and outbound email services, including their audit trail.

- Make setup self-service. Turn manual SSO, SCIM, and email setups into migration tools and the APIs behind our admin UIs, so customers and project managers can run them on their own.

- Work with customers. Join onboarding calls with customer IT teams and project managers, get their setups running, and turn what you learn into better tooling.

- Own it end-to-end. From design through the Go service to production, including tracing, metrics, and incident analysis after it ships.

Tech stack: Go, MySQL, Redis, Temporal, Kubernetes on GCP and AWS, GitHub CI/CD, and OpenTelemetry with Grafana, Prometheus, Tempo, and Parca for observability.

We're excited about you because 

- You have 4+ years of experience as a backend developer , building and operating systems in production.

- You have 2+ years of professional Go experience , writing services that run in production, not side projects.

- You've designed a backend service or API that other teams depended on, and kept it reliable and evolvable as usage grew.

- You work well across teams. You align with product, frontend, integration, and infrastructure teams on contracts, priorities, and rollouts, and you can explain technical trade-offs to people who aren't engineers.

- You improve existing production systems step by step, and you know when a rewrite isn't worth it.

- You have strong fundamentals in type systems, composition, testing, and clean architecture, and you're comfortable working in a codebase built on functional patterns.

- You think in products and take ownership. You translate business problems into precise specifications, weigh cost against benefit, work directly with customers when a setup needs it, and stay responsible for what you ship after it goes live.

Strong plus 

- Experience with distributed systems , Kubernetes, Temporal, or cloud infrastructure.

- Experience with user provisioning (SCIM) and SSO (OIDC).

- Experience running multi-tenant systems.

- Domain knowledge in ERP, finance, procurement, or supply chain processes, or German language skills.

What you'll get 

- Ownership of visible outcomes. The areas you own decide how fast enterprise customers go live and how well BLP scales with them.

- Impact at scale. Every improvement you ship to the product core multiplies across all product teams and the 20'000+ people who use BLP daily.

- Senior scope from day one. You'll lead technical initiatives and mentor engineers on a team that is actively growing its backend ownership.

Learn more about BLP and our values at blp.digital/company/careers .

title: Robotics Application Engineer
description:
At Rhoda AI, we’re building the next generation of generalist intelligent robots. We own the full robotics stack from high-performance hardware and robot systems to the infrastructure and state-of-the-art foundation world models that control our robots. Our robots are designed to be generalists capable of operating in complex, real-world environments and handling long-tail edge cases, made possible by our cutting edge research and end-to-end system design. We've raised over $450M and are investing aggressively in model research, infrastructure, hardware development, and manufacturing scale-up to make generalist robotics a reality.

Robotics Application Engineer – Rhoda AI GmbH (Germany) 

About Rhoda AI GmbH 
Rhoda AI GmbH is Rhoda AI's first international entity, established to own strategic partner relationships across Europe and drive deployment of Robotics as a Service (RaaS). It's a small, high-ownership team: you'll work with the Managing Director and Commercial Lead as peers from day one, with a direct line to our engineering organization in Silicon Valley.

About the Application Engineering Team 
Application Engineering is where Rhoda's AI meets the real world. We work directly with customers and strategic partners to understand their operational problems, determine where our platform can deliver value, and lead the application of Rhoda's AI model end to end — from model post-training and data collection, to robot tooling and work-cell design, to production deployments on the customer's floor. The team sits at the intersection of engineering, product, deployment operations, and business, with members in the US and Germany. Application Engineering is organized into three complementary roles — Application Engineers, Solution Engineers, and Technical Program Managers.

The Role 
As a Robotics Application Engineer, you are a core member of Rhoda AI's European team and the hands-on technical lead in the early stages of a partner engagement — Scoping, Proof of Principle (POP), and Proof of Concept (POC) — through to RaaS deployment. You'll determine whether a use case is feasible, design and prototype the end effectors and task tooling a robot needs to do the job, write the data collection procedures that feed our models, and post-train Rhoda's AI model to perform the task. You'll spend real time on partner sites across Europe standing up POCs and showing what our platform can do.

You'll also serve as a key technical bridge between our European partners and Rhoda HQ Engineering, owning the feedback loop that turns field findings into product improvements.

What You'll Do 

- Scope new partner use cases alongside the commercial team: ask the right questions, assess technical feasibility, and make go/no-go recommendations.

- Design, prototype, and iterate on end effectors and task-specific tooling for real-world manipulation tasks.

- Author and refine data collection SOPs, and work with teleoperation and ML ops teams to gather high-quality training data.

- Post-train and evaluate Rhoda's AI model on partner tasks, driving performance toward POC success criteria.

- Lead on-site POP/POC setup and execution, including model training, daily reporting, validation, and direct partner interaction, and author the final technical report.

- Partner with Solution Engineers on task engineering and solution design input as engagements move toward production.

- Review proposals and provide technical feedback ahead of purchase orders.

- Support model training through Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), deployment, and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT).

- Lead root cause analysis for issues surfaced during deployments, troubleshooting across hardware, firmware, and software until the real cause is found.

- Share field learnings with product and engineering in Silicon Valley, translating partner-reported issues into prioritized, actionable input for the roadmap.

- Present clear, non-technical summaries of technical outcomes to partner leadership, and work with the commercial team to tie them to commercial milestones.

What You'll Bring 

- BS or MS in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics, Computer Science, or a related field.

- 3–8 years of hands-on experience in robotics, automation, systems integration, or applied engineering in an industrial setting, including real-world deployments or field installations.

- Strong mechanical design skills, including CAD (e.g., SolidWorks, Onshape, Fusion) and rapid prototyping (3D printing, machining, off-the-shelf components).

- Working knowledge of machine learning workflows — data collection, training, and evaluation — and comfort working in Python.

- Experience with robot arms, grippers, and sensors (cameras, depth sensors, LiDAR, IMUs) in real environments, including integration and calibration.

- Proven track record conducting root cause analysis on complex systems spanning hardware, firmware, and software.

- Strong problem-solving skills and comfort working with ambiguity in high-stakes environments.

- Clear communicator who can explain technical tradeoffs to partners, executives, and internal teams. Fluent English required; German at working level minimum.

- Willingness to travel approximately 40% across Europe, including extended on-site POC periods, with occasional travel to the US.

Nice to Have 

- Experience with imitation learning, VLA models, world models, or robot foundation models.

- Background in factory automation, material handling, or logistics.

- Experience in a customer-facing technical role (application, field, FDE, or sales engineering) at a robotics OEM, system integrator, or corporate automation department.

- Familiarity with teleoperation systems or remote robot management workflows.

- Experience with ROS/ROS2, embedded Linux, or C/Rust for onboard software.

Why Rhoda AI GmbH 

- Work on real customer problems, not lab demos: our robots are ready for field deployment directly after a successful POC.

- Direct line to HQ Engineering — your field intelligence shapes the product roadmap.

- Small, high-ownership team where you work with the Managing Director and Commercial Lead as peers from day one.

title: Principal Software Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
The role 

Reporting directly to the VP Technology, you'll build new capability for Awin with AI at the core, free from the constraints of our established delivery model. You'll take ideas from concept to production quickly, prove what works, and turn the best of it into patterns the wider engineering organisation can adopt.

You'll work closely with product and commercial leaders to find where AI changes the economics of our affiliate marketing platform: what we can build, how fast, and at what cost. You'll be hands-on most of the time, writing code, shipping and measuring results, rather than coordinating others.

You'll know enough of our existing platform to connect new things to it safely, but you won't be absorbed into running it. Your job is to show what modern, AI-native engineering looks like at Awin, and make it real.

This is a step-up opportunity. We're looking for a bright, self-starting engineer who is ready for more scope than their current role allows. You might not have held a principal title yet. What matters is that you're already building this way, you learn fast, and you want the room to prove it. You'll have direct access to senior leadership, real problems with commercial weight, and the freedom to choose how you solve them.

Key tasks and accountabilities 

Build and ship 

- Design, build and run AI-powered products, tools and services from prototype to production

- Own outcomes end to end: problem framing, architecture, implementation, evaluation, release and operation

- Run fast, time-boxed experiments; scale what works and stop what doesn't, with the evidence to back either call

- Set up and evolve the AI infrastructure these builds rely on: model access, evaluation tooling, observability and guardrails

Shape direction 

- Work with the VP Technology to set Awin's engineering-specific AI direction, grounded in what has actually been built and measured

- Scope strategic opportunities early with product and commercial leaders, with effort, cost and value made explicit

- Make clear recommendations on build vs buy, model and vendor choice, and where AI should not be used

Architecture and design 

- Design new capability so it connects safely to the existing platform: APIs, events, data and identity

- Select tools and technologies, and define the patterns and practices for AI-native development at Awin

- Weigh long-term maintainability, economic viability and reuse against speed, and document the trade-offs

Spread what works 

- Turn proven builds into reusable patterns, templates and internal tools, and share them so other teams can adopt them without hand-holding

Ways of working 

- Works autonomously, guided by the VP Technology's priorities rather than team-level delivery processes

- Engages directly with engineering, product, data, security and commercial stakeholders as each build requires

Skills & Expertise 

AI-native engineering 

- Builds with coding agents (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) as the default way of working. Can show how they decompose work, manage context and review agent output to get production-quality code at pace

- Has shipped LLM-powered features to production: prompt and context engineering, tool use and function calling, structured outputs, retrieval (RAG) and multi-step agent workflows

- Builds evaluations first: test sets, automated evals and regression checks for non-deterministic behaviour, with quality measured before and after release

- Connects models to enterprise systems and data safely, e.g. MCP servers, internal APIs and event streams, with clear permissions and audit trails

- Understands model selection, token economics, latency, caching and fallback strategies, and can explain cost and benefit trade-offs to commercial stakeholders

- Designs for AI-specific security and privacy risks: prompt injection, data leakage, PII handling under GDPR, and guardrails on what models can do

Engineering foundations 

- Expert in at least one modern language (Python or TypeScript ideal), and able to work in our existing Java, PHP and JavaScript estate when integrating

- Strong cloud-native and serverless architecture on AWS, with infrastructure as code (Terraform)

- Experience with event-driven and distributed systems (Kafka/MSK, SQS/SNS) and with relational and non-relational data stores

- Builds observability into everything: tracing, logging and monitoring, including LLM-specific telemetry

- Treats automated testing, CI/CD and secure-by-default design as standard, and automates as much of the delivery loop as possible

Ways of building 

- Takes an idea to a working prototype in days, then hardens it for production, and knows when to stop

- Leaves behind reusable patterns, templates and internal tools, not one-off solutions

Soft skills 

- Bias to action: ships, measures and iterates rather than waiting for perfect requirements

- Comfortable with ambiguity: frames vague opportunities into concrete, testable bets

- Commercially minded: connects technical choices to revenue, cost and customer outcomes, and balances effort against value

- Intellectually honest: kills their own ideas when the evidence says so, and says plainly where AI is not the answer

- Clear communicator: explains technical trade-offs to executives, engineers and commercial teams in language each understands, in writing and in person

- Influences without authority: gets teams to adopt new patterns because they work, not because they're mandated

Our Offer 

- 
Flexi-Week : We prioritise your mental health and wellbeing by offering you a four-day Flexi-Week (with one lighter or completely disconnected day per week) at full pay, with no reduction to your annual holiday allowance.

- 
Flexi-office : We offer an international culture and flexibility through our hybrid/remote working scheme which is designed to foster a culture of mutual trust and working flexibility.

- 
Work Expense Contribution & Remote Working Furniture : You will receive a monthly allowance to cover part of your running costs, as well as a furniture package to support you in setting up a comfortable workspace when working from home.

- 
Health and Wellbeing : With our support and access to various initiatives and sports offers, you can focus on your mental and physical wellbeing.

- 
Development : We’ve built our extensive training suite, Awin Academy, to cover a wide range of skills that support your professional and personal growth, with trainings conveniently packaged to help your overall development.

- 
Appreciation : Thank and reward colleagues by sending them a voucher through our peer-to-peer recognition programme.

We are hiring in multiple countries for this role. Additional benefits, including health and wellbeing offerings, will be discussed during the initial interview. 

Established in 2000, Awin is proud of our dynamic, social and inclusive culture.

Like all businesses, we’ve had to adapt and nurture our culture in a virtual environment. Our virtual ‘Life @ Awin’ hub brings our colleagues from across the globe together for various social activities.

Diversity & Inclusion are paramount to us, and we proudly pursue and hire diverse team members. We champion uniqueness and authenticity; this is who we are at our core. Our network of affiliate partnerships are diverse and transparent, as are the employees powering our vision to build the world’s leading open partner ecosystem. title: Applied AI Engineer
description:
About Us: 

Future is building a personalized guidance system for lifelong health. We help people understand what to do next for their body, goals, and stage of life — then support them in turning those decisions into sustained behavior change. By combining AI, human expertise, personal health data, and accountability, Future helps members improve performance today while building the resilience, capacity, and healthspan they need for decades to come.

About the Role 

We're looking for an Applied AI Engineer to help us build and ship AI-powered features that directly improve our product experience and business outcomes. This is a hands-on, product-focused role where you'll take ideas from concept to production — designing intelligent systems, validating them with real users, and turning them into reliable, scalable services.

You'll work at the intersection of AI, product, and engineering — partnering closely with cross-functional teams to identify high-impact opportunities, prototype quickly, and iterate based on data. This isn't a research-only role. You'll own the full lifecycle: experimentation, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

The ideal candidate is excited about applying LLMs and modern ML tooling to real-world problems. You think in terms of systems, tradeoffs, and outcomes — not just models. You care about performance, quality, latency, and cost in production. Most importantly, you're motivated by shipping impactful AI experiences that customers actually use.

What You'll Do 

- Build and ship AI agents that serve real users: tool-calling LLM systems with structured output, parallel API orchestration, and streaming responses.

- Design evaluation harnesses and quality scoring — we use Langfuse, rubrics to measure safety, effectiveness, and personalization.

- Own the full loop: prototype a new agent capability, validate it with evals, deploy it to staging and production, monitor traces, and iterate.

- Improve reliability, latency, and cost through prompt caching strategies, token budgets, retry logic, and observability.

- Write the tools agents use: API integrations with Pydantic validation, exercise search over local databases, structured workout submission.

What You Bring 

- Strong Python skills: you've built and deployed services on large production systems.

- Experience with LangChain/LangGraph or similar agent frameworks.

- Hands-on experience with LLMs in production: prompt engineering, tool/function calling, structured output, evaluation.

- Comfort with async Python, HTTP APIs, and streaming protocols (SSE, webhooks).

- Experience with data validation and schema design (Pydantic, JSON Schema).

- Ability to debug across layers: from a broken LLM tool call to a misconfigured Terraform resource.

- Clear communication: you'll work directly with product, mobile, and backend engineers.

Nice to Have 

- Familiarity with AWS (Bedrock, ECR, CloudFront, S3, Cognito) or other cloud agent hosting.

- Observability and tracing tools (Langfuse, OpenTelemetry, Datadog).

- Exposure to evaluation frameworks: LLM-as-a-judge, automated scoring, dataset management.

- Infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CDK).

Compensation & Benefits 

We believe great people should be well paid and meaningfully invested in what they're building.

Base Salary $ 215,000– $ 250,000/ year + equity. The salary range is set based on multiple considerations including business needs, market demands, talent availability, experience, and unique skills and attributes. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future.

Equity Equity participation offered alongside base compensation.

Health Coverage Comprehensive medical, vision, dental, and disability insurance plus tax savings accounts for all eligible employees.

Retirement 401(k) plan with tax-advantaged savings options.

Remote-First Employment eligible to all employees located anywhere in the continental US. No travel required.

Wellness & Development Monthly health and fitness stipend contributing to overall wellbeing, access to a mental health platform, reimbursement for medical travel, and an annual learning & development stipend.

Flexible Time Off Flexible PTO so you can rest, recharge, and take care of life outside of work.

Future Membership Enjoy our platform for free!

Life at Future 

Equity: Meaningful equity package.
Health Coverage: All employees who meet eligibility requirements receive comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and disability insurance, plus tax-advantaged savings accounts.
Retirement: 401(k) plan.
Wellness: Monthly wellness stipend for fitness, recovery, and overall wellbeing, plus access to mental health resources and therapy support.
Flexible Time Off: Flexible PTO so you can rest, recharge, and take care of life outside of work.
Learning & Development: Annual budget for courses, conferences, coaching, and tools that help you grow in your craft.
Future Membership: Enjoy our platform for free.

Equal Employment Opportunities at Future 

We are committed to building a future where every member of our community, is healthy, cared for, and advancing forward together. Future is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, age, civil or family status, disability or race.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Operational Excellence
description:
Change the way the world travels 

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours. 

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team mission 

Incidents interrupt operations, drain team productivity, and erode user trust. As a member of the Operational Excellence team, you will help GetYourGuide notice problems sooner, fix them faster, and stop the same ones from coming back, so our travelers and suppliers see fewer disruptions and trust us more.

As we push boldly into AI-powered experiences, we don’t ignore the risks that increased output velocity creates. Faster change means more places for silent failures to hide. You will help our engineering organisation move fast with confidence, with the safeguards (tests, safe rollouts, monitoring, clear ownership) that catch problems before customers do.

Observability and cost efficiency are part of the same job: teams can’t fix or own what they can’t see. You will build the tooling, standards, and habits that make operational excellence a shared standard across all engineering teams, from blameless learning after every incident to alerts teams trust and cost visibility per team.

Your mission 

You will act as an "engineer for the engineers" — partnering with other engineering teams to raise the bar on reliability, speed, and confidence in their systems.

Incident management & reliability 

- Drive down how often incidents happen, how long it takes us to notice them, and how long it takes to fix them, with a focus on catching problems with monitors instead of by chance

- Lead post-incident reviews, translate learnings into systemic improvements, and make sure follow-up actions actually get done

- Build tooling and runbooks that enable teams to detect, diagnose and resolve production issues faster

- Champion a culture of blameless incident handling and continuous improvement

Observability & production confidence 

- Advance our Datadog-based observability practice — metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and alerting

- Help teams set measurable reliability targets with actionable alerts that reach the right owner — not alert fatigue

- Enable production debugging capabilities so engineers can triage issues without needing a specialist

Change confidence & release quality 

- Reduce how often changes cause failures in production by helping teams find and close the biggest gaps in their automated testing

- Make testing and CI faster and more reliable for product teams, so engineers trust their tests instead of working around them

- Identify blast radius risks and architectural gaps in evolving systems, and drive mitigation

- Reduce the cost and risk of deployments through better tooling, feature flagging, and progressive rollout practices

Platform enablement 

- Design and maintain paved paths: well - documented golden paths for development, observability, testing, and incident response so engineering teams can do the right things by default

- Work hands-on with product teams using Java and React to help them improve system design, testability, and operational hygiene

- Draw on Kubernetes, AWS, and service mesh expertise to guide product teams on infrastructure best practices

- Make infrastructure cost visible to teams and help them find and act on efficiency opportunities

- Leverage AI tooling to accelerate incident response, improve developer workflows, and scale operational practices

Your toolkit 

- 8+ years of relevant industry experience

- Deep understanding of observability tooling — we use Datadog (metrics, APM, logs, dashboards) — and of what makes alerts and production debugging effective

- Track record of improving the reliability of production systems at scale

- Strong coding skills in Java; comfortable reading and contributing in Go across infrastructure contexts; enough frontend context to collaborate with React / Vue teams

- Working experience with Kubernetes and AWS, and familiarity with service mesh technologies (Istio/Envoy)

- Solid understanding of distributed systems, networking, and container technology

- Hands-on experience with automated testing across unit, integration, and end-to-end levels, as well as CI/CD and build systems

- Hands-on, everyday use of AI in your engineering work

- You have led improvements that reached many teams at once, not just your own, with results you can point to:

- You have helped teams ship with more confidence and fewer production surprises

- You have embedded operational excellence practices into the culture of product engineering teams, not just platform teams

- You have helped teams cut or avoid cost through technical or operational improvements

- You have driven AI adoption beyond yourself: workflows you built are relied on by others and visibly changed how they work

- You communicate in clear, concise English: you listen to understand, adapt to your audience, and make sure people know what to do next

- You are a positive, proactive team player who is passionate about operational excellence and who helps others deliver

How to apply 

Submit your CV/resume in English using the form below. For tips and insights into our hiring process and culture, check out ‘ how we hire ’ and ‘ our culture ’. If you have any further questions, please don’t hesitate to get in touch at 

We’re an equal opportunities employer 

Our commitment is that every qualified person will be evaluated according to their skills regardless of age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status, or religion. Please refrain from including your picture and age with your application.

title: Marketing Growth Engineer
description:
TL;DR: 
We're looking for a full-stack engineer who wants to sit at the heart of Lovable's marketing engine - making every pound of spend measurable, and every manual workflow a tool. One sprint you're tracing spend from first click to revenue across Meta, Google and newer channels; the next you're shipping landing pages, experiments or an agent that saves the team hours a week. You think in React and APIs, but your first instinct is always: can we measure it, and does it help us grow faster?

Coding skills + excellent taste + growth instincts + marketing obsession = you. 

Why Lovable? 

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

What we’re looking for 

- 5+ years of experience building and growing user-facing products in high-performing teams, ideally including growth work, marketplaces/platforms, or communities.

- Strong product sense and UX taste for multi-sided systems with creators, learners, and customers - you can see problems from multiple sides and design for all of them.

- Knowledge of Meta Pixel and Google Ad Network APIs, and experience working with data from ad networks. Experience with TikTok, LinkedIn, Reddit and Beehiiv, plus CTV/podcast tracking, is a plus.

- Comfortable using data, funnels, analytics, attribution, and A/B testing to shape what you build and how you iterate.

- Skilled at designing, measuring, and iterating experiments, and thorough in setting up growth systems "right" from the start.

- Experience collaborating across functions (design, marketing, partnerships, support, data) to launch and grow new product surfaces and ecosystems.

- Enjoys designing reusable growth, ecosystem, and monetization tools that other builders can plug into, with a pragmatic and detail-oriented mindset.

- Motivated by helping others succeed and by seeing impact through engagement, measurable results, and revenue - you care about the scoreboard as much as the code.

What you’ll do 

In one sentence: You'll sit between marketing and engineering and build whatever we need to grow faster, from the site and tracking to the tools the team uses every day - expect to be driving the thinking here alongside our team leads.

- Build the tools marketing runs on: Find the manual work slowing the team down and replace it with tools, automations or agents, ideally built on Lovable.

- Shape what gets built: Work with design, marketing, data and partnerships to decide what's worth doing, then own it end to end.

- Own how we measure marketing: Make sure every pound of spend can be traced from first click to revenue, across Meta and Google and newer channels like CTV and podcast. This is what lets us scale spend with confidence.

- Make experimentation cheap & fast: Build the events, funnels and A/B testing setup that let the team test an idea in days and double down on what works.

- Turn the website into a growth surface: Ship landing pages, signup flows and first-run moments that get new users to value fast, without waiting in a product queue.

- Keep it Lovable: Growth should feel like part of the product, never bolted on.

Our tech stack 

We're building with tools that both humans and AI love:

- Frontend: React

- Backend: Golang and Rust

- Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, Many LLM providers

- DevOps & Tooling: Github Actions, Grafana, OTEL, infra-as-code (Terraform)

About your application 

Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.

We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

title: Senior AI Engineer (GTM)
description:
What do we do? 

Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better. 

We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally. 

The role: 

We’re looking for an entrepreneurial and technically strong Senior AI Engineer to join our Data & AI team and work with our Go-To-Market organisation.

This is a builder's role, end to end. You’ll work closely with Marketing, Sales, and RevOps to solve high-value problems, design practical AI solutions and build them into reliable systems that people use every day. You’ll be expected to move comfortably from an ambiguous business challenge to a technical design, a working prototype, and then a production-ready solution.

Your work could include building systems that segment and prioritise accounts, developing agents that automate sales workflows, or creating intelligent tools that help our teams research prospects and act on buying signals. You’ll own the full lifecycle of what you build, including evaluation, observability, reliability and cost optimisation.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys being close to users, can write production-quality code and is excited by the challenge of turning rapidly evolving AI capabilities into valuable commercial outcomes. Experience working with GTM teams is useful, but the ability to understand problems, build effective systems and measure their impact is more important.

What you'll do: 

- 
Design and build AI-powered systems for account segmentation, enrichment, scoring, prioritisation and buying-signal detection

- 
Develop and deploy agentic workflows for use cases such as account research, outbound personalisation, call summarisation and CRM hygiene

- 
Write production-quality code and build the integrations, data pipelines and services required to take solutions from prototype to reliable daily use

- 
Optimise systems for quality, latency and cost through evaluation, prompt design, model selection, routing, caching, context management and token optimisation

- 
Establish practical patterns for building AI systems at Paddle, including monitoring, guardrails, documentation and clear measures of business impact

We'd love to hear from you if you: 

- 
Have strong software engineering experience and can independently take a problem from technical design through to production; Python and SQL experience would be particularly relevant

- 
Have hands-on experience building applications with large language models, APIs, retrieval systems, agents or other applied AI technologies

- 
Understand how to evaluate and operate AI systems in production, including managing hallucination risk, latency, reliability, context limits and variable model costs

- 
Are comfortable working with structured and unstructured data, building integrations and turning information from multiple sources into useful systems

- 
Have an interest in commercial problems and can understand concepts such as ICP, segmentation, pipeline, buyer intent and sales workflows; direct GTM experience is beneficial but not essential

- 
Enjoy working directly with the people who use what you build, are comfortable with ambiguity and can balance speed, quality, and long-term maintainability

Everyone is welcome at Paddle 

At Paddle, we’re committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. We recognise and celebrate that every Paddler is unique and we welcome every individual perspective. As an inclusive employer, we don’t care if, or where, you studied, what you look like or where you’re from. We’re more interested in your craft, curiosity, passion for learning and what you’ll add to our culture. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t match every part of the job ad, especially if you’re part of an underrepresented group.

Please let us know if there’s anything we can do to better support you through the application process and in the workplace. We will do everything we can to support any accommodations needed. We’re committed to building a diverse team where everyone feels safe to be their authentic self. Let’s grow together.

Why you’ll love working at Paddle 

We’re a diverse, growing group of Paddlers who pride ourselves on our transparent, collaborative and respectful culture.

We live and breathe our values, which are:

- 
Paddle Together - “None of us, is as smart as all of us” 

- 
Paddle Simply - “Simple can be harder than complex: you have to get your thinking clean to make it simple” 

- 
Paddle for others - “We can realise our wildest dreams, so long as we help enough other people to realise theirs” 

We offer a full suite of benefits, including attractive salaries, stock options, unlimited holidays, enhanced parental leave, retirement plans, private healthcare and well-being initiatives.

We invest in learning and will help you with your personal development via constant exposure to new challenges, an annual learning fund, and regular internal and external training.

We recognize that where our Paddlers do their best work is unique to them and we provide trust and autonomy for everyone to work in a way which fits them best. We also value the power of connection and have invested in global hubs which help local communities flourish and bring us together for focused collaboration.

Our Paddle hubs:

- 
In Europe: UK (London headquarters), Portugal (Lisbon hub), Netherlands and Ireland (Dublin hub)

- 
In North America: Austin, TX (USA) and Toronto (Canada)

- 
In APAC : Singapore

title: Solutions Architect, Mid-Market (EMEA)
description:
